book.title: Sri Guru Granth Sahib

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਆਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag kaajal koThaRee tan man dheh suaaeh ||
verses.translation: The whole world is a store-house of lamp-black; the body and mind are blackened with it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se niramale sabadh nivaaree bhaeh ||7||
verses.translation: Those who are saved by the Guru are immaculate and pure; through the Word of the Shabad, they extinguish the fire of desire. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak tareeaai sach naam sir saahaa paatisaahu ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they swim across with the True Name of the Lord, the King above the heads of kings.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: mai har naam na veesarai har naam ratan vesaahu ||
verses.translation: May I never forget the Name of the Lord! I have purchased the Jewel of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhaujal pach mue gurmukh tare athaahu ||8||16||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in the terrifying world-ocean, while the Gurmukhs cross over the bottomless ocean. ||8||16||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਧੋਖ ॥
verses.translit: mukaam kar ghar baisanaa nit chalanai kee dhokh ||
verses.translation: They have made this their resting place and they sit at home, but the urge to depart is always there.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mukaam taa par jaaneeaai jaa rahai nihachal lok ||1||
verses.translation: This would be known as a lasting place of rest, only if they were to remain stable and unchanging. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈਸਿ ਮੁਕਾਮੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa kais mukaame ||
verses.translation: What sort of a resting place is this world?

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar sidhak karanee kharach baadhahu laag rahu naame ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Doing deeds of faith, pack up the supplies for your journey, and remain committed to the Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਤ ਆਸਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਲਾ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਕਾਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: jogee ta aasan kar bahai mulaa bahai mukaam ||
verses.translation: The Yogis sit in their Yogic postures, and the Mullahs sit at their resting stations.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਸਿਧ ਬਹਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit vakhaaneh potheeaa sidh baheh dhev sathaan ||2||
verses.translation: The Hindu Pandits recite from their books, and the Siddhas sit in the temples of their gods. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ ਪੀਰ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sur sidh gan ga(n)dharab mun jan sekh peer salaar ||
verses.translation: The angels, Siddhas, worshippers of Shiva, heavenly musicians, silent sages, Saints, priests, preachers, spiritual teachers and commanders

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਕੂਚ ਕੂਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਵਰੇ ਭਿ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhar kooch koochaa kar ge avare bh chalanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: -each and every one has left, and all others shall depart as well. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਉਮਰੇ ਗਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੂਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: sulataan khaan malook umare ge kar kar kooch ||
verses.translation: The sultans and kings, the rich and the mighty, have marched away in succession.

verses.original: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਦਿਲ ਸਮਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਭਿ ਪਹੂਚੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ghaRee muhat k chalanaa dhil samajh too(n) bh pahooch ||4||
verses.translation: In a moment or two, we shall also depart. O my heart, understand that you must go as well! ||4||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਾਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhaeh maeh vakhaaneeaai viralaa ta boojhai koi ||
verses.translation: This is described in the Shabads; only a few understand this!

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak vakhaanai benatee jal thal maheeal soi ||5||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to the One who pervades the water, the land and the air. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਲਾਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: alaahu alakh aga(n)m kaadhar karanahaar kareem ||
verses.translation: He is Allah, the Unknowable, the Inaccessible, All-powerful and Merciful Creator.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਰਹੀਮੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sabh dhunee aavan jaavanee mukaam ek raheem ||6||
verses.translation: All the world comes and goes-only the Merciful Lord is permanent. ||6||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਸਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: mukaam tis no aakheeaai jis sis na hovee lekh ||
verses.translation: Call permanent only the One, who does not have destiny inscribed upon His Forehead.

verses.original: ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: asamaan dharatee chalasee mukaam ohee ek ||7||
verses.translation: The sky and the earth shall pass away; He alone is permanent. ||7||

verses.original: ਦਿਨ ਰਵਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਸਸਿ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਲਖ ਪਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhin rav chalai nis sas chalai taarikaa lakh paloi ||
verses.translation: The day and the sun shall pass away; the night and the moon shall pass away; the hundreds of thousands of stars shall disappear.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਗੋਇ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: mukaam ohee ek hai naanakaa sach bugoi ||8||17||
verses.translation: He alone is permanent; Nanak speaks the Truth. ||8||17||

verses.original: ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸਤਾਰਹ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahale pahile sataareh asaTapadheeaa ||
verses.translation: Seventeen Ashtpadheeyaa Of The First Mehla.

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kirapaa kare bhagat keejai bin gur bhagat na hoi ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, the Gurmukh practices devotion; without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapai aap milaae boojhai taa niramal hovai koi ||
verses.translation: One who merges his own self into Him understands, and so becomes pure.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har jeeau sachaa sachee baanee sabadh milaavaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Word of the Shabad, Union with Him is obtained. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re bhagatiheen kaahe jag aaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, without devotion, why have people even come into the world?

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kee sev na keenee birathaa janam gavaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They have not served the Perfect Guru; they have wasted their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape har jagajeevan dhaataa aape bakhas milaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver. He Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t e kiaa vechaare kiaa ko aakh sunaae ||
verses.translation: What are these poor beings and creatures? What can they speak and say?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aape dhe vaddiaaiee aape sev karaae ||2||
verses.translation: God Himself grants glory to the Gurmukhs; He joins them to His Service. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh kuTa(n)b moh lobhaanaa chaladhiaa naal na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Beholding your family, you are lured away by emotional attachment, but when you leave, they will not go with you.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev gun nidhaan paiaa tis kee keem na paiee ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, I have found the Treasure of Excellence. Its value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prabh sakhaa har jeeau meraa a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord God is my Best Friend. In the end, He shall be my Companion and Support. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai jagajeevan dhaataa manmukh pat gavaiee ||
verses.translation: In this world of my father's home, the Great Giver is the Life of the World. The self-willed manmukhs have lost their honor.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur ko mag na jaanai a(n)dhe Thaur na kaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one knows the Way. The blind find no place of rest.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har sukhadhaataa man nahee vasiaa a(n)t giaa pachhutaiee ||4||
verses.translation: If the Lord, the Giver of Peace, does not dwell within the mind, then they shall depart with regret in the end. ||4||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai jagajeevan dhaataa gurmat ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: In this world of my father's house, through the Guru's Teachings, I have cultivated within my mind the Great Giver, the Life of the World.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kareh dhin raatee haumai moh chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, performing devotional worship, day and night, ego and emotional attachment are removed.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jis siau raataa taiso hovai sache sach samaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: And then, attuned to Him, we become like Him, truly absorbed in the True One. ||5||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape nadhar kare bhaau laae gur sabadhee beechaar ||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He gives us His Love, and we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai sahaj uoopajai haumai tirasanaa maar ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, intuitive peace wells up, and ego and desire die.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har gunadhaataa sadh man vasai sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||6||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Giver of Virtue, dwells forever within the minds of those who keep Truth enshrined within their hearts. ||6||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh meraa sadhaa niramalaa man niramal paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: My God is forever Immaculate and Pure; with a pure mind, He can be found.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan har man vasai haumai dhukh sabh jai ||
verses.translation: If the Treasure of the Name of the Lord abides within the mind, egotism and pain are totally eliminated.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur sabadh sunaiaa hau sadh balihaarai jaau ||7||
verses.translation: The True Guru has instructed me in the Word of the Shabad. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanai man chit kahai kahaae bin gur aap na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Within your own conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness and conceit are not eradicated.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau bhagat vachhal sukhadhaataa kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaiee ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is the Lover of His devotees, the Giver of Peace. By His Grace, He abides within the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak sobhaa surat dhei prabh aape gurmukh dhe vaddiaaiee ||8||1||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God blesses us with the sublime awakening of consciousness; He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh. ||8||1||18||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਮਡੰਡੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai karam kamaavadhe jamadda(n)dd lagai tin aai ||
verses.translation: Those who go around acting in egotism are struck down by the Messenger of Death with his club.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: j satigur sevan se ubare har setee liv lai ||1||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are uplifted and saved, in love with the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re gurmukh naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhur poorab karatai likhiaa tinaa gurmat naam samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who are so pre-destined by the Creator are absorbed into the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vin satigur parateet na aaviee naam na laago bhaau ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, faith does not come, and love for the Naam is not embraced.

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਸਵੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: supanai sukh na paaviee dhukh meh savai samai ||2||
verses.translation: Even in dreams, they find no peace; they sleep immersed in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je har har keechai bahut locheeaai kirat na meTiaa jai ||
verses.translation: Even if you chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with great longing, your past actions are still not erased.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਦਰਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kaa bhaanaa bhagatee ma(n)niaa se bhagat pe dhar thai ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees surrender to His Will; those devotees are accepted at His Door. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਿੜਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh dhiRaavai ra(n)g siau bin kirapaa liaa na jai ||
verses.translation: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Word of His Shabad within me. Without His Grace, it cannot be attained.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨੀਰੀਐ ਭੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: je sau a(n)mrit neereeaai bhee bikh fal laagai dhai ||4||
verses.translation: Even if the poisonous plant is watered with ambrosial nectar a hundred times, it will still bear poisonous fruit. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: se jan sache niramale jin satigur naal piaar ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who are in love with the True Guru are pure and true.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa bhaanaa kamaavadhe bikh haumai taj vikaar ||5||
verses.translation: They act in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; they shed the poison of ego and corruption. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh kitai upai na chhooTeeaai simirat saasatr sodhahu jai ||
verses.translation: Acting in stubborn-mindedness, no one is saved; go and study the Simritees and the Shaastras.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)gat saadhoo ubare gur kaa sabadh kamai ||6||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and practicing the Shabads of the Guru, you shall be saved. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam nidhaan hai jis a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Treasure, which has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਈ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh seiee sohadhe jin kirapaa kare karataar ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are beauteous; the Creator has blessed them with His Mercy. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaataa ek hai dhoojaa aaur na koi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is the Giver; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee paieeaai karam paraapat hoi ||8||2||19||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He is obtained. By His Mercy, He is found. ||8||2||19||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)khee birakh suhaavaRaa sach chugai gur bhai ||
verses.translation: The soul-bird in the beautiful tree of the body pecks at Truth, with love for the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ras peevai sahaj rahai uddai na aavai jai ||
verses.translation: She drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and abides in intuitive ease; she does not fly around coming and going.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vaasaa paiaa har har naam samai ||1||
verses.translation: She obtains her home within her own heart; she is absorbed into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re gur kee kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: O mind, work to serve the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhaanai je chaleh taa anadhin raacheh har nai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you walk in harmony with the Guru's Will, you shall remain immersed in the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਊਡਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)khee birakh suhaavaRe uooddeh chahu dhis jaeh ||
verses.translation: The birds in the beautiful trees fly around in all four directions.

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਊਡਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਤੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa uooddeh dhukh ghane nit dhaajheh tai bilalaeh ||
verses.translation: The more they fly around, the more they suffer; they burn and cry out in pain.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin gur mahal na jaapiee naa a(n)mirat fal paeh ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and they do not obtain the Ambrosial Fruit. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh braham hareeaavalaa saachai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is like God's tree, always green, blessed with the Sublime Love of the True One, with intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saakhaa teen nivaareeaa ek sabadh liv lai ||
verses.translation: He cuts off the three branches of the three qualities, and embraces love for the One Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat fal har ek hai aape dhei khavai ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord alone is the Ambrosial Fruit; He Himself gives it to us to eat. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਊਭੇ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh uoobhe suk ge naa fal ti(n)naa chhaau ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs stand there and dry up; they do not bear any fruit, and they do not provide any shade.

verses.original: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਸੀਐ ਓਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਗਿਰਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ti(n)naa paas na baiseeaai onaa ghar na giraau ||
verses.translation: Don't even bother to sit near them-they have no home or village.

verses.original: ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kaTe'eeh tai nit jaale'eeh onaa sabadh na naau ||4||
verses.translation: They are cut down and burnt each day; they have neither the Shabad, nor the Lord's Name. ||4||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hukame karam kamaavane piaai kirat firaau ||
verses.translation: According to the Lord's Command, people perform their actions; they wander around, driven by the karma of their past actions.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hukame dharasan dhekhanaa jeh bhejeh teh jaau ||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Command, they behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Wherever He sends them, there they go.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: hukame har har man vasai hukame sach samaau ||5||
verses.translation: By His Command, the Lord, Har, Har, abides within our minds; by His Command we merge in Truth. ||5||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hukam na jaaneh bapuRe bhoole fireh gavaar ||
verses.translation: The wretched fools do not know the Lord's Will; they wander around making mistakes.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh karam kamaavadhe nit nit hoh khuaar ||
verses.translation: They go about their business stubborn-mindedly; they are disgraced forever and ever.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar saa(n)t na aaviee naa sach lagai piaar ||6||
verses.translation: Inner peace does not come to them; they do not embrace love for the True Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukheeaa muh sohane gur kai het piaar ||
verses.translation: Beautiful are the faces of the Gurmukhs, who bear love and affection for the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: sachee bhagatee sach rate dhar sachai sachiaar ||
verses.translation: Through true devotional worship, they are attuned to Truth; at the True Door, they are found to be true.

verses.original: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aae se paravaan hai sabh kul kaa kareh udhaar ||7||
verses.translation: Blessed is their coming into being; they redeem all their ancestors. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh nadharee karam kamaavadhe nadharee baahar na koi ||
verses.translation: All do their deeds under the Lord's Glance of Grace; no one is beyond His Vision.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee nadhar kar dhekhai sachaa taisaa hee ko hoi ||
verses.translation: According to the Glance of Grace with which the True Lord beholds us, so do we become.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vaddaieeaa karam paraapat hoi ||8||3||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Glorious Greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received only by His Mercy. ||8||3||20||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai manmukh boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa mukh uoojale har vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: The faces of the Gurmukhs are always radiant; the Lord has come to dwell within their minds.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahaje hee sukh paieeaai sahaje rahai samai ||1||
verses.translation: Through intuitive understanding they are at peace, and through intuitive understanding they remain absorbed in the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re dhaasan dhaasaa hoi ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, be the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa gur bhagat hai viralaa paae koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Service to the Guru is worship of the Guru. How rare are those who obtain it! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa suhaag suhaaganee je chaleh satigur bhai ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-bride is always with her Husband Lord, if she walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa pir nihachal paieeaai naa oh marai na jai ||
verses.translation: She attains her Eternal, Ever-stable Husband, who never dies or goes away.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabadh milee naa veechhuRai pir kai a(n)k samai ||2||
verses.translation: United with the Word of the Shabad, she shall not be separated again. She is immersed in the Lap of her Beloved. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har niramal at uoojalaa bin gur paiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is Immaculate and Radiantly Bright; without the Guru, He cannot be found.

verses.original: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paaTh paRai naa boojhiee bhekhee bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: He cannot be understood by reading scriptures; the deceitful pretenders are deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmatee har sadhaa paiaa rasanaa har ras samai ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is always found, and the tongue is permeated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh chukaiaa gurmatee sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is shed with intuitive ease, through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai jag dhukheeaa firai manmukhaa no giee khai ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, the world wanders lost in pain. The self-willed manmukh is consumed.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabadhe naam dhiaaieeaai sabadhe sach samai ||4||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, meditate on the Naam; through the Shabad, you shall merge in Truth. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa bhoole sidh fireh samaadh na lagai subhai ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas wander around, deluded by Maya; they are not absorbed in the Samaadhi of the Lord's Sublime Love.

verses.original: ਤੀਨੇ ਲੋਅ ਵਿਆਪਤ ਹੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: teene loa viaapat hai adhik rahee lapaTai ||
verses.translation: The three worlds are permeated by Maya; they are totally covered by it.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin gur mukat na paieeaai naa dhubidhaa maiaa jai ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, liberation is not attained, and the double-mindedness of Maya does not go away. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa kis no aakheeaai kiaa maiaa karam kamai ||
verses.translation: What is called Maya? What does Maya do?

verses.original: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh eh jeeau badh hai haumai karam kamai ||
verses.translation: These beings are bound by pleasure and pain; they do their deeds in egotism.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਨਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai bharam na chookiee naa vichahu haumai jai ||6||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, doubt is not dispelled, and egotism is not eliminated from within. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin preetee bhagat na hoviee bin sabadhai thai na pai ||
verses.translation: Without love, there is no devotional worship. Without the Shabad, no one finds acceptance.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe haumai maareeaai maiaa kaa bhram jai ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, egotism is conquered and subdued, and the illusion of Maya is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath paieeaai gurmukh sahaj subhai ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease. ||7||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur gun na jaapanee bin gun bhagat na hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, one's virtues do not shine forth; without virtue, there is no devotional worship.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal har man vasiaa sahaj miliaa prabh soi ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He abides within their minds. They meet that God with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadhe har saalaaheeaai karam paraapat hoi ||8||4||21||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Shabad, praise the Lord. By His Grace, He is obtained. ||8||4||21||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh merai prabh keenaa aape bharam bhulaae ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is created by my God; He Himself misleads us through illusion and doubt.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh karam kareh nahee boojheh birathaa janam gavaae ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs perform their actions, but they do not understand; they waste away their lives in vain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee is jag meh chaanan karam vasai man aae ||1||
verses.translation: Gurbani is the Light to illuminate this world; by His Grace, it comes to abide within the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re naam japahu sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and find peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa saalaaheeaai sahaj milai prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Praising the Perfect Guru, you shall easily meet with that God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bharam giaa bhau bhaagiaa har charanee chit lai ||
verses.translation: Doubt departs, and fear runs away, when you focus your consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabadh kamaieeaai har vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh practices the Shabad, and the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghar mahal sach samaieeaai jamakaal na sakai khai ||2||
verses.translation: In the mansion of the home within the self, we merge in Truth, and the Messenger of Death cannot devour us. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਬਾ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਜੋੁਲਾਹਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naamaa chheebaa kabeer juolaahaa poore gur te gat paiee ||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv the printer, and Kabeer the weaver, obtained salvation through the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: braham ke bete sabadh pachhaaneh haumai jaat gavaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who know God and recognize His Shabad lose their ego and class consciousness.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sur nar tin kee baanee gaaveh koi na meTai bhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Their Banis are sung by the angelic beings, and no one can erase them, O Siblings of Destiny! ||3||

verses.original: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhait put karam dharam kichh sa(n)jam na paRai dhoojaa bhaau na jaanai ||
verses.translation: The demon's son Prahlaad had not read about religious rituals or ceremonies, austerity or self-discipline; he did not know the love of duality.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTiaai niramal hoaa anadhin naam vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Upon meeting with the True Guru, he became pure; night and day, he chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਪੜੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eko paRai eko naau boojhai dhoojaa avar na jaanai ||4||
verses.translation: He read only of the One and he understood only the One Name; he knew no other at all. ||4||

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: khaT dharasan jogee sa(n)niaasee bin gur bharam bhulaae ||
verses.translation: The followers of the six different life-styles and world-views, the Yogis and the Sanyaasees have gone astray in doubt without the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh taa gat mit paaveh har jeeau ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: If they serve the True Guru, they find the state of salvation; they enshrine the Dear Lord within their minds.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee siau chit laagai aavan jaan rahaae ||5||
verses.translation: They focus their consciousness on the True Bani, and their comings and goings in reincarnation are over. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paR paR vaadh vakhaaneh bin gur bharam bhulaae ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and argue and stir up controversies, but without the Guru, they are deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh fer piaa bin sabadhai mukat na paae ||
verses.translation: They wander around the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations; without the Shabad, they do not attain liberation.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਨਾਉ ਚੇਤੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jaa naau chetai taa gat paae jaa satigur mel milaae ||6||
verses.translation: But when they remember the Name, then they attain the state of salvation, when the True Guru unites them in Union. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat meh naam har upajai jaa satigur milai subhaae ||
verses.translation: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Name of the Lord wells up, when the True Guru unites us in His Sublime Love.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ਚਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arapee aap gavaiee chalaa satigur bhaae ||
verses.translation: I offer my mind and body, and I renounce my selfishness and conceit; I walk in Harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sadh balihaaree gur apune viTahu j har setee chit laae ||7||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who has attached my consciousness to the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: so braahaman braham jo bi(n)dhe har setee ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows the Lord Brahma, and is attuned to the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh nikaT vasai sabhanaa ghaT a(n)tar gurmukh viralai jaataa ||
verses.translation: God is close at hand; He dwells deep within the hearts of all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, know Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee gur kai sabadh pachhaataa ||8||5||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||8||5||22||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਹਜੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahajai no sabh lochadhee bin gur paiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs to be centered and balanced, but without the Guru, no one can.

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR pa(n)ddit jotakee thake bhekhee bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: The Pandits and the astrologers read and read until they grow weary, while the fanatics are deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur bheTe sahaj paiaa aapanee kirapaa kare rajai ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, intuitive balance is obtained, when God, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re gur bin sahaj na hoi ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, intuitive balance is not obtained.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai hee te sahaj uoopajai har paiaa sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace and poise wells up, and that True Lord is obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje gaaviaa thai pavai bin sahajai kathanee baadh ||
verses.translation: That which is sung intuitively is acceptable; without this intuition, all chanting is useless.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje hee bhagat uoopajai sahaj piaar bairaag ||
verses.translation: In the state of intuitive balance, devotion wells up. In intuitive balance, love is balanced and detached.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahajai hee te sukh saat hoi bin sahajai jeevan baadh ||2||
verses.translation: In the state of intuitive balance, peace and tranquility are produced. Without intuitive balance, life is useless. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj saalaahee sadhaa sadhaa sahaj samaadh lagai ||
verses.translation: In the state of intuitive balance, praise the Lord forever and ever. With intuitive ease, embrace Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje hee gun uoocharai bhagat kare liv lai ||
verses.translation: In the state of intuitive balance, chant His Glories, lovingly absorbed in devotional worship.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabadhe hee har man vasai rasanaa har ras khai ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the Lord dwells within the mind, and the tongue tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਿਆ ਸਚ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje kaal viddaariaa sach saranaiee pai ||
verses.translation: In the poise of intuitive balance, death is destroyed, entering the Sanctuary of the True One.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje har naam man vasiaa sachee kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: Intuitively balanced, the Name of the Lord dwells within the mind, practicing the lifestyle of Truth.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee jinee paiaa sahaje rahe samai ||4||
verses.translation: Those who have found Him are very fortunate; they remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa vich sahaj na uoopajai maiaa dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: Within Maya, the poise of intuitive balance is not produced. Maya leads to the love of duality.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲੈ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh karam kamaavane haumai jalai jalai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs perform religious rituals, but they are burnt down by their selfishness and conceit.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran na chookiee fir fir aavai jai ||5||
verses.translation: Their births and deaths do not cease; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation. ||5||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tirahu gunaa vich sahaj na paieeaai trai gun bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: In the three qualities, intuitive balance is not obtained; the three qualities lead to delusion and doubt.

verses.original: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paReeaai guneeaai kiaa katheeaai jaa mu(n)ddahu ghuthaa jai ||
verses.translation: What is the point of reading, studying and debating, if one loses his roots?

verses.original: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: chauthe padh meh sahaj hai gurmukh palai pai ||6||
verses.translation: In the fourth state, there is intuitive balance; the Gurmukhs gather it in. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: niragun naam nidhaan hai sahaje sojhee hoi ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, is the treasure. Through intuitive balance, understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)tee saalaahiaa sache sachee soi ||
verses.translation: The virtuous praise the True One; their reputation is true.

verses.original: ਭੁਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bhuliaa sahaj milaisee sabadh milaavaa hoi ||7||
verses.translation: The wayward are united with God through intuitive balance; through the Shabad, union is obtained. ||7||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin sahajai sabh a(n)dh hai maiaa moh gubaar ||
verses.translation: Without intuitive balance, all are blind. Emotional attachment to Maya is utter darkness.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje hee sojhee piee sachai sabadh apaar ||
verses.translation: In intuitive balance, understanding of the True, Infinite Shabad is obtained.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aape bakhas milaian poore gur karataar ||8||
verses.translation: Granting forgiveness, the Perfect Guru unites us with the Creator. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje adhisaT pachhaaneeaai nirabhau jot nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: In intuitive balance, the Unseen is recognized-the Fearless, Luminous, Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa jotee jot milaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: There is only the One Giver of all beings. He blends our light with His Light.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: poorai sabadh salaaheeaai jis dhaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||9||
verses.translation: So praise God through the Perfect Word of His Shabad; He has no end or limitation. ||9||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaaneeaa kaa dhan naam hai sahaj kareh vaapaar ||
verses.translation: Those who are wise take the Naam as their wealth; with intuitive ease, they trade with Him.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin laahaa har naam lain akhuT bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they receive the Profit of the Lord's Name, which is an inexhaustible and over-flowing treasure.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੀਏ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੬॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak toT na aaviee dhe'ee dhevanahaar ||10||6||23||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Great Giver gives, nothing at all is lacking. ||10||6||23||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai fer na pavai janam maran dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall not have to go through the cycle of reincarnation again; the pains of birth and death will be taken away.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poorai sabadh sabh sojhee hoiee har naamai rahai samai ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, all understanding is obtained; remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere satigur siau chit lai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: niramal naam sadh navatano aap vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau raakhahu apunee saranaiee jiau raakheh tiau rahanaa ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please protect and preserve me in Your Sanctuary. As You keep me, so do I remain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh jeevat marai gurmukh bhavajal taranaa ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh remains dead while yet alive, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag naau paieeaai gurmat sabadh suhaiee ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the Name is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, through the Shabad, you shall be exalted.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape man vasiaa prabh karataa sahaje rahiaa samaiee ||3||
verses.translation: God, the Creator Himself, dwells within the mind; remain absorbed in the state of intuitive balance. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa manmukh sabadh na bhaavai ba(n)dhan ba(n)dh bhavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Some are self-willed manmukhs; they do not love the Word of the Shabad. Bound in chains, they wander lost in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh fir fir aavai birathaa janam gavaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Through 8.4 million lifetimes, they wander over and over again; they waste away their lives in vain. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa man aana(n)dh hai sachai sabadh ra(n)g raate ||
verses.translation: In the minds of the devotees there is bliss; they are attuned to the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਤੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: anadhin gun gaaveh sadh niramal sahaje naam samaate ||5||
verses.translation: Night and day, they constantly sing the Glories of the Immaculate Lord; with intuitive ease, they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਭ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)mirat baanee boleh sabh aatam raam pachhaanee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs speak the Ambrosial Bani; they recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eko sevan ek araadheh gurmukh akath kahaanee ||6||
verses.translation: They serve the One; they worship and adore the One. The Gurmukhs speak the Unspoken Speech. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib seveeaai gurmukh vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs serve their True Lord and Master, who comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ra(n)g raate sach siau apunee kirapaa kare milai ||7||
verses.translation: They are forever attuned to the Love of the True One, who bestows His Mercy and unites them with Himself. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae aape ikanaa sutiaa dhei jagai ||
verses.translation: He Himself does, and He Himself causes others to do; He wakes some from their sleep.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: aape mel milaidhaa naanak sabadh samai ||8||7||24||
verses.translation: He Himself unites us in Union; Nanak is absorbed in the Shabad. ||8||7||24||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai man niramalaa bhe pavit sareer ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man aana(n)dh sadhaa sukh paiaa bheTiaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
verses.translation: The mind obtains bliss and eternal peace, meeting with the Deep and Profound Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachee sa(n)gat baisanaa sach naam man dheer ||1||
verses.translation: Sitting in the Sangat, the True Congregation, the mind is comforted and consoled by the True Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: man re satigur sev nisa(n)g ||
verses.translation: O mind, serve the True Guru without hesitation.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai har man vasai lagai na mail pata(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Lord abides within the mind, and no trace of filth shall attach itself to you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh pat uoopajai sache sachaa naau ||
verses.translation: From the True Word of the Shabad comes honor. True is the Name of the True One.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jinee haumai maar pachhaaniaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who conquer their ego and recognize the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: manmukh sach na jaananee tin Thaur na katahoo thaau ||2||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the True One; they find no shelter, and no place of rest anywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache hee vich vaas ||
verses.translation: Those who take the Truth as their food and the Truth as their clothing, have their home in the True One.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sachaa saalaahanaa sachai sabadh nivaas ||
verses.translation: They constantly praise the True One, and in the True Word of the Shabad they have their dwelling.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa gurmatee nij ghar vaas ||3||
verses.translation: They recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all, and through the Guru's Teachings they dwell in the home of their own inner self. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach vekhan sach bolanaa tan man sachaa hoi ||
verses.translation: They see the Truth, and they speak the Truth; their bodies and minds are True.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachee saakhee upadhes sach sache sachee soi ||
verses.translation: True are their teachings, and True are their instructions; True are the reputations of the true ones.

verses.original: ਜਿੰਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ji(n)nee sach visaariaa se dhukhe'ee chale roi ||4||
verses.translation: Those who have forgotten the True One are miserable-they depart weeping and wailing. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jinee na sevio se kit aae sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Those who have not served the True Guru-why did they even bother to come into the world?

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jam dhar badhe maare'eh kook na sunai pookaar ||
verses.translation: They are bound and gagged and beaten at Death's door, but no one hears their shrieks and cries.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: birathaa janam gavaiaa mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||5||
verses.translation: They waste their lives uselessly; they die and are reincarnated over and over again. ||5||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eh jag jalataa dhekh kai bhaj pe satigur saranaa ||
verses.translation: Seeing this world on fire, I rushed to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sach dhiRaiaa sadhaa sach sa(n)jam rahanaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has implanted the Truth within me; I dwell steadfastly in Truth and self-restraint.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: satigur sachaa hai bohithaa sabadhe bhavajal taranaa ||6||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Boat of Truth; in the Word of the Shabad, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh firadhe rahe bin satigur mukat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: People continue wandering through the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations; without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR pa(n)ddit monee thake dhoojai bhai pat khoiee ||
verses.translation: Reading and studying, the Pandits and the silent sages have grown weary, but attached to the love of duality, they have lost their honor.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur sabadh sunaiaa bin sache avar na koiee ||7||
verses.translation: The True Guru teaches the Word of the Shabad; without the True One, there is no other at all. ||7||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo sachai laae se sach lage nit sachee kaar kara(n)n ||
verses.translation: Those who are linked by the True One are linked to Truth. They always act in Truth.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: tinaa nij ghar vaasaa paiaa sachai mahal raha(n)n ||
verses.translation: They attain their dwelling in the home of their own inner being, and they abide in the Mansion of Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੮॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagat sukhe'ee sadhaa sachai naam racha(n)n ||8||17||8||25||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the True Name. ||8||17||8||25||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਣੈ ਢੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau musakal at banai ddoiee koi na dhei ||
verses.translation: When you are confronted with terrible hardships, and no one offers you any support,

verses.original: ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਸਮਨਾ ਸਾਕ ਭਿ ਭਜਿ ਖਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: laagoo hoe dhusamanaa saak bh bhaj khale ||
verses.translation: when your friends turn into enemies, and even your relatives have deserted you,

verses.original: ਸਭੋ ਭਜੈ ਆਸਰਾ ਚੁਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabho bhajai aasaraa chukai sabh asaraau ||
verses.translation: and when all support has given way, and all hope has been lost

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chit aavai os paarabraham lagai na tatee vaau ||1||
verses.translation: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, even the hot wind shall not touch you. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahib nitaaniaa kaa taan ||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master is the Power of the powerless.

verses.original: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aai na jaiee thir sadhaa gur sabadhee sach jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He does not come or go; He is Eternal and Permanent. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known as True. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੁਬਲਾ ਨੰਗ ਭੁਖ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: je ko hovai dhubalaa na(n)g bhukh kee peer ||
verses.translation: If you are weakened by the pains of hunger and poverty,

verses.original: ਦਮੜਾ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhamaRaa palai naa pavai naa ko dhevai dheer ||
verses.translation: with no money in your pockets, and no one will give you any comfort,

verses.original: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: suaarath suaau na ko kare naa kichh hovai kaaj ||
verses.translation: and no one will satisfy your hopes and desires, and none of your works is accomplished

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nihachal hovai raaj ||2||
verses.translation: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall obtain the eternal kingdom. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau chi(n)taa bahut bahut dhehee viaapai rog ||
verses.translation: When you are plagued by great and excessive anxiety, and diseases of the body;

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬਿ ਪਲੇਟਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: girasat kuTa(n)b paleTiaa kadhe harakh kadhe sog ||
verses.translation: when you are wrapped up in the attachments of household and family, sometimes feeling joy, and then other times sorrow;

verses.original: ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gaun kare chahu ku(n)T kaa ghaRee na baisan soi ||
verses.translation: when you are wandering around in all four directions, and you cannot sit or sleep even for a moment

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chit aavai os paarabraham tan man seetal hoi ||3||
verses.translation: -if you come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then your body and mind shall be cooled and soothed. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਲੋਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh moh vas keeaa kirapan lobh piaar ||
verses.translation: When you are under the power of sexual desire, anger and worldly attachment, or a greedy miser in love with your wealth;

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਨਿ ਅਘ ਕੀਏ ਹੋਆ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaare kilavikh un agh ke'ee hoaa asur sa(n)ghaar ||
verses.translation: if you have committed the four great sins and other mistakes; even if you are a murderous fiend

verses.original: ਪੋਥੀ ਗੀਤ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਰਨਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pothee geet kavit kichh kadhe na karan dhariaa ||
verses.translation: who has never taken the time to listen to sacred books, hymns and poetry

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nimakh simarat tariaa ||4||
verses.translation: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, and contemplate Him, even for a moment, you shall be saved. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਖਾਗਰ ਬਿਚਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saasat si(n)mirat bedh chaar mukhaagar bichare ||
verses.translation: People may recite by heart the Shaastras, the Simritees and the four Vedas;

verses.original: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tape tapeesar jogeeaa teerath gavan kare ||
verses.translation: they may be ascetics, great, self-disciplined Yogis; they may visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khaT karamaa te dhugune poojaa karataa nai ||
verses.translation: and perform the six ceremonial rituals, over and over again, performing worship services and ritual bathings.

verses.original: ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾ ਸਰਪਰ ਨਰਕੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g na lagee paarabraham taa sarapar narake jai ||5||
verses.translation: Even so, if they have not embraced love for the Supreme Lord God, then they shall surely go to hell. ||5||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: raaj milak sikadhaareeaa ras bhogan bisathaar ||
verses.translation: You may possess empires, vast estates, authority over others, and the enjoyment of myriads of pleasures;

verses.original: ਬਾਗ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: baag suhaave sohane chalai hukam afaar ||
verses.translation: you may have delightful and beautiful gardens, and issue unquestioned commands;

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਚਾਇ ਲਗਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g tamaase bahu bidhee chai lag rahiaa ||
verses.translation: you may have enjoyments and entertainments of all sorts and kinds, and continue to enjoy exciting pleasures

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਸਰਪ ਕੀ ਜੂਨਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: chit na aaio paarabraham taa sarap kee joon giaa ||6||
verses.translation: -and yet, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall be reincarnated as a snake. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਧਨਾਢਿ ਅਚਾਰਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bahut dhanaadd achaarava(n)t sobhaa niramal reet ||
verses.translation: You may possess vast riches, maintain virtuous conduct, have a spotless reputation and observe religious customs;

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈਆ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut bhaieeaa saajan sa(n)g pareet ||
verses.translation: you may have the loving affections of mother, father, children, siblings and friends;

verses.original: ਲਸਕਰ ਤਰਕਸਬੰਦ ਬੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਕੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: lasakar tarakasaba(n)dh ba(n)dh jeeau jeeau sagalee keet ||
verses.translation: you may have armies well-equipped with weapons, and all may salute you with respect;

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਖੜਿ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਦੀਤ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: chit na aaio paarabraham taa khaR rasaatal dheet ||7||
verses.translation: But still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then you shall be taken and consigned to the most hideous hell! ||7||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾੜਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa rog na chhidhr kichh naa kichh kaaRaa sog ||
verses.translation: You may have a body free of disease and deformity, and have no worries or grief at all;

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: mrit na aavee chit tis ahinis bhogai bhog ||
verses.translation: you may be unmindful of death, and night and day revel in pleasures;

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜੀਇ ਨ ਸੰਕ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh keeton aapanaa jeei na sa(n)k dhariaa ||
verses.translation: you may take everything as your own, and have no fear in your mind at all;

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਵਸਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: chit na aaio paarabraham jamaka(n)kar vas pariaa ||8||
verses.translation: but still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||8||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare jis paarabraham hovai saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord showers His Mercy, and we find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਓਹੁ ਵਧਾਈਐ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau oh vadhaieeaai tiau tiau har siau ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The more time we spend there, the more we come to love the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhuhaa siriaa kaa khasam aap avar na dhoojaa thaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Master of both worlds; there is no other place of rest.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੯॥੧॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: satigur tuThai paiaa naanak sachaa naau ||9||1||26||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is pleased and satisfied, O Nanak, the True Name is obtained. ||9||1||26||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ghar panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House:

verses.original: ਜਾਨਉ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਵਨ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaanau nahee bhaavai kavan baataa ||
verses.translation: I do not know what pleases my Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਖੋਜਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man khoj maarag ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O mind, seek out the way! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaanee dhiaan laaveh ||
verses.translation: The meditatives practice meditation,

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee giaan kamaaveh ||
verses.translation: and the wise practice spiritual wisdom,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh kin hee jaataa ||1||
verses.translation: but how rare are those who know God! ||1||

verses.original: ਭਗਉਤੀ ਰਹਤ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagautee rahat jugataa ||
verses.translation: The worshipper of Bhagaauti practices self-discipline,

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jogee kahat mukataa ||
verses.translation: the Yogi speaks of liberation,

verses.original: ਤਪਸੀ ਤਪਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tapasee tapeh raataa ||2||
verses.translation: and the ascetic is absorbed in asceticism. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੋਨੀ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: monee monidhaaree ||
verses.translation: The men of silence observe silence,

verses.original: ਸਨਿਆਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saniaasee brahamachaaree ||
verses.translation: the Sanyaasees observe celibacy,

verses.original: ਉਦਾਸੀ ਉਦਾਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: audhaasee udhaas raataa ||3||
verses.translation: and the Udaasees abide in detachment. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਵੈ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat navai parakaaraa ||
verses.translation: There are nine forms of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਵੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit vedh pukaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Pandits recite the Vedas.

verses.original: ਗਿਰਸਤੀ ਗਿਰਸਤਿ ਧਰਮਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: girasatee girasat dharamaataa ||4||
verses.translation: The householders assert their faith in family life. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਸਬਦੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਵਧੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik sabadhee bahu roop avadhootaa ||
verses.translation: Those who utter only One Word, those who take many forms, the naked renunciates,

verses.original: ਕਾਪੜੀ ਕਉਤੇ ਜਾਗੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaapaRee kaute jaagootaa ||
verses.translation: the wearers of patched coats, the magicians, those who remain always awake,

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: eik teerath naataa ||5||
verses.translation: and those who bathe at holy places of pilgrimage-||5||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਹਾਰ ਵਰਤੀ ਆਪਰਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: nirahaar varatee aaparasaa ||
verses.translation: Those who go without food, those who never touch others,

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਲੂਕਿ ਨ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਦਰਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik look na dheveh dharasaa ||
verses.translation: the hermits who never show themselves,

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eik man hee giaataa ||6||
verses.translation: and those who are wise in their own minds-||6||

verses.original: ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghaaT na kin hee kahaiaa ||
verses.translation: Of these, no one admits to any deficiency;

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਹਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kahate hai paiaa ||
verses.translation: all say that they have found the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis mele so bhagataa ||7||
verses.translation: But he alone is a devotee, whom the Lord has united with Himself. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਉਕਤਿ ਉਪਾਵਾ ॥ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal ukat upaavaa || tiaagee saran paavaa ||
verses.translation: Abandoning all devices and contrivances, I have sought His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੨॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak gur charan paraataa ||8||2||27||
verses.translation: Nanak has fallen at the Feet of the Guru. ||8||2||27||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jogee a(n)dhar jogeeaa ||
verses.translation: Among Yogis, You are the Yogi;

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਭੋਗੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੋਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) bhogee a(n)dhar bhogeeaa ||
verses.translation: among pleasure seekers, You are the Pleasure Seeker.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਮਛਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teraa a(n)t na paiaa surag machh piaal jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Your limits are not known to any of the beings in the heavens, in this world, or in the nether regions of the underworld. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree hau vaaranai kurabaan tere naav no ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh sa(n)saar upaiaa ||
verses.translation: You created the world,

verses.original: ਸਿਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sire sir dha(n)dhe laiaa ||
verses.translation: and assigned tasks to one and all.

verses.original: ਵੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vekheh keetaa aapanaa kar kudharat paasaa ddaal jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: You watch over Your Creation, and through Your All-powerful Creative Potency, You cast the dice. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਰਗਟਿ ਪਾਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਪਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: paragaT paahaarai jaapadhaa ||
verses.translation: You are manifest in the Expanse of Your Workshop.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh naavai no parataapadhaa ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs for Your Name,

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur baajh na paio sabh mohee maiaa jaal jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: but without the Guru, no one finds You. All are enticed and trapped by Maya. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kau bal jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jit miliaai param gat paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Meeting Him, the supreme status is obtained.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sur nar mun jan lochadhe so satigur dheeaa bujhai jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: The angelic beings and the silent sages long for Him; the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat kaisee jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: How is the Society of the Saints to be known?

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jithai eko naam vakhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: There, the Name of the One Lord is chanted.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: eko naam hukam hai naanak satigur dheeaa bujhai jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: The One Name is the Lord's Command; O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih jagat bharam bhulaiaa ||
verses.translation: This world has been deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਆਪਹੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapahu tudh khuaaiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself, Lord, have led it astray.

verses.original: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਗ ਜਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: parataap lagaa dhohaaganee bhaag jinaa ke naeh jeeau ||6||
verses.translation: The discarded soul-brides suffer in terrible agony; they have no luck at all. ||6||

verses.original: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhohaaganee kiaa neesaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: What are the signs of the discarded brides?

verses.original: ਖਸਮਹੁ ਘੁਥੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: khasamahu ghutheeaa fireh nimaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: They miss their Husband Lord, and they wander around in dishonor.

verses.original: ਮੈਲੇ ਵੇਸ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: maile ves tinaa kaamanee dhukhee rain vihai jeeau ||7||
verses.translation: The clothes of those brides are filthy-they pass their life-night in agony. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sohaaganee kiaa karam kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: What actions have the happy soul-brides performed?

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: They have obtained the fruit of their pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare kai aapanee aape le milai jeeau ||8||
verses.translation: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord unites them with Himself. ||8||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਨੋ ਮਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hukam jinaa no manaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those, whom God causes to abide by His Will,

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin a(n)tar sabadh vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: have the Shabad of His Word abiding deep within.

verses.original: ਸਹੀਆ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: saheeaa se sohaaganee jin seh naal piaar jeeau ||9||
verses.translation: They are the true soul-brides, who embrace love for their Husband Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa bhaane kaa ras aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who take pleasure in God's Will

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin vichahu bharam chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: remove doubt from within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur aaisaa jaaneeaai jo sabhasai le milai jeeau ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, know Him as the True Guru, who unites all with the Lord. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, they receive the fruits of their destiny,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਅਹਕਰਣੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin vichahu ahakaran chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: and egotism is driven out from within.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਭਾਗੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: dhuramat kaa dhukh kaTiaa bhaag baiThaa masatak aai jeeau ||11||
verses.translation: The pain of evil-mindedness is eliminated; good fortune comes and shines radiantly from their foreheads. ||11||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit teree baaneeaa ||
verses.translation: The Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: teriaa bhagataa ridhai samaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: It permeates the hearts of Your devotees.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿਐ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sukh sevaa a(n)dhar rakhiaai aapanee nadhar kareh nisataar jeeau ||12||
verses.translation: Serving You, peace is obtained; granting Your Mercy, You bestow salvation. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaa jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, one comes to know;

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jit miliaai naam vakhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: by this meeting, one comes to chant the Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਥਕੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: satigur baajh na paio sabh thakee karam kamai jeeau ||13||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, God is not found; all have grown weary of performing religious rituals. ||13||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau satigur viTahu ghumaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru;

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin bhram bhulaa maarag paiaa ||
verses.translation: I was wandering in doubt, and He has set me on the right path.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare je aapanee aape le ralai jeeau ||14||
verses.translation: If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He unites us with Himself. ||14||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sabhanaa maeh samaiaa ||
verses.translation: You, Lord, are pervading in all,

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin karatai aap lukaiaa ||
verses.translation: and yet, the Creator keeps Himself concealed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh paragaT hoiaa jaa kau jot dharee karataar jeeau ||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Creator is revealed to the Gurmukh, within whom He has infused His Light. ||15||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਖਸਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape khasam nivaajiaa ||
verses.translation: The Master Himself bestows honor.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd dhe saajiaa ||
verses.translation: He creates and bestows body and soul.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀਆ ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: aapane sevak kee paij rakheeaa dhui kar masatak dhaar jeeau ||16||
verses.translation: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He places both His Hands upon their foreheads. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sa(n)jam rahe siaanapaa ||
verses.translation: All strict rituals are just clever contrivances.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh sabh kichh jaanadhaa ||
verses.translation: My God knows everything.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: pragaT prataap varataio sabh lok karai jaikaar jeeau ||17||
verses.translation: He has made His Glory manifest, and all people celebrate Him. ||17 |

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਨ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mere gun avagan na beechaariaa ||
verses.translation: He has not considered my merits and demerits;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apanaa biradh samaariaa ||
verses.translation: this is God's Own Nature.

verses.original: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th lai kai rakhion lagai na tatee vaau jeeau ||18||
verses.translation: Hugging me close in His Embrace, He protects me, and now, even the hot wind does not touch me. ||18||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan prabhoo dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Within my mind and body, I meditate on God.

verses.original: ਜੀਇ ਇਛਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeei ichhiaRaa fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my soul's desire.
