verses.original: ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: saeh paatisaeh sir khasam too(n) jap naanak jeevai naau jeeau ||19||
verses.translation: You are the Supreme Lord and Master, above the heads of kings. Nanak lives by chanting Your Name. ||19||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape aap upaiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the Universe;

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa khel kar dhikhalaiaa ||
verses.translation: You created the play of duality, and staged it.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: sabh sacho sach varatadhaa jis bhaavai tisai bujhai jeeau ||20||
verses.translation: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; He instructs those with whom He is pleased. ||20||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee paiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have found God.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tithai maiaa moh chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, I have shed emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kar kai aapanee aape le samai jeeau ||21||
verses.translation: Showering His Mercy, He has blended me into Himself. ||21||

verses.original: ਗੋਪੀ ਨੈ ਗੋਆਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gopee nai goaaleeaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Gopis, the milk-maids of Krishna; You are the sacred river Jamunaa; You are Krishna, the herdsman.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape goi uThaaleeaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself support the world.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: hukamee bhaa(n)dde saajiaa too(n) aape bha(n)n savaar jeeau ||22||
verses.translation: By Your Command, human beings are fashioned. You Yourself embellish them, and then again destroy them. ||22||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin satigur siau chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have focused their consciousness on the True Guru

verses.original: ਤਿਨੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tinee dhoojaa bhaau chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: have rid themselves of the love of duality.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ ਓਇ ਚਲੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: niramal jot tin praaneeaa oi chale janam savaar jeeau ||23||
verses.translation: The light of those mortal beings is immaculate. They depart after redeeming their lives. ||23||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥ ਮੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ॥
verses.translit: tereeaa sadhaa sadhaa cha(n)giaaieeaa || mai raat dhihai vaddiaaieeaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, night and day, I praise the Greatness of Your Goodness.

verses.original: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: anama(n)giaa dhaan dhevanaa kahu naanak sach samaal jeeau ||24||1||
verses.translation: You bestow Your Gifts, even if we do not ask for them. Says Nanak, contemplate the True Lord. ||24||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੈ ਪਾਇ ਮਨਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: pai pai manaiee soi jeeau ||
verses.translation: I fall at His Feet to please and appease Him.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh milaiaa tis jevadd avar na koi jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has united me with the Lord, the Primal Being. There is no other as great as He. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੋਸਾਈ ਮਿਹੰਡਾ ਇਠੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: gosaiee miha(n)ddaa iThaRaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is my Sweet Beloved.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ ਅਬੇ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਠੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)m abe thaavahu miThaRaa ||
verses.translation: He is sweeter than my mother or father.

verses.original: ਭੈਣ ਭਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhain bhaiee sabh sajanaa tudh jehaa naahee koi jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Among all sisters and brothers and friends, there is no one like You. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: terai hukame saavan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Your Command, the month of Saawan has come.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਹਲੁ ਜੋਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai sat kaa hal joaaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have hooked up the plow of Truth,

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜਣ ਲਗਾ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਬਖਸ ਜਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naau beejan lagaa aas kar har bohal bakhas jamai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: and I plant the seed of the Name in hopes that the Lord, in His Generosity, will bestow a bountiful harvest. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau gur mil ik pachhaanadhaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, I recognize only the One Lord.

verses.original: ਦੁਯਾ ਕਾਗਲੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhuyaa kaagal chit na jaanadhaa ||
verses.translation: In my consciousness, I do not know of any other account.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਂਵੈ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har ikatai kaarai laion jiau bhaavai ti(n)vai nibaeh jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord has assigned one task to me; as it pleases Him, I perform it. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਸੀ ਭੋਗਿਹੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: tusee bhogih bhu(n)chahu bhaieeho ||
verses.translation: Enjoy yourselves and eat, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਕਵਾਇ ਪੈਨਾਈਓ ॥
verses.translit: gur dheebaan kavai painaieeo ||
verses.translation: In the Guru's Court, He has blessed me with the Robe of Honor.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹੋਆ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਪਿੰਡ ਦਾ ਬੰਨਿ ਆਦੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਸਰੀਕ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: hau hoaa maahar pi(n)dd dhaa ba(n)n aadhe pa(n)j sareek jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: I have become the Master of my body-village; I have taken the five rivals as prisoners. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਮੑੈ ਤਿਹੰਡੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau aaiaa saam(h)ai tiha(n)ddeeaa ||
verses.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਪੰਜਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਮੁਜੇਰੇ ਮਿਹਡਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)j kirasaan mujere mihaddiaa ||
verses.translation: The five farm-hands have become my tenants;

verses.original: ਕੰਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਵੁਠਾ ਘੁਘਿ ਗਿਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ka(n)n koiee kadd na ha(n)ghiee naanak vuThaa ghugh giraau jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: none dare to raise their heads against me. O Nanak, my village is populous and prosperous. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਘੁੰਮਾ ਜਾਵਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree ghu(n)maa jaavadhaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik saahaa tudh dhiaaidhaa ||
verses.translation: I meditate on You continually.

verses.original: ਉਜੜੁ ਥੇਹੁ ਵਸਾਇਓ ਹਉ ਤੁਧ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aujaR theh vasaio hau tudh viTahu kurabaan jeeau ||6||
verses.translation: The village was in ruins, but You have re-populated it. I am a sacrifice to You. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਠੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: har iThai nit dhiaaidhaa ||
verses.translation: O Beloved Lord, I meditate on You continually;

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੀ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhee so fal paidhaa ||
verses.translation: I obtain the fruits of my mind's desires.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਲਾਹੀਅਨੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sabhe kaaj savaarian laaheean man kee bhukh jeeau ||7||
verses.translation: All my affairs are arranged, and the hunger of my mind is appeased. ||7||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਛਡਿਆ ਸਭੋ ਧੰਧੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai chhaddiaa sabho dha(n)dhaRaa ||
verses.translation: I have forsaken all my entanglements;

verses.original: ਗੋਸਾਈ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: gosaiee sevee sachaRaa ||
verses.translation: I serve the True Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਲੈ ਬਧਾ ਛਿਕਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: nau nidh naam nidhaan har mai palai badhaa chhik jeeau ||8||
verses.translation: I have firmly attached the Name, the Home of the Nine Treasures to my robe. ||8||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai sukhee hoo(n) sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the comfort of comforts.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur a(n)tar sabadh vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has implanted the Word of the Shabad deep within me.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh vikhaaliaa masatak dhar kai hath jeeau ||9||
verses.translation: The True Guru has shown me my Husband Lord; He has placed His Hand upon my forehead. ||9||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਬਧੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: mai badhee sach dharam saal hai ||
verses.translation: I have established the Temple of Truth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਲਹਦਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa lahadhaa bhaal kai ||
verses.translation: I sought out the Guru's Sikhs, and brought them into it.

verses.original: ਪੈਰ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਗਾ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: pair dhovaa pakhaa feradhaa tis niv niv lagaa pai jeeau ||10||
verses.translation: I wash their feet, and wave the fan over them. Bowing low, I fall at their feet. ||10||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sun galaa gur peh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I heard of the Guru, and so I went to Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan isanaan dhiRaiaa ||
verses.translation: He instilled within me the Naam, the goodness of charity and true cleansing.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਸਾਰੜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: sabh mukat hoaa saisaaraRaa naanak sachee beRee chaaR jeeau ||11||
verses.translation: All the world is liberated, O Nanak, by embarking upon the Boat of Truth. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sirasaT seve dhin raat jeeau ||
verses.translation: The whole Universe serves You, day and night.

verses.original: ਦੇ ਕੰਨੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhe ka(n)n sunahu aradhaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: Please hear my prayer, O Dear Lord.

verses.original: ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀਆ ਤੁਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: Thok vajai sabh ddiTheeaa tus aape lian chhaddai jeeau ||12||
verses.translation: I have thoroughly tested and seen all-You alone, by Your Pleasure, can save us. ||12||

verses.original: ਹੁਣਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣ ਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: hun hukam hoaa miharavaan dhaa ||
verses.translation: Now, the Merciful Lord has issued His Command.

verses.original: ਪੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਰਞਾਣਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: pai koi na kisai ran(j)aanadhaa ||
verses.translation: Let no one chase after and attack anyone else.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਵੁਠੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sabh sukhaalee vuTheeaa ih hoaa halemee raaj jeeau ||13||
verses.translation: Let all abide in peace, under this Benevolent Rule. ||13||

verses.original: ਝਿੰਮਿ ਝਿੰਮਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jhi(n)m jhi(n)m a(n)mrit varasadhaa ||
verses.translation: Softly and gently, drop by drop, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.

verses.original: ਬੋਲਾਇਆ ਬੋਲੀ ਖਸਮ ਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: bolaiaa bolee khasam dhaa ||
verses.translation: I speak as my Lord and Master causes me to speak.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਥਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: bahu maan keeaa tudh upare too(n) aape paieh thai jeeau ||14||
verses.translation: I place all my faith in You; please accept me. ||14||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਦ ਤੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: teriaa bhagataa bhukh sadh tereeaa ||
verses.translation: Your devotees are forever hungry for You.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har lochaa pooran mereeaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please fulfill my desires.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ ਮੈ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: dheh dharas sukhadhaatiaa mai gal vich laih milai jeeau ||15||
verses.translation: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Giver of Peace. Please, take me into Your Embrace. ||15||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd avar na bhaaliaa ||
verses.translation: I have not found any other as Great as You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਇਆਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dheep loa piaaliaa ||
verses.translation: You pervade the continents, the worlds and the nether regions;

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: too(n) thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa naanak bhagataa sach adhaar jeeau ||16||
verses.translation: You are permeating all places and interspaces. Nanak: You are the True Support of Your devotees. ||16||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੋਸਾਈ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਵਾਨੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau gosaiee dhaa pahilavaanaRaa ||
verses.translation: I am a wrestler; I belong to the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਚ ਦੁਮਾਲੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai gur mil uch dhumaalaRaa ||
verses.translation: I met with the Guru, and I have tied a tall, plumed turban.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਛਿੰਝ ਇਕਠੀਆ ਦਯੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: sabh hoiee chhi(n)jh ikaTheeaa dhay baiThaa vekhai aap jeeau ||17||
verses.translation: All have gathered to watch the wrestling match, and the Merciful Lord Himself is seated to behold it. ||17||

verses.original: ਵਾਤ ਵਜਨਿ ਟੰਮਕ ਭੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaat vajan Ta(n)mak bhereeaa ||
verses.translation: The bugles play and the drums beat.

verses.original: ਮਲ ਲਥੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਫੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mal lathe laidhe fereeaa ||
verses.translation: The wrestlers enter the arena and circle around.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਤੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਜੁਆਨ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਥਾਪੀ ਦਿਤੀ ਕੰਡਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: nihate pa(n)j juaan mai gur thaapee dhitee ka(n)dd jeeau ||18||
verses.translation: I have thrown the five challengers to the ground, and the Guru has patted me on the back. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ikaThe hoi aaiaa ||
verses.translation: All have gathered together,

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghar jaasan vaaT vaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: but we shall return home by different routes.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: gurmukh laahaa lai ge manmukh chale mool gavai jeeau ||19||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs reap their profits and leave, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their investment and depart. ||19||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) varanaa chihanaa baaharaa ||
verses.translation: You are without color or mark.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiseh haajar jaaharaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is seen to be manifest and present.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: sun sun tujhai dhiaaidhe tere bhagat rate gunataas jeeau ||20||
verses.translation: Hearing of Your Glories again and again, Your devotees meditate on You; they are attuned to You, O Lord, Treasure of Excellence. ||20||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਯੈ ਸੇਵੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: mai jug jug dhayai sevaRee ||
verses.translation: Through age after age, I am the servant of the Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਟੀ ਮਿਹਡੀ ਜੇਵੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaTee mihaddee jevaRee ||
verses.translation: The Guru has cut away my bonds.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਛਿੰਝ ਨ ਨਚਊ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਲਧਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: hau baahuR chhi(n)jh na nachuoo naanak aausar ladhaa bhaal jeeau ||21||2||29||
verses.translation: I shall not have to dance in the wrestling arena of life again. Nanak has searched, and found this opportunity. ||21||2||29||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਹਰੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa pahare ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Pehray, First House:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa hukam piaa garabhaas ||
verses.translation: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you were cast into the womb, by the Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: auradh tap a(n)tar kare vanajaariaa mitraa khasam setee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Upside-down, within the womb, you performed penance, O my merchant friend, and you prayed to your Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: khasam setee aradhaas vakhaanai uradh dhiaan liv laagaa ||
verses.translation: You uttered prayers to your Lord and Master, while upside-down, and you meditated on Him with deep love and affection.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਲਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਨਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa marajaadh aaiaa kal bheetar baahuR jaasee naagaa ||
verses.translation: You came into this Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and you shall depart again naked.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਕਲਮ ਵੁੜੀ ਹੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee kalam vuRee hai masatak taisee jeeaRe paas ||
verses.translation: As God's Pen has written on your forehead, so it shall be with your soul.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai hukam piaa garabhaas ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command, you enter into the womb. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa visar giaa dhiaan ||
verses.translation: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you have forgotten to meditate.

verses.original: ਹਥੋ ਹਥਿ ਨਚਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਸੁਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: hatho hath nachaieeaai vanajaariaa mitraa jiau jasudhaa ghar kaan ||
verses.translation: From hand to hand, you are passed around, O my merchant friend, like Krishna in the house of Yashoda.

verses.original: ਹਥੋ ਹਥਿ ਨਚਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮਾਤ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hatho hath nachaieeaai praanee maat kahai sut meraa ||
verses.translation: From hand to hand, you are passed around, and your mother says, ""This is my son.""

verses.original: ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: chet achet mooR man mere a(n)t nahee kachh teraa ||
verses.translation: O, my thoughtless and foolish mind, think: In the end, nothing shall be yours.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin rach rachiaa tiseh na jaanai man bheetar dhar giaan ||
verses.translation: You do not know the One who created the creation. Gather spiritual wisdom within your mind.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee dhoojai paharai visar giaa dhiaan ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, you have forgotten to meditate. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhan joban siau chit ||
verses.translation: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your consciousness is focused on wealth and youth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam na chetahee vanajaariaa mitraa badhaa chhuTeh jit ||
verses.translation: You have not remembered the Name of the Lord, O my merchant friend, although it would release you from bondage.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਬਿਕਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam na chetai praanee bikal bhiaa sa(n)g maiaa ||
verses.translation: You do not remember the Name of the Lord, and you become confused by Maya.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਤਾ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਤਾ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan siau rataa joban mataa ahilaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Revelling in your riches and intoxicated with youth, you waste your life uselessly.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharam setee vaapaar na keeto karam na keeto mit ||
verses.translation: You have not traded in righteousness and Dharma; you have not made good deeds your friends.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak teejai paharai praanee dhan joban siau chit ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, your mind is attached to wealth and youth. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਲਾਵੀ ਆਇਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa laavee aaiaa khet ||
verses.translation: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Grim Reaper comes to the field.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa jam pakaR chalaiaa vanajaariaa mitraa kisai na miliaa bhet ||
verses.translation: When the Messenger of Death seizes and dispatches you, O my merchant friend, no one knows the mystery of where you have gone.

verses.original: ਭੇਤੁ ਚੇਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhet chet har kisai na milio jaa jam pakaR chalaiaa ||
verses.translation: So think of the Lord! No one knows this secret, of when the Messenger of Death will seize you and take you away.

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੋੁਆਲੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa rudhan hoaa dhuoaalai khin meh bhiaa paraiaa ||
verses.translation: All your weeping and wailing then is false. In an instant, you become a stranger.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਆ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: saiee vasat paraapat hoiee jis siau laiaa het ||
verses.translation: You obtain exactly what you have longed for.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਲਾਵੀ ਲੁਣਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai laavee luniaa khet ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the fourth watch of the night, O mortal, the Grim Reaper has harvested your field. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਾਲਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਚੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa baalak budh achet ||
verses.translation: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your innocent mind has a child-like understanding.

verses.original: ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ ਖੇਲਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਹੇਤੁ ॥ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kheer peeaai khelaieeaai vanajaariaa mitraa maat pitaa sut het || maat pitaa sut neh ghaneraa maiaa moh sabaiee ||
verses.translation: You drink milk, and you are fondled so gently, O my merchant friend. The mother and father love their child so much, but in Maya, all are caught in emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jogee aaiaa kirat kamaiaa karanee kaar karaiee ||
verses.translation: By the good fortune of good deeds done in the past, you have come, and now you perform actions to determine your future.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਬੂਡੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee booddee dhoojai het ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained, and you are drowned in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਛੂਟਹਿਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai chhooTahigaa har chet ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, O mortal, you shall be saved by remembering the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮੈ ਮਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bhar joban mai mat ||
verses.translation: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you are intoxicated with the wine of youth and beauty.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis kaam viaapiaa vanajaariaa mitraa a(n)dhule naam na chit ||
verses.translation: Day and night, you are engrossed in sexual desire, O my merchant friend, and your consciousness is blind to the Naam.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ghaT a(n)tar naahee hor jaanai ras kas meeThe ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is not within your heart, but all sorts of other tastes seem sweet to you.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹੁਗੇ ਝੂਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan gun sa(n)jam naahee janam marahuge jhooThe ||
verses.translation: You have no wisdom at all, no meditation, no virtue or self-discipline; in falsehood, you are caught in the cycle of birth and death.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: teerath varat such sa(n)jam naahee karam dharam nahee poojaa ||
verses.translation: Pilgrimages, fasts, purification and self-discipline are of no use, nor are rituals, religious ceremonies or empty worship.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhai bhagat nisataaraa dhubidhaa viaapai dhoojaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, emancipation comes only by loving devotional worship; through duality, people are engrossed in duality. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਰਿ ਹੰਸ ਉਲਥੜੇ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa sar ha(n)s ulathaRe aai ||
verses.translation: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the swans, the white hairs, come and land upon the pool of the head.

verses.original: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਘਟੈ ਜਰੂਆ ਜਿਣੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: joban ghaTai jarooaa jinai vanajaariaa mitraa aav ghaTai dhin jai ||
verses.translation: Youth wears itself out, and old age triumphs, O my merchant friend; as time passes, your days diminish.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਸੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal pachhutaasee a(n)dhule jaa jam pakaR chalaiaa ||
verses.translation: At the last moment, you repent-you are so blind!-when the Messenger of Death seizes you and carries you away.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh apunaa kar kar raakhiaa khin meh bhiaa paraiaa ||
verses.translation: You kept all your things for yourself, but in an instant, they are all lost.

verses.original: ਬੁਧਿ ਵਿਸਰਜੀ ਗਈ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: budh visarajee giee siaanap kar avagan pachhutai ||
verses.translation: Your intellect left you, your wisdom departed, and now you repent for the evil deeds you committed.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee teejai paharai prabh chetahu liv lai ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the third watch of the night, let your consciousness be lovingly focused on God. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa biradh bhiaa tan kheen ||
verses.translation: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your body grows old and weak.

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਦੀਸਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਵੈਣ ॥
verses.translit: akhee a(n)dh na dheesiee vanajaariaa mitraa ka(n)nee sunai na vain ||
verses.translation: Your eyes go blind, and cannot see, O my merchant friend, and your ears do not hear any words.

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਹੇ ਪਰਾਕਉ ਤਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: akhee a(n)dh jeebh ras naahee rahe paraakau taanaa ||
verses.translation: Your eyes go blind, and your tongue is unable to taste; you live only with the help of others.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun a(n)tar naahee kiau sukh paavai manmukh aavan jaanaa ||
verses.translation: With no virtue within, how can you find peace? The self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਖੜੁ ਪਕੀ ਕੁੜਿ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਇ ਚਲੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: khaR pakee kuR bhajai binasai aai chalai kiaa maan ||
verses.translation: When the crop of life has matured, it bends, breaks and perishes; why take pride in that which comes and goes?

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai gurmukh sabadh pachhaan ||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the Gurmukh recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਓੜਕੁ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਹਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਰੁ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਕੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: oRak aaiaa tin saahiaa vanajaariaa mitraa jar jaravaanaa ka(n)n ||
verses.translation: Your breath comes to its end, O my merchant friend, and your shoulders are weighed down by the tyrant of old age.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅਵਗਣ ਖੜਸਨਿ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik ratee gun na samaaniaa vanajaariaa mitraa avagan khaRasan ba(n)n ||
verses.translation: Not one iota of virtue came into you, O my merchant friend; bound and gagged by evil, you are driven along.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun sa(n)jam jaavai choT na khaavai naa tis ja(n)man maranaa ||
verses.translation: One who departs with virtue and self-discipline is not struck down, and is not consigned to the cycle of birth and death.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaal jaal jam joh na saakai bhai bhagat bhai taranaa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death and his trap cannot touch him; through loving devotional worship, he crosses over the ocean of fear.

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: pat setee jaavai sahaj samaavai sagale dhookh miTaavai ||
verses.translation: He departs with honor, and merges in intuitive peace and poise; all his pains depart.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee gurmukh chhooTai saache te pat paavai ||5||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when the mortal becomes Gurmukh, he is saved and honored by the True Lord. ||5||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਉਦਰ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa har paiaa udhar ma(n)jhaar ||
verses.translation: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord places you in the womb.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaavai har ucharai vanajaariaa mitraa har har naam samaar ||
verses.translation: You meditate on the Lord, and chant the Lord's Name, O my merchant friend. You contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam jape aaraadhe vich aganee har jap jeeviaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and meditating on it within the fire of the womb, your life is sustained by dwelling on the Naam.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਰਸੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤ ਥੀਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: baahar janam bhiaa mukh laagaa sarase pitaa maat theeviaa ||
verses.translation: You are born and you come out, and your mother and father are delighted to see your face.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis kee vasat tis chetahu praanee kar hiradhai gurmukh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Remember the One, O mortal, to whom the child belongs. As Gurmukh, reflect upon Him within your heart.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai har japeeaai kirapaa dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, dwell upon the Lord, who shall shower you with His Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa man laagaa dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the mind is attached to the love of duality.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਲੀਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਲੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: meraa meraa kar paaleeaai vanajaariaa mitraa le maat pitaa gal lai ||
verses.translation: Mother and father hug you close in their embrace, claiming, ""He is mine, he is mine""; so is the child brought up, O my merchant friend.

verses.original: ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਟਿ ਖਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: laavai maat pitaa sadhaa gal setee man jaanai khaT khavaae ||
verses.translation: Your mother and father constantly hug you close in their embrace; in their minds, they believe that you will provide for them and support them.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਦਿਤੇ ਨੋ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhevai tisai na jaanai mooRaa dhite no lapaTaae ||
verses.translation: The fool does not know the One who gives; instead, he clings to the gift.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee gurmukh hovai su karai veechaar har dhiaavai man liv lai ||
verses.translation: Rare is the Gurmukh who reflects upon, meditates upon, and within his mind, is lovingly attached to the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak dhoojai paharai praanee tis kaal na kabahoo(n) khai ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, death never devours you. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਆਲਿ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa man lagaa aal ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your mind is entangled in worldly and household affairs.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhan chitavai dhan sa(n)chavai vanajaariaa mitraa har naamaa har na samaal ||
verses.translation: You think of wealth, and gather wealth, O my merchant friend, but you do not contemplate the Lord or the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har naamaa har har kadhe na samaalai j hovai a(n)t sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: You never dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, who will be your only Helper and Support in the end.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eih dhan sa(n)pai maiaa jhooThee a(n)t chhodd chaliaa pachhutaiee ||
verses.translation: This wealth, property and Maya are false. In the end, you must leave these, and depart in sorrow.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare gur mele so har har naam samaal ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord, in His Mercy, unites with the Guru, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak teejai paharai praanee se jai mile har naal ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, O mortal, they go, and are united with the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਣ ਵੇਲਾ ਆਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa har chalan velaa aadhee ||
verses.translation: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord announces the time of departure.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਭ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar sevahu pooraa satiguroo vanajaariaa mitraa sabh chalee rain vihaadhee ||
verses.translation: Serve the Perfect True Guru, O my merchant friend; your entire life-night is passing away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਢਿਲ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har sevahu khin khin ddil mool na karih jit asathir jug jug hovahu ||
verses.translation: Serve the Lord each and every instant-do not delay! You shall become eternal throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਖੋਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har setee sadh maanahu raleeaa janam maran dhukh khovahu ||
verses.translation: Enjoy ecstasy forever with the Lord, and do away with the pains of birth and death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਂਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur suaamee bhedh na jaanahu jit mil har bhagat sukhaa(n)dhee ||
verses.translation: Know that there is no difference between the Guru, the True Guru, and your Lord and Master. Meeting with Him, take pleasure in the Lord's devotional service.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਸਫਲਿਓੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai safalio rain bhagataa dhee ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the life-night of the devotee is fruitful. ||4||1||3||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhar paitaa udharai maeh ||
verses.translation: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord placed your soul in the womb.

verses.original: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਮਾਨਸੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhasee maasee maanas keeaa vanajaariaa mitraa kar muhalat karam kamaeh ||
verses.translation: In the tenth month, you were made into a human being, O my merchant friend, and you were given your allotted time to perform good deeds.

verses.original: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: muhalat kar dheenee karam kamaane jaisaa likhat dhur paiaa ||
verses.translation: You were given this time to perform good deeds, according to your pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੰਜੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa bhaiee sut banitaa tin bheetar prabhoo sa(n)joiaa ||
verses.translation: God placed you with your mother, father, brothers, sons and wife.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਇਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: karam sukaram karaae aape is ja(n)tai vas kichh naeh ||
verses.translation: God Himself is the Cause of causes, good and bad-no one has control over these things.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai dhar paitaa udharai maeh ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, the soul is placed in the womb. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਜੁਆਨੀ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bhar juaanee laharee dhei ||
verses.translation: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the fullness of youth rises in you like waves.

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਾ ਅਹੰਮੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa na pachhaaniee vanajaariaa mitraa man mataa aha(n)mei ||
verses.translation: You do not distinguish between good and evil, O my merchant friend-your mind is intoxicated with ego.

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਆਗੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa na pachhaanai praanee aagai pa(n)th karaaraa ||
verses.translation: Mortal beings do not distinguish between good and evil, and the road ahead is treacherous.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa satigur kabahoo(n) na seviaa sir Thaadde jam ja(n)dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: They never serve the Perfect True Guru, and the cruel tyrant Death stands over their heads.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਪਕਰਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai jab pakaras bavare tab kiaa jabaab karei ||
verses.translation: When the Righteous Judge seizes you and interrogates you, O madman, what answer will you give him then?

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak dhoojai paharai praanee bhar joban laharee dhei ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, the fullness of youth tosses you about like waves in the storm. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bikh sa(n)chai a(n)dh agiaan ||
verses.translation: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰਿ ਕਲਤ੍ਰਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr moh lapaTiaa vanajaariaa mitraa a(n)tar lahar lobhaan ||
verses.translation: He is entangled in emotional attachment to his wife and sons, O my merchant friend, and deep within him, the waves of greed are rising up.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar lahar lobhaan paraanee so prabh chit na aavai ||
verses.translation: The waves of greed are rising up within him, and he does not remember God.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat siau sa(n)g na keeaa bahu jonee dhukh paavai ||
verses.translation: He does not join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and he suffers in terrible pain through countless incarnations.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sirajanahaar visaariaa suaamee ik nimakh na lago dhiaan ||
verses.translation: He has forgotten the Creator, his Lord and Master, and he does not meditate on Him, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੇ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee teejai paharai bikh sa(n)che a(n)dh agiaan ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhin neRai aaiaa soi ||
verses.translation: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, that day is drawing near.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam samaal too(n) vanajaariaa mitraa teraa dharageh belee hoi ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O my merchant friend. It shall be your Friend in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam samaal paraanee a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O mortal; in the end, it shall be your only companion.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਝੂਠੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eih moh maiaa terai sa(n)g na chaalai jhooThee preet lagaiee ||
verses.translation: This emotional attachment to Maya shall not go with you; it is false to fall in love with it.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਦਰੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee rain gudharee a(n)dhiaaree sev satigur chaanan hoi ||
verses.translation: The entire night of your life has passed away in darkness; but by serving the True Guru, the Divine Light shall dawn within.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai dhin neRai aaiaa soi ||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, that day is drawing near! ||4||

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: likhiaa aaiaa govi(n)dh kaa vanajaariaa mitraa uTh chale kamaanaa saath ||
verses.translation: Receiving the summons from the Lord of the Universe, O my merchant friend, you must arise and depart with the actions you have committed.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਦੇਵਨੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਓਨੀ ਤਕੜੇ ਪਾਏ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: eik ratee bilam na dhevanee vanajaariaa mitraa onee takaRe paae haath ||
verses.translation: You are not allowed a moment's delay, O my merchant friend; the Messenger of Death seizes you with firm hands.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: likhiaa aaiaa pakaR chalaiaa manmukh sadhaa dhuhele ||
verses.translation: Receiving the summons, people are seized and dispatched. The self-willed manmukhs are miserable forever.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee pooraa satigur seviaa se dharageh sadhaa suhele ||
verses.translation: But those who serve the Perfect True Guru are forever happy in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਬੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharatee sareer jug a(n)tar jo bovai so khaat ||
verses.translation: The body is the field of karma in this age; whatever you plant, you shall harvest.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਤਿ ॥੫॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bhagat soheh dharavaare manmukh sadhaa bhavaat ||5||1||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs wander forever in reincarnation. ||5||1||4||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla, Second House, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh iaanee peieeaRai kiau kar har dharasan pikhai ||
verses.translation: How can the ignorant soul-bride obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is in this world of her father's home?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har apanee kirapaa kare gurmukh saahuraRai ka(n)m sikhai ||
verses.translation: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, the Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home.

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: saahuraRai ka(n)m sikhai gurmukh har har sadhaa dhiaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home; she meditates forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saheeaa vich firai suhelee har dharageh baeh luddaae ||
verses.translation: She walks happily among her companions, and in the Lord's Court, she swings her arms joyfully.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa dharam rai kee baakee jap har har naam kirakhai ||
verses.translation: Her account is cleared by the Righteous Judge of Dharma, when she chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦਿਖੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh iaanee peieeaRai gurmukh har dharasan dhikhai ||1||
verses.translation: The ignorant soul-bride becomes Gurmukh, and gains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is still in her father's house. ||1||

verses.original: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: veeaahu hoaa mere baabulaa gurmukhe har paiaa ||
verses.translation: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan a(n)dheraa kaTiaa gur giaan pracha(n)dd balaiaa ||
verses.translation: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. The Guru has revealed the blazing light of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: baliaa gur giaan a(n)dheraa binasiaa har ratan padhaarath laadhaa ||
verses.translation: This spiritual wisdom given by the Guru shines forth, and the darkness has been dispelled. I have found the Priceless Jewel of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai rog giaa dhukh laathaa aap aapai gurmat khaadhaa ||
verses.translation: The sickness of my ego has been dispelled, and my pain is over and done. Through the Guru's Teachings, my identity has consumed my identical identity.

verses.original: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: akaal moorat var paiaa abinaasee naa kadhe marai na jaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained my Husband Lord, the Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form. He is Imperishable; He shall never die, and He shall never ever leave.

verses.original: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: veeaahu hoaa mere baabolaa gurmukhe har paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਞ ਸੁਹੰਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: har sat sate mere baabulaa har jan mil ja(n)n(j) suha(n)dhee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage procession looks beautiful.

verses.original: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: pevakaRai har jap suhelee vich saahuraRai kharee soha(n)dhee ||
verses.translation: She who chants the Lord's Name is happy in this world of her father's home, and in the next world of her Husband Lord, she shall be very beautiful.

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saahuraRai vich kharee soha(n)dhee jin pevakaRai naam samaaliaa ||
verses.translation: In her Husband Lord's Celestial Home, she shall be most beautiful, if she has remembered the Naam in this world.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh safalio janam tinaa dhaa gurmukh jinaa man jin paasaa ddaaliaa ||
verses.translation: Fruitful are the lives of those who, as Gurmukh, have conquered their minds-they have won the game of life.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)t janaa mil kaaraj sohiaa var paiaa purakh ana(n)dhee ||
verses.translation: Joining with the humble Saints of the Lord, my actions bring prosperity, and I have obtained the Lord of Bliss as my Husband.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਞ ਸੋੁਹੰਦੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har sat sat mere baabolaa har jan mil ja(n)n(j) suoha(n)dhee ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Joining with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage party has been embellished. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh mere baabulaa har dhevahu dhaan mai dhaajo ||
verses.translation: O my father, give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਪੜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਵਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਜੋ ॥
verses.translit: har kapaRo har sobhaa dhevahu jit savarai meraa kaajo ||
verses.translation: Give me the Lord as my wedding gown, and the Lord as my glory, to accomplish my works.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har bhagatee kaaj suhelaa gur satigur dhaan dhivaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through devotional worship to the Lord, this ceremony is made blissful and beautiful; the Guru, the True Guru, has given this gift.

verses.original: ਖੰਡਿ ਵਰਭੰਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਰਲੈ ਰਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd varabha(n)dd har sobhaa hoiee ih dhaan na ralai ralaiaa ||
verses.translation: Across the continents, and throughout the Universe, the Lord's Glory is pervading. This gift is not diminished by being diffused among all.

verses.original: ਹੋਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਾਜੁ ਜਿ ਰਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਹਿ ਸੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਚੁ ਪਾਜੋ ॥
verses.translit: hor manmukh dhaaj j rakh dhikhaaleh su kooR aha(n)kaar kach paajo ||
verses.translation: Any other dowry, which the self-willed manmukhs offer for show, is only false egotism and a worthless display.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har prabh mere baabulaa har dhevahu dhaan mai dhaajo ||4||
verses.translation: O my father, please give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਨ ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: har raam raam mere baabolaa pir mil dhan vel vadha(n)dhee ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, the soul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੋ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੋ ਸਦ ਪੀੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਚਲੰਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jugeh jugo jug jugeh jugo sadh peeRee guroo chala(n)dhee ||
verses.translation: In age after age, through all the ages, forever and ever, those who belong to the Guru's Family shall prosper and increase.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪੀੜੀ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug peeRee chalai satigur kee jinee gurmukh naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Age after age, the Family of the True Guru shall increase. As Gurmukh, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har purakh na kab hee binasai jaavai nit dhevai chaRai savaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Almighty Lord never dies or goes away. Whatever He gives, keeps on increasing.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t sa(n)t har eko jap har har naam soha(n)dhee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One Lord is the Saint of Saints. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the soul-bride is bountiful and beautiful.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਨ ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: har raam raam mere baabulaa pir mil dhan vel vadha(n)dhee ||5||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, the soul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine. ||5||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jeeau mitraa gobi(n)dh naam samaale ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jee mitraa har nibahai terai naale ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the Lord shall always be with you.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g sahaiee har naam dhiaaiee birathaa koi na jaae ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord shall be with you as your Helper and Support. Meditate on Him-no one who does so shall ever return empty-handed.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhe seiee fal paaveh charan kamal chit laae ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, by focusing your consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal poor rahiaa banavaaree ghaT ghaT nadhar nihaale ||
verses.translation: He is totally pervading the water and the land; He is the Lord of the World-forest. Behold Him in exaltation in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sikh dhei man preetam saadhasa(n)g bhram jaale ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, in the Company of the Holy, burn away your doubts. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jee mitraa har bin jhooTh pasaare ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, without the Lord, all outward show is false.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jeeau mitraa bikh saagar sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the world is an ocean of poison.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal kar bohith karate sahasaa dhookh na biaapai ||
verses.translation: Let the Lord's Lotus Feet be your Boat, so that pain and skepticism shall not touch you.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa bheTai vaddabhaagee aaTh pahar prabh jaapai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, meditate on God twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee sevak suaamee bhagataa naam adhaare ||
verses.translation: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Lord and Master of His servants. His Name is the Support of His devotees.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਝੂਠ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sikh dhei man preetam bin har jhooTh pasaare ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, without the Lord, all outward show is false. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jeeau mitraa har ladhe khep savalee ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, load the profitable cargo of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਮਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jeeau mitraa har dhar nihachal malee ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, enter through the eternal Door of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਸਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har dhar seve alakh abheve nihachal aasan paiaa ||
verses.translation: One who serves at the Door of the Imperceptible and Unfathomable Lord, obtains this eternal position.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: teh janam na maran na aavan jaanaa sa(n)saa dhookh miTaiaa ||
verses.translation: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going; anguish and anxiety are ended.

verses.original: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਫਾਰਿਆ ਜਮਦੂਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: chitr gupat kaa kaagadh faariaa jamadhootaa kachhoo na chalee ||
verses.translation: The accounts of Chitr and Gupt, the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious are torn up, and the Messenger of Death cannot do anything.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sikh dhei man preetam har ladhe khep savalee ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, load the profitable cargo of the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jeeau mitraa kar sa(n)taa sa(n)g nivaaso ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, abide in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jeeau mitraa har naam japat paragaaso ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, chanting the Lord's Name, the Divine Light shines within.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਇਛ ਸਗਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: simar suaamee sukheh gaamee ichh sagalee pu(n)neeaa ||
verses.translation: Remember your Lord and Master, who is easily obtained, and all desires shall be fulfilled.

verses.original: ਪੁਰਬੇ ਕਮਾਏ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: purabe kamaae sreera(n)g paae har mile chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||
verses.translation: By my past actions, I have found the Lord, the Greatest Lover. Separated from Him for so long, I am united with Him again.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar sarabat raviaa man upajiaa bisuaaso ||
verses.translation: Inside and out, He is pervading everywhere. Faith in Him has welled up within my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sikh dhei man preetam kar sa(n)taa sa(n)g nivaaso ||4||
verses.translation: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, let the Society of the Saints be your dwelling. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jeeau mitraa har prem bhagat man leenaa ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, let your mind remain absorbed in loving devotion to the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa jeeau mitraa har jal mil jeeve meenaa ||
verses.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the fish of the mind lives only when it is immersed in the Water of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੀ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੇ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮਨ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: har pee aaghaane a(n)mirat baane srab sukhaa man vuThe ||
verses.translation: Drinking in the Lord's Ambrosial Bani, the mind is satisfied, and all pleasures come to abide within.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: sreedhar paae ma(n)gal gaae ichh pu(n)nee satigur tuThe ||
verses.translation: Attaining the Lord of Excellence, I sing the Songs of Joy. The True Guru, becoming merciful, has fulfilled my desires.

verses.original: ਲੜਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਲਾਏ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: laR leene laae nau nidh paae naau sarabas Thaakur dheenaa ||
verses.translation: He has attached me to the hem of His robe, and I have obtained the nine treasures. My Lord and Master has bestowed His Name, which is everything to me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਝਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sikh sa(n)t samajhaiee har prem bhagat man leenaa ||5||1||2||
verses.translation: Nanak instructs the Saints to teach, that the mind is imbued with loving devotion to the Lord. ||5||1||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: sireeraag ke chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Chhants Of Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhanaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanaa:

verses.original: ਹਠ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਦੀਦਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: haTh majhaahoo maa piree pase kiau dheedhaar ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Husband Lord is deep within my heart. How can I see Him?

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਲਭਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t saranaiee labhane naanak praan adhaar ||1||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, O Nanak, the Support of the breath of life is found. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau preet reet sa(n)tan man aave jeeau ||
verses.translation: To love the Lotus Feet of the Lord-this way of life has come into the minds of His Saints.

verses.original: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਅਨੀਤਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhuteeaa bhaau bipareet aneet dhaasaa neh bhaave jeeau ||
verses.translation: The love of duality, this evil practice, this bad habit, is not liked by the Lord's slaves.

verses.original: ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਾਵਏ ਇਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaasaa neh bhaave bin dharasaave ik khin dheeraj kiau karai ||
verses.translation: It is not pleasing to the Lord's slaves; without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, how can they find peace, even for a moment?

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam bihoonaa tan man heenaa jal bin machhulee jiau marai ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are empty; like fish out of water, they die.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: mil mere piaare praan adhaare gun saadhasa(n)g mil gaave ||
verses.translation: Please meet with me, O my Beloved-You are the Support of my breath of life. Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ke suaamee dhaar anugrahu man tan a(n)k samaave ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master of Nanak, please grant Your Grace, and permeate my body, mind and being. ||1||

verses.original: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhanaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanaa:

verses.original: ਸੋਹੰਦੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਡੂਜੜੋ ॥
verses.translit: soha(n)dhaRo habh Thai koi na dhisai ddoojaRo ||
verses.translation: He is Beautiful in all places; I do not see any other at all.

verses.original: ਖੁਲੑੜੇ ਕਪਾਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khul(h)Re kapaaT naanak satigur bheTate ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, O Nanak, the doors are opened wide. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere bachan anoop apaar sa(n)tan aadhaar baanee beechaareeaai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Your Word is Incomparable and Infinite. I contemplate the Word of Your Bani, the Support of the Saints.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਸੁਆਸ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: simarat saas giraas pooran bisuaas kiau manahu bisaareeaai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I remember Him in meditation with every breath and morsel of food, with perfect faith. How could I forget Him from my mind?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬੇਸਾਰੀਐ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਟਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kiau manahu besaareeaai nimakh nahee Taareeaai gunava(n)t praan hamaare ||
verses.translation: How could I forget Him from my mind, even for an instant? He is the Most Worthy; He is my very life!

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man baa(n)chhat fal dhet hai suaamee jeea kee birathaa saare ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is the Giver of the fruits of the mind's desires. He knows all the useless vanities and pains of the soul.

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਨਾਥੇ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: anaath ke naathe srab kai saathe jap jooaai janam na haareeaai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Patron of lost souls, the Companion of all, your life shall not be lost in the gamble.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh peh kirapaa kar bhavajal taareeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to God: Please shower me with Your Mercy, and carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhanaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanaa:

verses.original: ਧੂੜੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਖੇ ਸਾਈ ਥੀਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: dhooRee majan saadh khe saiee the'ee kirapaal ||
verses.translation: People bathe in the dust of the feet of the Saints, when the Lord becomes merciful.

verses.original: ਲਧੇ ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ladhe habhe thokaRe naanak har dhan maal ||1||
verses.translation: I have obtained all things, O Nanak; the Lord is my Wealth and Property. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਾਮ ਭਗਤਹ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਆਸਾ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar suaamee dhaam bhagateh bisraam aasaa lag jeevate jeeau ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master's Home is beautiful. It is the resting place of His devotees, who live in hopes of attaining it.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨੇ ਗਲਤਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tane galataan simarat prabh naam har a(n)mrit peevate jeeau ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are absorbed in meditation on the Name of God; they drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਵਤੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har peevate sadhaa thir theevate bikhai ban feekaa jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and become eternally stable. They know that the water of corruption is insipid and tasteless.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal gopaal prabh mere saadhasa(n)gat nidh maaniaa ||
verses.translation: When my God, the Lord of the Universe became merciful, I came to look upon the Saadh Sangat as the treasure.

verses.original: ਸਰਬਸੋ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੀਵਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sarabaso sookh aana(n)dh ghan piaare har ratan man a(n)tar seevate ||
verses.translation: All pleasures and supreme ecstasy, O my Beloved, come to those who sew the Jewel of the Lord into their minds.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eik til nahee visarai praan aadhaaraa jap jap naanak jeevate ||3||
verses.translation: They do not forget, even for an instant, the Support of the breath of life. They live by constantly meditating on Him, O Nanak. ||3||

verses.original: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhanaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanaa:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਕੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੂੰ ਮਿਲਿਓਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo tau keene aapane tinaa koo(n) milioh ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You meet and merge with those whom you have made Your Own.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਮੋਹਿਓਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਿਓਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape hee aap mohioh jas naanak aap sunioh ||1||
verses.translation: You Yourself are entranced, O Nanak, hearing Your Own Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਰੀਝਾਇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: prem Thagauree pai reejhai gobi(n)dh man mohiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Administering the intoxicating drug of love, I have won over the Lord of the Universe; I have fascinated His Mind.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕੰਠੇ ਲਗਿ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kai parasaadh agaadh ka(n)The lag sohiaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I am held in the loving embrace of the Unfathomable Lord, and I am entranced.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਿ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਖੵਣ ਕਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: har ka(n)Th lag sohiaa dhokh sabh johiaa bhagat lakhayen kar vas bhe ||
verses.translation: Held in the Lord's loving embrace, I look beautiful, and all my pains have been dispelled. By the loving worship of His devotees, the Lord has come under their power.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਵੁਠੇ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਤੁਠੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: man sarab sukh vuThe govidh tuThe janam maranaa sabh miT ge ||
verses.translation: All pleasures have come to dwell in the mind; the Lord of the Universe is pleased and appeased. Birth and death have been totally eliminated.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਗਾਇਆ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਇਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੋਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee ma(n)galo gaiaa ichh pujaiaa bahuR na maiaa hohiaa ||
verses.translation: O my companions, sing the Songs of Joy. My desires have been fulfilled, and I shall never again be trapped or shaken by Maya.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੋਹਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kar geh leene naanak prabh piaare sa(n)saar saagar nahee pohiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Taking hold of my hand, O Nanak, my Beloved God will not let me be swallowed up by the world-ocean. ||4||

verses.original: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddakhanaa ||
verses.translation: Dakhanaa:

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਦੋ ॥
verses.translit: saiee naam amol keem na koiee jaanadho ||
verses.translation: The Master's Name is Priceless; no one knows its value.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਦੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jinaa bhaag mathaeh se naanak har ra(n)g maanadho ||1||
verses.translation: Those who have good destiny recorded upon their foreheads, O Nanak, enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਕਹਤੇ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਣਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਲਿਖਤਂੀ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahate pavitr sunate sabh dha(n)n likhata(n)ee kul taariaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those who chant are sanctified. All those who listen are blessed, and those who write save their ancestors.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau saadhoo sa(n)g naam har ra(n)g tinee braham beechaariaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those who join the Saadh Sangat are imbued with the Lord's Love; they reflect and meditate on God.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: braham beechaariaa janam savaariaa pooran kirapaa prabh karee ||
verses.translation: Contemplating God, their lives are reformed and redeemed; God has showered His Perfect Mercy upon them.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੋ ਦੀਨੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਾ ਧਾਵੈ ਨਹ ਮਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar geh leene har jaso dheene jon naa dhaavai neh maree ||
verses.translation: Taking them by the hand, the Lord has blessed them with His Praises. They no longer have to wander in reincarnation, and they never have to die.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰੇ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhiaal kirapaal bheTat hare kaam karodh lobh maariaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Kind and Compassionate True Guru, I have met the Lord; I have conquered sexual desire, anger and greed.

verses.original: ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਕਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਕੈ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: kathan na jai akath suaamee sadhakai jai naanak vaariaa ||5||1||3||
verses.translation: Our Indescribable Lord and Master cannot be described. Nanak is devoted, forever a sacrifice to Him. ||5||1||3||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa vanajaaraa
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla, Vanajaaraa ~ The Merchant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har utam naam hai jin siriaa sabh koi jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Excellent and Sublime. He created everyone.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਸਭੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeea sabhe pratipaaladhaa ghaT ghaT ramieeaa soi ||
verses.translation: The Lord cherishes all beings. He permeates each and every heart.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: so har sadhaa dhiaaieeaai tis bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Meditate forever on that Lord. Without Him, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo moh maiaa chit laidhe se chhodd chale dhukh roi ||
verses.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on emotional attachment to Maya must leave; they depart crying out in despair.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa har a(n)t sakhaiee hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, his only Companion in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mai har bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: I have none other than You, O Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har gur saranaiee paieeaai vanajaariaa mitraa vaddabhaag paraapat hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Guru's Sanctuary, the Lord is found, O my merchant friend; by great good fortune, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa vin bhaieeaa har kinai na paiaa naau ||
verses.translation: Without the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, no one has obtained the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਪੁਤੁ ਨਿਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vich haumai karam kamaavadhe jiau vesuaa put ninaau ||
verses.translation: Those who do their deeds in ego are like the prostitute's son, who has no name.

verses.original: ਪਿਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pitaa jaat taa hoieeaai gur tuThaa kare pasaau ||
verses.translation: The father's status is obtained only if the Guru is pleased and bestows His Favor.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur paiaa har ahinis lagaa bhaau ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the Guru is found; embrace love for the Lord, day and night.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak braham pachhaaniaa har keerat karam kamaau ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has realized God; he sings the Lord's Praises through the actions he does. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man har har lagaa chaau ||
verses.translation: In my mind there is such a deep yearning for the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai naam dhiraRaiaa har miliaa har prabh naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me; I have found the Lord through the Lord God's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: As long as there is youth and health, meditate on the Naam.

verses.original: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaladhiaa naal har chalasee har a(n)te le chhaddai ||
verses.translation: Along the way, the Lord shall go along with you, and in the end, He shall save you.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree tin kau jin har man vuThaa aai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those, within whose minds the Lord has come to dwell.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee har har naam na chetio se a(n)t ge pachhutai ||
verses.translation: Those who have not remembered the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, shall leave with regret in the end.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhur masatak har prabh likhiaa jan naanak naam dhiaai ||3||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads, O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man har har preet lagai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, embrace love for the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur paiaa gur sabadhee paar laghai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the Guru is found; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are carried across to the other side. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: har aape aap upaidhaa har aape dhevai lei ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself creates, He Himself gives and takes away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: har aape bharam bhulaidhaa har aape hee mat dhei ||
