verses.translation: The Lord Himself leads us astray in doubt; the Lord Himself imparts understanding.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukhaa man paragaas hai se virale keiee kei ||
verses.translation: The minds of the Gurmukhs are illuminated and enlightened; they are so very rare.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree tin kau jin har paiaa gurmate ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who find the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kamal paragaasiaa man har har vuThaRaa he ||4||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak's heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and the Lord, Har, Har, has come to dwell in the mind. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man har har japan kare ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har gur saranaiee bhaj pau ji(n)dhoo sabh kilavikh dhukh parahare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Guru, O my soul; all your sins shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਭਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT ramieeaa man vasai kiau paieeaai kit bhat ||
verses.translation: The All-pervading Lord dwells within each and every person's heart-how can He be obtained?

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa satigur bheTeeaai har aai vasai man chit ||
verses.translation: By meeting the Perfect Guru, the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell within the conscious mind.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: mai dhar naam adhaar hai har naamai te gat mat ||
verses.translation: The Naam is my Support and Sustenance. From the Lord's Name, I obtain salvation and understanding.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: mai har har naam visaahu hai har naame hee jat pat ||
verses.translation: My faith is in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name is my status and honor.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa ra(n)g rataRaa har ra(n)g rat ||5||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaavahu har prabh sat ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, the True Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਭ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੇ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee har prabh jaaniaa sabh har prabh te utapat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, you shall come to know the Lord God. From the Lord God, everything was created. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa se aai mile gur paas ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, come to the Guru and meet Him.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: sevak bhai vanajaariaa mitraa gur har har naam pragaas ||
verses.translation: They love to serve, O my merchant friend, and through the Guru, they are illuminated by the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਜਿਨ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan vanaj vaapaareeaa jin vakhar ladhiaRaa har raas ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the trade of those traders who have loaded the merchandise of the Wealth of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਦਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukhaa dhar mukh ujale se aai mile har paas ||
verses.translation: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant in the Court of the Lord; they come to the Lord and merge with Him.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gur tin paiaa jinaa aap tuThaa gunataas ||6||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, they alone find the Guru, with whom the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is pleased. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaavahu saas giraas ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, with every breath and morsel of food.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man preet lagee tinaa gurmukhaa har naam jinaa raharaas ||1|| rahaau ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs embrace the Love of the Lord in their minds; they are continually occupied with the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||1||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag kee vaar mahalaa chauthhaa salokaa naal ||
verses.translation: Vaar Of Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla, With Shaloks:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਗਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raagaa vich sreeraag hai je sach dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: Among the ragas, Siree Raag is the best, if it inspires you to enshrine love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa har sach man vasai nihachal mat apaar ||
verses.translation: The True Lord comes to abide forever in the mind, and your understanding becomes steady and unequalled.

verses.original: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ratan amolak paiaa gur kaa sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: The priceless jewel is obtained, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਰੀਰ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa sachee man sachaa sachaa sareer akaar ||
verses.translation: The tongue becomes true, the mind becomes true, and the body becomes true as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sachai satigur seviaai sadhaa sach vaapaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, forever true are the dealings of those who serve the True Guru. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: hor birahaa sabh dhaat hai jab lag saahib preet na hoi ||
verses.translation: All other loves are transitory, as long as people do not love their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih man maiaa mohiaa vekhan sunan na hoi ||
verses.translation: This mind is enticed by Maya-it cannot see or hear.

verses.original: ਸਹ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: seh dhekhe bin preet na uoopajai a(n)dhaa kiaa karei ||
verses.translation: Without seeing her Husband Lord, love does not well up; what can the blind person do?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਖੀ ਲੀਤੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jin akhee leeteeaa soiee sachaa dhei ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True One who takes away the eyes of spiritual wisdom-He alone can restore them. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har iko karataa ik iko dheebaan har ||
verses.translation: The Lord alone is the One Creator; there is only the One Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ikasai dhaa hai amar iko har chit dhar ||
verses.translation: The One Lord's Command is the One and Only-enshrine the One Lord in your consciousness.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har tis bin koiee naeh ddar bhram bhau dhoor kar ||
verses.translation: Without that Lord, there is no other at all. Remove your fear, doubt and dread.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਖੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har tisai no saalaeh j tudh rakhai baahar ghar ||
verses.translation: Praise that Lord who protects you, inside your home, and outside as well.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har jis no hoi dhiaal so har jap bhau bikham tar ||1||
verses.translation: When that Lord becomes merciful, and one comes to chant the Lord's Name, one swims across the ocean of fear. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਾਤੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਦੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhaatee saahib sa(n)dheeaa kiaa chalai tis naal ||
verses.translation: The gifts belong to our Lord and Master; how can we compete with Him?

verses.original: ਇਕ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eik jaaga(n)dhe naa laha(n)n ikanaa sutiaa dhei uThaal ||1||
verses.translation: Some remain awake and aware, and do not receive these gifts, while others are awakened from their sleep to be blessed. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸਾਦਿਕਾ ਸਬਰੁ ਤੋਸਾ ਮਲਾਇਕਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sidhak sabooree saadhikaa sabar tosaa malaikaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Faith, contentment and tolerance are the food and provisions of the angels.

verses.original: ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਾਇਸਾ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਇਕਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheedhaar poore paisaa thaau naahee khaikaa ||2||
verses.translation: They obtain the Perfect Vision of the Lord, while those who gossip find no place of rest. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aape tudh upai kai aap kaarai laiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created all; You Yourself delegate the tasks.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape vekh vigasadhaa aapanee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are pleased, beholding Your Own Glorious Greatness.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har tudhahu baahar kichh naahee too(n) sachaa saiee ||
verses.translation: O Lord, there is nothing at all beyond You. You are the True Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਹੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape aap varatadhaa sabhanee hee thaiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are contained in all places.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har tisai dhiaavahu sa(n)t janahu jo le chhaddaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Meditate on that Lord, O Saints; He shall rescue and save you. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਕੜ ਜਾਤੀ ਫਕੜੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: fakaR jaatee fakaR naau ||
verses.translation: Pride in social status is empty; pride in personal glory is useless.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਇਕਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa jeeaa ikaa chhaau ||
verses.translation: The One Lord gives shade to all beings.

verses.original: ਆਪਹੁ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapahu je ko bhalaa kahaae ||
verses.translation: You may call yourself good;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak taa par jaapai jaa pat lekhai paae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this will only be known when your honor is approved in God's Account. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਰਿ ਚਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis piaare siau neh tis aagai mar chaleeaai ||
verses.translation: Die before the One whom you love;

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhirag jeevan sa(n)saar taa kai paachhai jeevanaa ||2||
verses.translation: To live without Him is to live a worthless life in this world. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਐ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਦੀਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape dharatee saajeeaai cha(n)dh sooraj dhui dheeve ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the earth, and the two lamps of the sun and the moon.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਹਟ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhas chaar haT tudh saajiaa vaapaar kareeve ||
verses.translation: You created the fourteen world-shops, in which Your Business is transacted.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa no har laabh dhei jo gurmukh theeve ||
verses.translation: The Lord bestows His Profits on those who become Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin jamakaal na viaapiee jin sach a(n)mrit peeve ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not touch those who drink in the True Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛੁਟੀਵੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oi aap chhuTe paravaar siau tin pichhai sabh jagat chhuTeeve ||3||
verses.translation: They themselves are saved, along with their family, and all those who follow them are saved as well. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat kar kai vasiaa soi ||
verses.translation: He created the Creative Power of the Universe, within which He dwells.

verses.original: ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vakhat veechaare su ba(n)dhaa hoi ||
verses.translation: One who reflects upon his allotted span of life, becomes the slave of God.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat hai keemat nahee pai ||
verses.translation: The value of the Creative Power of the Universe cannot be known.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਤ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa keemat pai ta kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: Even if its value were known, it could not be described.

verses.original: ਸਰੈ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarai sareeat kareh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Some think about religious rituals and regulations,

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe kaise paaveh paar ||
verses.translation: but without understanding, how can they cross over to the other side?

verses.original: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਖਸੂਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: sidhak kar sijadhaa man kar makhasoodh ||
verses.translation: Let sincere faith be your bowing in prayer, and let the conquest of your mind be your objective in life.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਧਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਿਹ ਧਿਰਿ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh dhir dhekhaa teh dhir maujoodh ||1||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see God's Presence. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਭਾ ਏਵ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabhaa ev na paieeaai naa neRai naa dhoor ||
verses.translation: The Society of the Guru is not obtained like this, by trying to be near or far away.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur taa(n) milai jaa man rahai hadhoor ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, you shall meet the True Guru, if your mind remains in His Presence. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਸਪਤ ਸਾਗਰਾ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sapat dheep sapat saagaraa nav kha(n)dd chaar vedh dhas asaT puraanaa ||
verses.translation: The seven islands, seven seas, nine continents, four Vedas and eighteen Puraanas

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: har sabhanaa vich too(n) varatadhaa har sabhanaa bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You pervade and permeate all. Lord, everyone loves You.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਰਗ ਪਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tujhai dhiaaveh jeea ja(n)t har saarag paanaa ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures meditate on You, Lord. You hold the earth in Your Hands.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo gurmukh har aaraadhadhe tin hau kurabaanaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape aap varatadhaa kar choj viddaanaa ||4||
verses.translation: You Yourself are All-pervading; You stage this wondrous drama! ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਉ ਮਸਾਜਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਸਦਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੀ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kalau masaajanee kiaa sadhaieeaai hiradhai hee likh leh ||
verses.translation: Why ask for a pen, and why ask for ink? Write within your heart.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa saahib kai ra(n)g rahai kabahoo(n) na tooTas neh ||
verses.translation: Remain immersed forever in the Love of your Lord and Master, and your love for Him shall never break.

verses.original: ਕਲਉ ਮਸਾਜਨੀ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਭੀ ਨਾਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kalau masaajanee jaisee likhiaa bhee naale jai ||
verses.translation: Pen and ink shall pass away, along with what has been written.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak seh preet na jaisee jo dhur chhoddee sachai pai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Love of your Husband Lord shall never perish. The True Lord has bestowed it, as it was pre-ordained. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee aavadhaa naal na chaliee vekhahu ko viaupai ||
verses.translation: That which is seen, shall not go along with you. What does it take to make you see this?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sach dhiraRaiaa sach rahahu liv lai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has implanted the True Name within; remain lovingly absorbed in the True One.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadhee sach hai karamee palai pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Word of His Shabad is True. By His Grace, it is obtained. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)dhar baahar ik too(n) too(n) jaaneh bhet ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are inside and outside as well. You are the Knower of secrets.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕੀਚੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo keechai so har jaanadhaa mere man har chet ||
verses.translation: Whatever anyone does, the Lord knows. O my mind, think of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਡਰੈ ਜਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਦਾ ਧਰਮੀ ਵਿਗਸੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: so ddarai j paap kamaavadhaa dharamee vigaset ||
verses.translation: The one who commits sins lives in fear, while the one who lives righteously rejoices.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਡਰੀਐ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sachaa aap niaau sach taa ddareeaai ket ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You Yourself are True, and True is Your Justice. Why should anyone be afraid?

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਲੇਤੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jinaa naanak sach pachhaaniaa se sach ralet ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who recognize the True Lord are blended with the True One. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਮ ਜਲਉ ਸਣੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਭੀ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kalam jalau san masavaaneeaai kaagadh bhee jal jaau ||
verses.translation: Burn the pen, and burn the ink; burn the paper as well.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: likhan vaalaa jal balau jin likhiaa dhoojaa bhaau ||
verses.translation: Burn the writer who writes in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa avar na karanaa jai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, people do what is pre-ordained; they cannot do anything else. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੜਣਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hor kooR paRanaa kooR bolanaa maiaa naal piaar ||
verses.translation: False is other reading, and false is other speaking, in the love of Maya.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vin naavai ko thir nahee paR paR hoi khuaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, nothing is permanent; those who read and read are ruined. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kee vaddiaaiee vaddee hai har keeratan har kaa ||
verses.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord, and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kee vaddiaaiee vaddee hai jaa niaau hai dharam kaa ||
verses.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; His Justice is totally Righteous.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kee vaddiaaiee vaddee hai jaa fal hai jeea kaa ||
verses.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; people receive the fruits of the soul.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਹਿਆ ਚੁਗਲ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kee vaddiaaiee vaddee hai jaa na suniee kahiaa chugal kaa ||
verses.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He does not hear the words of the back-biters.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਅਪੁਛਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਕਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har kee vaddiaaiee vaddee hai apuchhiaa dhaan dhevakaa ||6||
verses.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He gives His Gifts without being asked. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਈ ਸੰਪਉ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau karatee sabh muiee sa(n)pau kisai na naal ||
verses.translation: Those who act in ego shall all die. Their worldly possessions shall not go along with them.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਜੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai dhukh paiaa sabh johee jamakaal ||
verses.translation: Because of their love of duality, they suffer in pain. The Messenger of Death is watching all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh ubare saachaa naam samaal ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, by contemplating the True Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਲਂੀ ਅਸੀ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਆਚਾਰੀ ਬੁਰੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: gala(n)ee asee cha(n)geeaa aachaaree bureeaaeh ||
verses.translation: We are good at talking, but our actions are bad.

verses.original: ਮਨਹੁ ਕੁਸੁਧਾ ਕਾਲੀਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਚਿਟਵੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: manahu kusudhaa kaaleeaa baahar chiTaveeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Mentally, we are impure and black, but outwardly, we appear white.

verses.original: ਰੀਸਾ ਕਰਿਹ ਤਿਨਾੜੀਆ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: reesaa kareh tinaaReeaa jo seveh dhar khaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: We imitate those who stand and serve at the Lord's Door.

verses.original: ਨਾਲਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਲੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: naal khasamai rateeaa maaneh sukh raleeaaeh ||
verses.translation: They are attuned to the Love of their Husband Lord, and they experience the pleasure of His Love.

verses.original: ਹੋਦੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਨਿਤਾਣੀਆ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਨਣੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: hodhai taan nitaaneeaa raheh nimaananeeaaeh ||
verses.translation: They remain powerless, even while they have power; they remain humble and meek.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak janam sakaarathaa je tin kai sa(n)g milaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, our lives become profitable if we associate with them. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape jal meenaa hai aape aape hee aap jaal ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the water, You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇਬਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape jaal vataidhaa aape vich sebaal ||
verses.translation: You Yourself cast the net, and You Yourself are the bait.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੈ ਹਥਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape kamal alipat hai sai hathaa vich gulaal ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the lotus, unaffected and still brightly-colored in hundreds of feet of water.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਖਿਆਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape mukat karaidhaa ik nimakh ghaRee kar khiaal ||
verses.translation: You Yourself liberate those who think of You for even an instant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har tudhahu baahar kichh nahee gur sabadhee vekh nihaal ||7||
verses.translation: O Lord, nothing is beyond You. I am delighted to behold You, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam na jaanai bahutaa rovai ||
verses.translation: One who does not know the Hukam of the Lord's Command cries out in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੋਖਾ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar dhokhaa needh na sovai ||
verses.translation: She is filled with deception, and she cannot sleep in peace.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਖਸਮੈ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: je dhan khasamai chalai rajaiee || dhar ghar sobhaa mahal bulaiee ||
verses.translation: But if the soul-bride follows the Will of her Lord and Master, she shall be honored in her own home, and called to the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak karamee ieh mat paiee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Mercy, this understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sach samaiee ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, she is absorbed into the True One. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh naam vihooniaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bhaa dhekh na bhul ||
verses.translation: O self-willed manmukh, devoid of the Naam, do not be misled upon beholding the color of the safflower.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜਿਆ ਛੋਛਾ ਇਸ ਦਾ ਮੁਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: eis kaa ra(n)g dhin thoRiaa chhochhaa is dhaa mul ||
verses.translation: Its color lasts for only a few days-it is worthless!

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai lage pach mue moorakh a(n)dh gavaar ||
verses.translation: Attached to duality, the foolish, blind and stupid people waste away and die.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟ ਸੇ ਪਇ ਪਚਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bisaTaa a(n)dhar keeT se pi pacheh vaaro vaar ||
verses.translation: Like worms, they live in manure, and in it, they die over and over again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate se ra(n)gule gur kai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are dyed in the color of truth; they take on the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagatee ra(n)g na utarai sahaje rahai samai ||2||
verses.translation: The color of devotional worship does not fade away; they remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sisaT upaiee sabh tudh aape rijak sa(n)baahiaa ||
verses.translation: You created the entire universe, and You Yourself bring sustenance to it.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਵਦੇ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਢਾਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik val chhal kar kai khaavadhe muhahu kooR kusat tinee ddaahiaa ||
verses.translation: Some eat and survive by practicing fraud and deceit; from their mouths they drop falsehood and lies.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਓਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਓਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape bhaavai so kareh tudh otai ka(n)m oi laiaa ||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You assign them their tasks.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਅਤੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa sach bujhaion tinaa atuT bha(n)ddaar dhevaiaa ||
verses.translation: Some understand Truthfulness; they are given the inexhaustible treasure.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਚੇਤਾ ਹਥ ਤਡਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: har chet khaeh tinaa safal hai achetaa hath taddaiaa ||8||
verses.translation: Those who eat by remembering the Lord are prosperous, while those who do not remember Him stretch out their hands in need. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR pa(n)ddit bedh vakhaaneh maiaa moh suaai ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, constantly read and recite the Vedas, for the sake of the love of Maya.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai har naam visaariaa man moorakh milai sajai ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, the foolish people have forgotten the Lord's Name; they shall receive their punishment.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਜੋ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin jeeau pi(n)dd dhitaa tis kabahoo(n) na chetai jo dhe(n)dhaa rijak sa(n)baeh ||
verses.translation: They never think of the One who gave them body and soul, who provides sustenance to all.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਗਲਹੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jam kaa faahaa galahu na kaTeeaai fir fir aavai jai ||
verses.translation: The noose of death shall not be cut away from their necks; they shall come and go in reincarnation over and over again.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kichhoo na soojhai a(n)dhule poorab likhiaa kamai ||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything. They do what they are pre-ordained to do.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag satigur milai sukhadhaataa naam vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: Through perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace, and the Naam comes to abide in the mind.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh maaneh sukh painanaa sukhe sukh vihai ||
verses.translation: They enjoy peace, they wear peace, and they pass their lives in the peace of peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak so naau manahu na visaareeaai jit dhar sachai sobhaa pai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they do not forget the Naam from the mind; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sukh paiaa sach naam gunataas ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained. The True Name is the Treasure of Excellence.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee aap pachhaaniaa raam naam paragaas ||
verses.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and recognize your own self; the Divine Light of the Lord's Name shall shine within.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: sacho sach kamaavanaa vaddiaaiee vadde paas ||
verses.translation: The true ones practice Truth; greatness rests in the Great Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kaa sifat kare aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Body, soul and all things belong to the Lord-praise Him, and offer your prayers to Him.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh saalaahanaa sukhe sukh nivaas ||
verses.translation: Sing the Praises of the True Lord through the Word of His Shabad, and you shall abide in the peace of peace.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam manai maeh bin naavai dhirag jeevaas ||
verses.translation: You may practice chanting, penance and austere self-discipline within your mind, but without the Name, life is useless.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee naau paieeaai manmukh moh vinaas ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained, while the self-willed manmukh wastes away in emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too(n) naanak teraa dhaas ||2||
verses.translation: Please protect me, by the Pleasure of Your Will. Nanak is Your slave. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਸੁ ਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko teraa too(n) sabhas dhaa too(n) sabhanaa raas ||
verses.translation: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You are the wealth of all.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tudhai paasahu ma(n)gadhe nit kar aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) dheh tis sabh kichh milai ikanaa dhoor hai paas ||
verses.translation: Those, unto whom You give, receive everything. You are far away from some, and You are close to others.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: tudh baajhahu thaau ko naahee jis paasahu ma(n)geeaai man vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is not even a place to stand begging. See this yourself and verify it in your mind.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sabh tudhai no saalaahadhe dhar gurmukhaa no paragaas ||9||
verses.translation: All praise You, O Lord; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਉਚਾ ਕੂਕਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paR paR uchaa kookadhaa maiaa moh piaar ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read, and shout out loud, but they are attached to the love of Maya.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਈ ਮਨਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar braham na cheeniee man moorakh gaavaar ||
verses.translation: They do not recognize God within themselves-they are so foolish and ignorant!

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਦਾ ਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai jagat parabodhadhaa naa boojhai beechaar ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, they try to teach the world, but they do not understand meditative contemplation.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: birathaa janam gavaiaa mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaar ||1||
verses.translation: They lose their lives uselessly; they die, only to be re-born, over and over again. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinee satigur seviaa tinee naau paiaa boojhahu kar beechaar ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this and understand.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa saa(n)t sukh man vasai chookai kook pukaar ||
verses.translation: Eternal peace and joy abide in their minds; they abandon their cries and complaints.

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਨੋ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aapai no aap khai man niramal hovai gur sabadhee veechaar ||
verses.translation: Their identity consumes their identical identity, and their minds become pure by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadh rate se mukat hai har jeeau het piaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, attuned to the Shabad, they are liberated. They love their Beloved Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kee sevaa safal hai gurmukh paavai thai ||
verses.translation: Service to the Lord is fruitful; through it, the Gurmukh is honored and approved.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis har bhaavai tis gur milai so har naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: That person, with whom the Lord is pleased, meets with the Guru, and meditates on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee har paieeaai har paar laghai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. The Lord carries us across.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh kinai na paio puchhahu vedhaa jai ||
verses.translation: Through stubborn-mindedness, none have found Him; go and consult the Vedas on this.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak har kee sevaa so kare jis le har lai ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone serves the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਅਹੰਕਰਣੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak so sooraa vareeaam jin vichahu dhusaT aha(n)karan maariaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he is a brave warrior, who conquers and subdues his vicious inner ego.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam saalaeh janam savaariaa ||
verses.translation: Praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukhs redeem their lives.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap hoaa sadhaa mukat sabh kul nisataariaa ||
verses.translation: They themselves are liberated forever, and they save all their ancestors.

verses.original: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਚਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sohan sach dhuaar naam piaariaa ||
verses.translation: Those who love the Naam look beauteous at the Gate of Truth.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਗਾੜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mareh aha(n)kaar maran vigaaRiaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs die in egotism-even their death is painfully ugly.

verses.original: ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabho varatai hukam kiaa kareh vichaariaa ||
verses.translation: Everything happens according to the Lord's Will; what can the poor people do?

verses.original: ਆਪਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapahu dhoojai lag khasam visaariaa ||
verses.translation: Attached to self-conceit and duality, they have forgotten their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bin naavai sabh dhukh sukh visaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, everything is painful, and happiness is forgotten. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har naam dhiRaiaa tin vichahu bharam chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. It has dispelled my doubts from within.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam har keerat gaiee kar chaanan mag dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I sing the Lord's Name and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the Divine Light shines, and now I see the Way.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar ek liv laagee a(n)tar naam vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Conquering my ego, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord; the Naam has come to dwell within me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee jam joh na saakai saachai naam samaiaa ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I cannot be touched by the Messenger of Death. I am absorbed in the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aape aap varatai karataa jo bhaavai so nai laiaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself is All-pervading everywhere; He links those with whom He is pleased to His Name.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam le taa jeevai bin naavai khin mar jaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would die in an instant. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਸਭਨੀ ਦੀਬਾਣੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo miliaa har dheebaan siau so sabhanee dheebaanee miliaa ||
verses.translation: One who is accepted at the Court of the Lord shall be accepted in courts everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਰਖਰੂ ਉਸ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਸਭ ਪਾਪੀ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jithai oh jai tithai oh surakharoo us kai muh ddiThai sabh paapee tariaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever he goes, he is recognized as honorable. Seeing his face, all sinners are saved.

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਵਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: os a(n)tar naam nidhaan hai naamo paravariaa ||
verses.translation: Within him is the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Through the Naam, he is exalted.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naau poojeeaai naau ma(n)neeaai nai kilavikh sabh hiriaa ||
verses.translation: He worships the Name, and believes in the Name; the Name erases all his sinful mistakes.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jinee naam dhiaaiaa ik man ik chit se asathir jag rahiaa ||11||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Name, with one-pointed mind and focused consciousness, remain forever stable in the world. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਤਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aatamaa dheau poojeeaai gur kai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Worship the Divine, Supreme Soul, with the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.

verses.original: ਆਤਮੇ ਨੋ ਆਤਮੇ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aatame no aatame dhee prateet hoi taa ghar hee parachaa pai ||
verses.translation: If the individual soul has faith in the Supreme Soul, then it shall obtain realization within its own home.

verses.original: ਆਤਮਾ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aatamaa addol na ddoliee gur kai bhai subhai ||
verses.translation: The soul becomes steady, and does not waver, by the natural inclination of the Guru's Loving Will.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur vin sahaj na aaviee lobh mail na vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, intuitive wisdom does not come, and the filth of greed does not depart from within.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khin pal har naam man vasai sabh aThasaTh teerath nai ||
verses.translation: If the Lord's Name abides within the mind, for a moment, even for an instant, it is like bathing at all the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sache mail na lagiee mal laagai dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: Filth does not stick to those who are true, but filth attaches itself to those who love duality.

verses.original: ਧੋਤੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhotee mool na utarai je aThasaTh teerath nai ||
verses.translation: This filth cannot be washed off, even by bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh karam kare aha(n)kaaree sabh dhukho dhukh kamai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh does deeds in egotism; he earns only pain and more pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈਲਾ ਊਜਲੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak mailaa uoojal taa theeaai jaa satigur maeh samai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the filthy ones become clean only when they meet and surrender to the True Guru. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਕਦਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh lok samajhaieeaai kadhahu samajhaiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs may be taught, but how can they really be taught?

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh ralaiaa naa ralai piaai kirat firai ||
verses.translation: The manmukhs do not fit in at all. Because of their past actions, they are condemned to the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਲਿਵ ਧਾਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: liv dhaat dhui raeh hai hukamee kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: Loving attention to the Lord and attachment to Maya are the two separate ways; all act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aapanaa man maariaa sabadh kasavaTee lai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh has conquered his own mind, by applying the Touchstone of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਝਗੜਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਥ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man hee naal jhagaRaa man hee naal sath man hee ma(n)jh samai ||
verses.translation: He fights with his mind, he settles with his mind, and he is at peace with his mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man jo ichhe so lahai sachai sabadh subhai ||
verses.translation: All obtain the desires of their minds, through the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam sadh bhu(n)cheeaai gurmukh kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam forever; this is how the Gurmukhs act.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਲੁਝਣਾ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin manai j horee naal lujhanaa jaasee janam gavai ||
verses.translation: Those who struggle with something other than their own mind, shall depart having wasted their lives.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukhee manahaTh haariaa kooR kusat kamai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs, through stubborn-mindedness and the practice of falsehood, lose the game of life.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee man jinai har setee liv lai ||
verses.translation: Those who conquer their own mind, by Guru's Grace, lovingly focus their attention on the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sach kamaavai manmukh aavai jai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs practice Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t sunahu jan bhaiee har satigur kee ik saakhee ||
verses.translation: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen, and hear the Lord's Teachings, through the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhur bhaag hovai mukh masatak tin jan lai hiradhai raakhee ||
verses.translation: Those who have good destiny pre-ordained and inscribed on their foreheads, grasp it and keep it enshrined in the heart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਊਤਮ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਚਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mirat kathaa saresaT uootam gur bachanee sahaje chaakhee ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, they intuitively taste the sublime, exquisite and ambrosial sermon of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੂਰਜ ਰੈਣਿ ਕਿਰਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: teh bhiaa pragaas miTiaa a(n)dhiaaraa jiau sooraj rain kiraakhee ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light shines in their hearts, and like the sun which removes the darkness of night, it dispels the darkness of ignorance.

verses.original: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: adhisaT agochar alakh nira(n)jan so dhekhiaa gurmukh aakhee ||12||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, they behold with their eyes the Unseen, Imperceptible, Unknowable, Immaculate Lord. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve aapanaa so sir lekhai lai ||
verses.translation: Those who serve their True Guru are certified and accepted.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਹਨਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vichahu aap gavai kai rahan sach liv lai ||
verses.translation: They eradicate selfishness and conceit from within; they remain lovingly absorbed in the True One.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jinee na sevio tinaa birathaa janam gavai ||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru waste away their lives in vain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord does just as He pleases. No one has any say in this. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਵੇਕਾਰਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man vekaaree veRiaa vekaaraa karam kamai ||
verses.translation: With the mind encircled by wickedness and evil, people do evil deeds.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੂਜਦੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai agiaanee poojadhe dharageh milai sajai ||
verses.translation: The ignorant worship the love of duality; in the Lord's Court they shall be punished.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਦੇਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aatam dheau poojeeaai bin satigur boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: So worship the Lord, the Light of the soul; without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam bhaanaa satiguroo kaa karamee palai pai ||
verses.translation: Meditation, penance and austere self-discipline are found by surrendering to the True Guru's Will. By His Grace this is received.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sevaa surat kamaavanee jo har bhaavai so thai pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, serve with this intuitive awareness; only that which is pleasing to the Lord is approved. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu man mere jit sadhaa sukh hovai dhin raatee ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; it will bring you eternal peace, day and night.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu man mere jit simarat sabh kilavikh paap lahaatee ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; meditating on it, all sins and misdeeds shall be erased.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu man mere jit dhaaladh dhukh bhukh sabh leh jaatee ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; through it, all poverty, pain and hunger shall be removed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu man mere mukh gurmukh preet lagaatee ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; as Gurmukh, declare your love.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਤੀ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jit mukh bhaag likhiaa dhur saachai har tit mukh naam japaatee ||13||
verses.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead by the True Lord, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jinee na sevio sabadh na keeto veechaar ||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar giaan na aaio mritak hai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: -spiritual wisdom does not enter into their hearts; they are like dead bodies in the world.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh fer piaa mar ja(n)mai hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: They go through the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations, and they are ruined through death and rebirth.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa so kare jis no aap karaae soi ||
verses.translation: He alone serves the True Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vich naam nidhaan hai karam paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: The Treasure of the Naam is within the True Guru; by His Grace, it is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach rate gur sabadh siau tin sachee sadhaa liv hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who are truly attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad-their love is forever True.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jis no mele na vichhuRai sahaj samaavai soi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are united with Him shall not be separated again. They merge imperceptibly into God. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੋੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: so bhagautee juo bhagava(n)tai jaanai ||
verses.translation: One who knows the Benevolent Lord God is the true devotee of Bhagaautee.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee aap pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he is self-realized.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat raakhai ikat ghar aanai ||
verses.translation: He restrains his wandering mind, and brings it back to its own home within the self.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai har naam vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: He remains dead while yet alive, and he chants the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa bhagautee utam hoi ||
verses.translation: Such a Bhagaautee is most exalted.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sach samaavai soi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he merges into the True One. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kapaT bhagautee kahaae ||
verses.translation: He is full of deceit, and yet he calls himself a devotee of Bhagaautee.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd paarabraham kadhe na paae ||
verses.translation: Through hypocrisy, he shall never attain the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: par ni(n)dhaa kare a(n)tar mal laae ||
verses.translation: He slanders others, and pollutes himself with his own filth.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: baahar mal dhovai man kee jooTh na jaae ||
verses.translation: Outwardly, he washes off the filth, but the impurity of his mind does not go away.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat siau baadh rachaae ||
verses.translation: He argues with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin dhukheeaa dhoojai bhai rachaae ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he suffers, engrossed in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har naam na chetai bahu karam kamaae ||
verses.translation: He does not remember the Name of the Lord, but still, he performs all sorts of empty rituals.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa su meTanaa na jaae ||
verses.translation: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak bin satigur seve mokh na paae ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੇ ਕੜਿ ਨ ਸਵਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jinee dhiaaiaa se kaR na savaahee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the True Guru shall not be burnt to ashes.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jinee dhiaaiaa se tirapat aghaahee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the True Guru are satisfied and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਡਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jinee dhiaaiaa tin jam ddar naahee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the True Guru are not afraid of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau hoaa kirapaal har se satigur pairee paahee ||
verses.translation: Those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, fall at the Feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: tin aaithai othai mukh ujale har dharageh paidhe jaahee ||14||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, their faces are radiant; they go to the Lord's Court in robes of honor. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਂਈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਡਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo sir saa(n)iee naa nivai so sir dheejai ddaar ||
verses.translation: Chop off that head which does not bow to the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jis pi(n)jar meh birahaa nahee so pi(n)jar lai jaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that human body, in which there is no pain of separation from the Lord-take that body and burn it. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਈਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)ddahu bhulee naanakaa fir fir janam muieeaas ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Primal Lord, O Nanak, people are born and die, over and over again.

verses.original: ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਕੈ ਭੋਲੜੈ ਗੰਦੇ ਡੁੰਮਿ ਪਈਆਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kasatooree kai bholaRai ga(n)dhe ddu(n)m pieeaas ||2||
verses.translation: Mistaking it for musk, they have fallen into the stinking pit of filth. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: so aaisaa har naam dhiaaieeaai man mere jo sabhanaa upar hukam chalaae ||
verses.translation: Meditate on that Name of the Lord, O my mind, whose Command rules over all.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: so aaisaa har naam japeeaai man mere jo a(n)tee aausar le chhaddaae ||
verses.translation: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which will save you at the very last moment.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: so aaisaa har naam japeeaai man mere ju man kee tirasanaa sabh bhukh gavaae ||
verses.translation: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which shall drive out all hunger and desire from your mind.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: so gurmukh naam japiaa vaddabhaagee tin ni(n)dhak dhusaT sabh pairee paae ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate and blessed is that Gurmukh who chants the Naam; it shall bring all slanderers and wicked enemies to fall at his feet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam araadh sabhanaa te vaddaa sabh naavai agai aan nivaae ||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Greatest Name of all, before which all come and bow. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ves kare kuroop kulakhanee man khoTai kooRiaar ||
verses.translation: She may wear good clothes, but the bride is ugly and rude; her mind is false and impure.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਨਾ ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਗਾਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pir kai bhaanai naa chalai hukam kare gaavaar ||
verses.translation: She does not walk in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord. Instead, she foolishly gives Him orders.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai sabh dhukh nivaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: But she who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, shall be spared all pain and suffering.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: likhiaa meT na sakeeaai jo dhur likhiaa karataar ||
verses.translation: That destiny which was pre-ordained by the Creator cannot be erased.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੇ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man tan saupe ka(n)t kau sabadhe dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: She must dedicate her mind and body to her Husband Lord, and enshrine love for the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai kinai na paiaa dhekhahu ridhai beechaar ||
verses.translation: Without His Name, no one has found Him; see this and reflect upon it in your heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸੁਆਲਿਓ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਜਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saa suaalio sulakhanee j raavee sirajanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she is beautiful and graceful; the Creator Lord ravishes and enjoys her. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh gubaar hai tis dhaa na dhisai uravaar na paar ||
verses.translation: Attachment to Maya is an ocean of darkness; neither this shore nor the one beyond can be seen.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh agiaanee mahaa dhukh paidhe ddube har naam visaar ||
verses.translation: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs suffer in terrible pain; they forget the Lord's Name and drown.

verses.original: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhalake uTh bahu karam kamaaveh dhoojai bhai piaar ||
verses.translation: They arise in the morning and perform all sorts of rituals, but they are caught in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh aapanaa bhaujal utare paar ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sach samaaveh sach naam ur dhaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts; they are absorbed into the True One. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jal thal maheeal bharapoor dhoojaa naeh koi ||
verses.translation: The Lord pervades and permeates the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਸਭ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har aap beh kare niaau kooRiaar sabh maar kaddoi ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself sits upon His Throne and administers justice. He beats and drives out the false-hearted.

verses.original: ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਉ ਕੀਓਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachiaaraa dhei vaddiaaiee har dharam niaau keeoi ||
verses.translation: The Lord bestows glorious greatness upon those who are truthful. He administers righteous justice.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਗਰੀਬ ਅਨਾਥ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh har kee karahu usatat jin gareeb anaath raakh leeoi ||
verses.translation: So praise the Lord, everybody; He protects the poor and the lost souls.

verses.original: ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਧਰਮੀਆ ਕਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੀਓਇ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: jaikaar keeo dharameeaa kaa paapee kau dda(n)dd dheeoi ||16||
verses.translation: He honors the righteous and punishes the sinners. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mailee kaamanee kulakhanee kunaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh, the foolish bride, is a filthy, rude and evil wife.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pir chhoddiaa ghar aapanaa par purakhai naal piaar ||
verses.translation: Forsaking her Husband Lord and leaving her own home, she gives her love to another.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa kadhe na chukiee jaladhee kare pookaar ||
verses.translation: Her desires are never satisfied, and she burns and cries out in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਸੋਹਣੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bin naavai kuroop kusohanee parahar chhoddee bhataar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, she is ugly and ungraceful. She is abandoned and left behind by her Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ratee sohaaganee satigur kai bhai piaar ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-bride is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; she is in love with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa raave pir aapanaa sachai prem piaar ||
verses.translation: She continually enjoys and ravishes her Beloved, with true love and affection.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: at suaaliau su(n)dharee sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
verses.translation: She is such a loveable, beautiful and noble woman.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੇਲੀ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam sohaaganee melee melanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, the happy soul-bride unites with the Lord of Union. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har teree sabh kareh usatat jin faathe kaaddiaa ||
verses.translation: Lord, everyone sings Your Praises. You have freed us from bondage.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਪੈ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har tudhano kareh sabh namasakaar jin paapai te raakhiaa ||
verses.translation: Lord, everyone bows in reverence to You. You have saved us from our sinful ways.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਡਾਢੀ ਹੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਡਾਢਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har nimaaniaa too(n) maan har ddaaddee hoo(n) too(n) ddaaddiaa ||
verses.translation: Lord, You are the Honor of the dishonored. Lord, You are the Strongest of the strong.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har aha(n)kaareeaa maar nivaae manmukh mooR saadhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord beats down the egocentrics and corrects the foolish, self-willed manmukhs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗਰੀਬ ਅਨਾਥਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa dhei vaddiaaiee gareeb anaathiaa ||17||
verses.translation: The Lord bestows glorious greatness on His devotees, the poor, and the lost souls. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai tis vaddiaaiee vaddee hoi ||
verses.translation: One who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, obtains the greatest glory.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam utam man vasai meT na sakai koi ||
verses.translation: The Exalted Name of the Lord abides in his mind, and no one can take it away.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare jis aapanee tis karam paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Grace, receives His Mercy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaran karate vas hai gurmukh boojhai koi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, creativity is under the control of the Creator; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this! ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naanak har naam jinee aaraadhiaa anadhin har liv taar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who worship and adore the Lord's Name night and day, vibrate the String of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਦੀ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਨ ਅਗੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ba(n)dhee khasam kee tin agai kamaavai kaar ||
verses.translation: Maya, the maid-servant of our Lord and Master, serves them.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: poorai pooraa kar chhoddiaa hukam savaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: The Perfect One has made them perfect; by the Hukam of His Command, they are embellished.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jin bujhiaa tin paiaa mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they understand Him, and they find the gate of salvation.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh hukam na jaananee tin maare jam ja(n)dhaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Lord's Command; they are beaten down by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jinee araadhiaa tinee tariaa bhaujal sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: But the Gurmukhs, who worship and adore the Lord, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh aaugan gunee miTaiaa gur aape bakhasanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: All their demerits are erased, and replaced with merits. The Guru Himself is their Forgiver. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagataa parateet har sabh kichh jaanadhaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees have faith in Him. The Lord knows everything.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jevadd naahee koiee jaan har dharam beechaaradhaa ||
verses.translation: No one is as great a Knower as the Lord; the Lord administers righteous justice.

verses.original: ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਧਰਮਿ ਮਾਰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaaRaa a(n)dhesaa kiau keejai jaa naahee adharam maaradhaa ||
verses.translation: Why should we feel any burning anxiety, since the Lord does not punish without just cause?

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਰੁ ਹਾਰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib sach niaau paapee nar haaradhaa ||
verses.translation: True is the Master, and True is His Justice; only the sinners are defeated.

verses.original: ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਤਾਰਦਾ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: saalaahih bhagatahu kar joR har bhagat jan taaradhaa ||18||
verses.translation: O devotees, praise the Lord with your palms pressed together; the Lord saves His humble devotees. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapane preetam mil rahaa a(n)tar rakhaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Oh, if only I could meet my Beloved, and keep Him enshrined deep within my heart!

verses.original: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saalaahee so prabh sadhaa sadhaa gur kai het piaar ||
verses.translation: I praise that God forever and ever, through love and affection for the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jis nadhar kare tis mel le saiee suhaagan naar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that one upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace is united with Him; such a person is the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te har paieeaai jaa kau nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, the Lord is obtained, when He bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਭਏ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maanas te dhevate bhe dhiaaiaa naam hare ||
verses.translation: They are transformed from humans into angels, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar milaian gur kai sabadh tare ||
verses.translation: They conquer their egotism and merge with the Lord; they are saved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaj samaian har aapanee kirapaa kare ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they merge imperceptibly into the Lord, who has bestowed His Favor upon them. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਾਲੀਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har aapanee bhagat karai vaddiaaiee vekhaaleean ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself inspires us to worship Him; He reveals His Glorious Greatness.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਘਾਲੀਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee aap kare parateet aape sev ghaaleean ||
verses.translation: He Himself inspires us to place our faith in Him. Thus He performs His Own Service.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਬਹਾਲਿਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa no dhei ana(n)dh thir gharee bahaalian ||
verses.translation: The Lord bestows bliss upon His devotees, and gives them a seat in the eternal home.

verses.original: ਪਾਪੀਆ ਨੋ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰਿ ਚਾਲਿਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: paapeeaa no na dheiee thir rahan chun narak ghor chaalian ||
verses.translation: He does not give the sinners any stability or place of rest; He consigns them to the depths of hell.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa no dhei piaar kar a(n)g nisataarian ||19||
verses.translation: The Lord blesses His devotees with His Love; He sides with them and saves them. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਡੂਮਣੀ ਕੁਦਇਆ ਕਸਾਇਣਿ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਘਟ ਚੂਹੜੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਚੰਡਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: kubudh ddoomanee kudhiaa kasain par ni(n)dhaa ghaT choohaRee muThee karodh cha(n)ddaal ||
verses.translation: False-mindedness is the drummer-woman; cruelty is the butcheress; slander of others in one's heart is the cleaning-woman, and deceitful anger is the outcast-woman.

verses.original: ਕਾਰੀ ਕਢੀ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੈਠੀਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaaree kaddee kiaa theeaai jaa(n) chaare baiTheeaa naal ||
verses.translation: What good are the ceremonial lines drawn around your kitchen, when these four are seated there with you?

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰਾਂ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)jam karanee kaaraa(n) naavan naau japehee ||
verses.translation: Make Truth your self-discipline, and make good deeds the lines you draw; make chanting the Name your cleansing bath.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਊਤਮ ਸੇਈ ਜਿ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak agai uootam seiee j paapaa(n) pa(n)dh na dhehee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who do not walk in the ways of sin, shall be exalted in the world hereafter. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ha(n)s kiaa bagulaa jaa kau nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: Which is the swan, and which is the crane? It is only by His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa kaagahu ha(n)s karei ||2||
verses.translation: Whoever is pleasing to Him, O Nanak, is transformed from a crow into a swan. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਕੰਮੁ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa loReeaai ka(n)mu su har peh aakheeaai ||
verses.translation: Whatever work you wish to accomplish-tell it to the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kaaraj dhei savaar satigur sach saakheeaai ||
verses.translation: He will resolve your affairs; the True Guru gives His Guarantee of Truth.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa sa(n)g nidhaan a(n)mrit chaakheeaai ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, you shall taste the treasure of the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bha(n)jan miharavaan dhaas kee raakheeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Merciful Destroyer of fear; He preserves and protects His slaves.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਲਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਖੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
