verses.translit: naanak har gun gai alakh prabh laakheeaai ||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and see the Unseen Lord God. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kaa sabhasai dhei adhaar ||
verses.translation: Body and soul, all belong to Him. He gives His Support to all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh seveeaai sadhaa sadhaa dhaataar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, become Gurmukh and serve Him, who is forever and ever the Giver.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree tin kau jin dhiaaiaa har nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: onaa ke mukh sadh ujale onaa no sabh jagat kare namasakaar ||1||
verses.translation: Their faces are forever radiant, and the whole world bows in reverence to them. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਖਰਚਿਉ ਖਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai ulaTee bhiee nav nidh kharachiau khaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, I am totally transformed; I have obtained the nine treasures to use and consume.

verses.original: ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਿਧੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗੀਆ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aThaareh sidhee pichhai lageeaa firan nij ghar vasai nij thai ||
verses.translation: The Siddhis-the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers-follow in my footsteps; I dwell in my own home, within my own self.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਸਦ ਵਜਦੇ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh dhunee sadh vajadhe unaman har liv lai ||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Melody constantly vibrates within; my mind is exalted and uplifted-I am lovingly absorbed in the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak har bhagat tinaa kai man vasai jin masatak likhiaa dhur pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, devotion to the Lord abides within the minds of those who have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau ddaaddee har prabh khasam kaa har kai dhar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a minstrel of the Lord God, my Lord and Master; I have come to the Lord's Door.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਪੂਕਾਰ ਢਾਢੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)dhar sunee pookaar ddaaddee mukh laiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has heard my sad cries from within; He has called me, His minstrel, into His Presence.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਢਾਢੀ ਸਦਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਅਰਥਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har puchhiaa ddaaddee sadh kai kit arath too(n) aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord called His minstrel in, and asked, ""Why have you come here?""

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nit dhevahu dhaan dhiaal prabh har naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: "O Merciful God, please grant me the gift of continual meditation on the Lord's Name."

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
verses.translit: har dhaatai har naam japaiaa naanak painaiaa ||21||1|| sudhu
verses.translation: And so the Lord, the Great Giver, inspired Nanak to chant the Lord's Name, and blessed him with robes of honor. ||21||1||Sudh||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ॥ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ
verses.translit: sireeraag kabeer jeeau kaa || ek suaan kai ghar gaavanaa
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Kabeer Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of ""Ayk Su-Aan"" :

verses.original: ਜਨਨੀ ਜਾਨਤ ਸੁਤੁ ਬਡਾ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਤਨਾ ਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਅਵਧ ਘਟਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jananee jaanat sut baddaa hot hai itanaa k na jaanai j dhin dhin avadh ghaTat hai ||
verses.translation: The mother thinks that her son is growing up; she does not understand that, day by day, his life is diminishing.

verses.original: ਮੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਾਡੁ ਧਰਿ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਜਮਰਾਉ ਹਸੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mor mor kar adhik laadd dhar pekhat hee jamaraau hasai ||1||
verses.translation: Calling him, ""Mine, mine"", she fondles him lovingly, while the Messenger of Death looks on and laughs. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਤੈਂ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa tai(n) jag bharam laiaa ||
verses.translation: You have misled the world so deeply in doubt.

verses.original: ਕੈਸੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਬ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaise boojhai jab mohiaa hai maiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How can people understand You, when they are entranced by Maya? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer chhodd bikhiaa ras it sa(n)gat nihachau maranaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, give up the pleasures of corruption, or else you will surely die of them.

verses.original: ਰਮਈਆ ਜਪਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਅਨਤ ਜੀਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ramieeaa japahu praanee anat jeevan baanee in bidh bhav saagar taranaa ||2||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, O mortal being, through the Word of His Bani; you shall be blessed with eternal life. In this way, shall you cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) tis bhaavai taa laagai bhaau ||
verses.translation: As it pleases Him, people embrace love for the Lord,

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulaavaa vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: and doubt and delusion are dispelled from within.

verses.original: ਉਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: aupajai sahaj giaan mat jaagai ||
verses.translation: Intuitive peace and poise well up within, and the intellect is awakened to spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh a(n)tar liv laagai ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the inner being is touched by the Lord's Love. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eit sa(n)gat naahee maranaa ||
verses.translation: In this association, there is no death.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: hukam pachhaan taa khasamai milanaa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||
verses.translation: Recognizing the Hukam of His Command, you shall meet with your Lord and Master. ||1||Second Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag tiralochan kaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Trilochan:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਗਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਉ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh man aagalaRaa praanee jaraa maran bhau visar giaa ||
verses.translation: The mind is totally attached to Maya; the mortal has forgotten his fear of old age and death.

verses.original: ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਕਪਟ ਨਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kuTa(n)b dhekh bigaseh kamalaa jiau par ghar joheh kapaT naraa ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon his family, he blossoms forth like the lotus flower; the deceitful person watches and covets the homes of others. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੂੜਾ ਆਇਓਹਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਤਣਾ ॥ ਤਿਨ ਆਗਲੜੈ ਮੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhooRaa aaioh jameh tanaa || tin aagalaRai mai rahan na jai ||
verses.translation: When the powerful Messenger of Death comes, no one can stand against his awesome power.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਣੁ ਆਇ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: koiee koiee saajan aai kahai ||
verses.translation: Rare, very rare, is that friend who comes and says,

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਲੈ ਬਾਹੜੀ ਵਲਾਇ ॥ ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਆ ਮੈ ਲੇਹਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil mere beeThulaa lai baahaRee valai || mil mere ramieeaa mai leh chhaddai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: "O my Beloved, take me into Your Embrace! O my Lord, please save me!"||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਗ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਪੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anik anik bhog raaj bisare praanee sa(n)saar saagar pai amar bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Indulging in all sorts of princely pleasures, O mortal, you have forgotten God; you have fallen into the world-ocean, and you think that you have become immortal.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠਾ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਆਲਸੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maiaa mooThaa chetas naahee janam gavaio aalaseeaa ||2||
verses.translation: Cheated and plundered by Maya, you do not think of God, and you waste your life in laziness. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਖਮ ਘੋਰ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਾਲਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਤਹ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੰ ॥
verses.translit: bikham ghor pa(n)th chaalanaa praanee rav sas teh na pravesa(n) ||
verses.translation: The path you must walk is treacherous and terrifying, O mortal; neither the sun nor the moon shine there.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਬ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਂ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh tab bisar giaa jaa(n) tajeeale sa(n)saara(n) ||3||
verses.translation: Your emotional attachment to Maya will be forgotten, when you have to leave this world. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਜੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਪੇਖੀਅਲੇ ਧਰਮਰਾਓ ॥
verses.translit: aaj merai man pragaT bhiaa hai pekheeale dharamaraao ||
verses.translation: Today, it became clear to my mind that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is watching us.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਕਰ ਦਲ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਹਾਬਲੀ ਤਿਨ ਆਗਲੜੈ ਮੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: teh kar dhal karan mahaabalee tin aagalaRai mai rahan na jai ||4||
verses.translation: His messengers, with their awesome power, crush people between their hands; I cannot stand against them. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੂੰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: je ko moo(n) upadhes karat hai taa van tiran rataRaa naarainaa ||
verses.translation: If someone is going to teach me something, let it be that the Lord is pervading the forests and fields.

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: aai jee too(n) aape sabh kichh jaanadhaa badhat tiralochan raamieeaa ||5||2||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You Yourself know everything; so prays Trilochan, Lord. ||5||2||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: sreeraag bhagat kabeer jeeau kaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Devotee Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਅਚਰਜ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਅਬ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: acharaj ek sunahu re pa(n)ddeeaa ab kichh kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Listen, O religious scholar: the One Lord alone is Wondrous; no one can describe Him.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮੇਖੁਲੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sur nar gan ga(n)dhrab jin mohe tirabhavan mekhulee laiee ||1||
verses.translation: He fascinates the angels, the celestial singers and the heavenly musicians; he has strung the three worlds upon His Thread. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਅਨਹਦ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa raam anahadh ki(n)guree baajai ||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Melody of the Sovereign Lord's Harp vibrates;

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee dhisaT naadh liv laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: by His Glance of Grace, we are lovingly attuned to the Sound-current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਾਠੀ ਗਗਨੁ ਸਿੰਙਿਆ ਅਰੁ ਚੁੰਙਿਆ ਕਨਕ ਕਲਸ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaaThee gagan si(n)n(g)iaa ar chu(n)n(g)iaa kanak kalas ik paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Tenth Gate of my crown chakra is the distilling fire, and the channels of the Ida and Pingala are the funnels, to pour in and empty out the golden vat.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਸਨ ਚੁਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis meh dhaar chuaai at niramal ras meh rasan chuaaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Into that vat, there trickles a gentle stream of the most sublime and pure essence of all distilled essences. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਜੁ ਬਾਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਬਨੀ ਹੈ ਪਵਨ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ek ju baat anoop banee hai pavan piaalaa saajiaa ||
verses.translation: Something wonderful has happened-the breath has become the cup.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: teen bhavan meh eko jogee kahahu kavan hai raajaa ||3||
verses.translation: In all the three worlds, such a Yogi is unique. What king can compare to him? ||3||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮ ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaise giaan pragaTiaa purakhotam kahu kabeer ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: This spiritual wisdom of God, the Supreme Soul, has illuminated my being. Says Kabeer, I am attuned to His Love.

verses.original: ਅਉਰ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaur dhunee sabh bharam bhulaanee man raam rasain maataa ||4||3||
verses.translation: All the rest of the world is deluded by doubt, while my mind is intoxicated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਬੇਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: sreeraag baanee bhagat benee jeeau kee ||
verses.translation: Sree Raag, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee:

verses.original: ਪਹਰਿਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: pahariaa kai ghar gaavanaa ||
verses.translation: To Be Sung To The Tune Of ""Pehray"":

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਜਬ ਆਛਤ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: re nar garabh ku(n)ddal jab aachhat uradh dhiaan liv laagaa ||
verses.translation: O man, when you were coiled in the cradle of the womb, upside-down, you were absorbed in meditation.

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਪਿੰਡਿ ਪਦ ਮਦ ਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਸੁ ਨਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: mritak pi(n)dd padh madh naa ahinis ek agiaan su naagaa ||
verses.translation: You took no pride in your perishable body; night and day were all the same to you-you lived unknowing, in the silence of the void.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਦਿਨ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਕਸਟ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਅਬ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: te dhin sa(n)mal kasaT mahaa dhukh ab chit adhik pasaariaa ||
verses.translation: Remember the terrible pain and suffering of those days, now that you have spread out the net of your consciousness far and wide.

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਆਇਆ ਤਉ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: garabh chhodd mirat ma(n)ddal aaiaa tau narahar manahu bisaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: Leaving the womb, you entered this mortal world; you have forgotten the Lord from your mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿਗਾ ਮੂੜਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਵਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: fir pachhutaavahigaa mooRiaa too(n) kavan kumat bhram laagaa ||
verses.translation: Later, you will regret and repent-you fool! Why are you engrossed in evil-mindedness and skepticism?

verses.original: ਚੇਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਚਰੈ ਅਨਰਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chet raam naahee jam pur jaahigaa jan bicharai anaraadhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Think of the Lord, or else you shall be led to the City of Death. Why are you wandering around, out of control? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਲ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਰਸ ਲਾਗਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: baal binodh chi(n)dh ras laagaa khin khin moh biaapai ||
verses.translation: You play like a child, craving sweets; moment by moment, you become more entangled in emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਰਸੁ ਮਿਸੁ ਮੇਧੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਚਾਖੀ ਤਉ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: ras mis medh a(n)mrit bikh chaakhee tau pa(n)ch pragaT sa(n)taapai ||
verses.translation: Tasting good and bad, you eat nectar and then poison, and then the five passions appear and torture you.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam chhodd sukirat mat raam naam na araadhiaa ||
verses.translation: Abandoning meditation, penance and self-restraint, and the wisdom of good actions, you do not worship and adore the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਉਛਲਿਆ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਲ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਉ ਆਨਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਗਲਿ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: auchhaliaa kaam kaal mat laagee tau aan sakat gal baa(n)dhiaa ||2||
verses.translation: You are overflowing with sexual desire, and your intellect is stained with darkness; you are held in the grip of Shakti's power. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਰੁਣ ਤੇਜੁ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਸਰੁ ਅਪਸਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tarun tej par tria mukh joheh sar apasar na pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: In the heat of youthful passion, you look with desire upon the faces of other men's wives; you do not distinguish between good and evil.

verses.original: ਉਨਮਤ ਕਾਮਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aunamat kaam mahaa bikh bhoolai paap pu(n)n na pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Drunk with sexual desire and other great sins, you go astray, and do not distinguish between vice and virtue.

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਰਬਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੇ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sut sa(n)pat dhekh ih man garabiaa raam ridhai te khoiaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon your children and your property, your mind is proud and arrogant; you cast out the Lord from your heart.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਮਰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਲੇ ਤਉ ਭਗ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਗੋਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: avar marat maiaa man tole tau bhag mukh janam vigoiaa ||3||
verses.translation: When others die, you measure your own wealth in your mind; you waste your life in the pleasures of the mouth and sexual organs. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੁੰਡਰ ਕੇਸ ਕੁਸਮ ਤੇ ਧਉਲੇ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: pu(n)ddar kes kusam te dhaule sapat paataal kee baanee ||
verses.translation: Your hair is whiter than the jasmine flower, and your voice has grown feeble, as if it comes from the seventh underworld.

verses.original: ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਨਾਠੀ ਤਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਪਵਸਿ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: lochan srameh budh bal naaThee taa kaam pavas maadhaanee ||
verses.translation: Your eyes water, and your intellect and strength have left you; but still, your sexual desire churns and drives you on.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੁ ਕੁਮਲਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: taa te bikhai bhiee mat paavas kaiaa kamal kumalaanaa ||
verses.translation: And so, your intellect has dried up through corruption, and the lotus flower of your body has wilted and withered.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਤਿ ਬਾਣਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: avagat baan chhodd mirat ma(n)ddal tau paachhai pachhutaanaa ||4||
verses.translation: You have forsaken the Bani, the Word of the Immortal Lord, in this mortal world; in the end, you shall regret and repent. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਿਕੁਟੀ ਦੇਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਾਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: nikuTee dheh dhekh dhun upajai maan karat nahee boojhai ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the tiny bodies of your children, love has welled up within your heart; you are proud of them, but you do not understand.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: laalach karai jeevan padh kaaran lochan kachhoo na soojhai ||
verses.translation: You long for the dignity of a long life, but your eyes can no longer see anything.

verses.original: ਥਾਕਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਉਡਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਂਗਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: thaakaa tej uddiaa man pa(n)khee ghar aa(n)gan na sukhaiee ||
verses.translation: Your light has gone out, and the bird of your mind has flown away; you are no longer welcome in your own home and courtyard.

verses.original: ਬੇਣੀ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਮਰਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: benee kahai sunahu re bhagatahu maran mukat kin paiee ||5||
verses.translation: Says Baynee, listen, O devotee: who has ever attained liberation after such a death? ||5||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag ||
verses.translation: Sree Raag:

verses.original: ਤੋਹੀ ਮੋਹੀ ਮੋਹੀ ਤੋਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tohee mohee mohee tohee a(n)tar kaisaa ||
verses.translation: You are me, and I am You-what is the difference between us?

verses.original: ਕਨਕ ਕਟਿਕ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜੈਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kanak kaTik jal tara(n)g jaisaa ||1||
verses.translation: We are like gold and the bracelet, or water and the waves. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਹਮ ਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰੰਤਾ ਅਹੇ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jau pai ham na paap kara(n)taa ahe ana(n)taa ||
verses.translation: If I did not commit any sins, O Infinite Lord,

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੁੰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan naam kaise hu(n)taa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: how would You have acquired the name, 'Redeemer of sinners'? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਨਾਇਕ ਆਛਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) ju naik aachhahu a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: You are my Master, the Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਨੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prabh te jan jaaneejai jan te suaamee ||2||
verses.translation: The servant is known by his God, and the Lord and Master is known by His servant. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਦੇਹੂ ॥
verses.translit: sareer aaraadhai mo kau beechaar dhehoo ||
verses.translation: Grant me the wisdom to worship and adore You with my body.

verses.original: ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਮ ਦਲ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਕੋਊ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ravidhaas sam dhal samajhaavai kouoo ||3||
verses.translation: O Ravi Daas, one who understands that the Lord is equally in all, is very rare. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
verses.translit: raag maajh chaupadhe ghar pehilaa mahalaa chauthhaa
verses.translation: Raag Maajh, Chau-Padhay, First House, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam mai har man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee har naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har naam sidh paiee ko viralaa gurmat chalai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has attained spiritual perfection in the Name of the Lord. How rare are those who follow the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲਇਆ ਬੰਨਿ ਪਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: mai har har kharach liaa ba(n)n palai ||
verses.translation: I have loaded my pack with the provisions of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa praan sakhaiee sadhaa naal chalai ||
verses.translation: The Companion of my breath of life shall always be with me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har naam dhiRaiaa har nihachal har dhan palai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me. I have the Imperishable Treasure of the Lord in my lap. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har sajan meraa preetam raiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is my Best Friend; He is my Beloved Lord King.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koiee aan milaavai mere praan jeevaiaa ||
verses.translation: If only someone would come and introduce me to Him, the Rejuvenator of my breath of life.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਮੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹੇ ਵਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hau reh na sakaa bin dhekhe preetamaa mai neer vahe veh chalai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved. My eyes are welling up with tears. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur mitr meraa baal sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: My Friend, the True Guru, has been my Best Friend since I was very young.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hau reh na sakaa bin dhekhe meree maiee ||
verses.translation: I cannot survive without seeing Him, O my mother!

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: har jeeau kirapaa karahu gur melahu jan naanak har dhan palai jeeau ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please show Mercy to me, that I may meet the Guru. Servant Nanak gathers the Wealth of the Lord's Name in his lap. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: madhusoodhan mere man tan praanaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my mind, body and breath of life.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau har bin dhoojaa avar na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: I do not know any other than the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koiee sajan sa(n)t milai vaddabhaagee mai har prabh piaaraa dhasai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: If only I could have the good fortune to meet some friendly Saint; he might show me the Way to my Beloved Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜੀ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hau man tan khojee bhaal bhaalaiee ||
verses.translation: I have searched my mind and body, through and through.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiau piaaraa preetam milai meree maiee ||
verses.translation: How can I meet my Darling Beloved, O my mother?

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat khoj dhasaiee vich sa(n)gat har prabh vasai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I ask about the Path to God. In that Congregation, the Lord God abides. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa piaaraa preetam satigur rakhavaalaa ||
verses.translation: My Darling Beloved True Guru is my Protector.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik dheen karahu pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: I am a helpless child-please cherish me.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: meraa maat pitaa gur satigur pooraa gur jal mil kamal vigasai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining the Water of the Guru, the lotus of my heart blossoms forth. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: mai bin gur dhekhe needh na aavai ||
verses.translation: Without seeing my Guru, sleep does not come.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਦਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: mere man tan vedhan gur birahu lagaavai ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are afflicted with the pain of separation from the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har dhiaa karahu gur melahu jan naanak gur mil rahasai jeeau ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, show mercy to me, that I may meet my Guru. Meeting the Guru, servant Nanak blossoms forth. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har gun paReeaai har gun guneeaai ||
verses.translation: Read of the Lord's Glories and reflect upon the Lord's Glories.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam kathaa nit suneeaai ||
verses.translation: Listen continually to the Sermon of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat har gun gaae jag bhaujal dhutar tareeaai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall cross over the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aau sakhee har mel karehaa ||
verses.translation: Come, friends, let us meet our Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere preetam kaa mai dhei sanehaa ||
verses.translation: Bring me a message from my Beloved.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਖਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meraa mitr sakhaa so preetam bhaiee mai dhase har narahareeaai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: He alone is a friend, companion, beloved and brother of mine, who shows me the way to the Lord, the Lord of all. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: meree bedhan har gur pooraa jaanai ||
verses.translation: My illness is known only to the Lord and the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau reh na sakaa bin naam vakhaane ||
verses.translation: I cannot continue living without chanting the Naam.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mai aaukhadh ma(n)tr dheejai gur poore mai har har naam udhareeaai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: So give me the medicine, the Mantra of the Perfect Guru. Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am saved. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ham chaatirak dheen satigur saranaiee ||
verses.translation: I am just a poor song-bird, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam boo(n)dh mukh paiee ||
verses.translation: who has placed the Drop of Water, the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in my mouth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਜਲ ਕੇ ਮੀਨੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: har jalanidh ham jal ke meene jan naanak jal bin mareeaai jeeau ||4||3||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Treasure of Water; I am just a fish in that water. Without this Water, servant Nanak would die. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jan sa(n)t milahu mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: O servants of the Lord, O Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny, let us join together!

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸਹੁ ਮੈ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa har prabh dhasahu mai bhukh lagaiee ||
verses.translation: Show me the way to my Lord God-I am so hungry for Him!

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: meree saradhaa poor jagajeevan dhaate mil har dharasan man bheejai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Please reward my faith, O Life of the World, O Great Giver. Obtaining the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)g bolee har baanee ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I chant the Bani of the Lord's Word.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har kathaa merai man bhaanee ||
verses.translation: The Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har a(n)mrit har man bhaavai mil satigur a(n)mrit peejai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is so sweet to my mind. Meeting the True Guru, I drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee har sa(n)gat paaveh ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the Lord's Congregation is found,

verses.original: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhaagaheen bhram choTaa khaaveh ||
verses.translation: while the unfortunate ones wander around in doubt, enduring painful beatings.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin bhaagaa satasa(n)g na labhai bin sa(n)gat mail bhareejai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Without good fortune, the Sat Sangat is not found; without this Sangat, people are stained with filth and pollution. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai aai milahu jagajeevan piaare ||
verses.translation: Come and meet me, O Life of the World, my Beloved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiaa man dhaare ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and enshrine Your Name, Har, Har, within my mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmat naam meeThaa man bhaiaa jan naanak naam man bheejai jeeau ||4||4||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Sweet Name has become pleasing to my mind. Servant Nanak's mind is drenched and delighted with the Naam. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har gur giaan har ras har paiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, I have obtained the Lord's spiritual wisdom. I have obtained the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man har ra(n)g raataa har ras peeaaiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is imbued with the Love of the Lord; I drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਟੁਲਿ ਟੁਲਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har naam mukh har har bolee man har ras Tul Tul paudhaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: With my mouth, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; my mind is filled to overflowing with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੈ ਗਲਿ ਮੇਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu sa(n)t mai gal melaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Come, O Saints, and lead me to my Lord's Embrace.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere preetam kee mai kathaa sunaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Recite to me the Sermon of my Beloved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t milahu man dhevaa jo gurbaanee mukh chaudhaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind to those Saints of the Lord, who chant the Word of the Guru's Bani with their mouths. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee har sa(n)t milaiaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the Lord has led me to meet His Saint.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har ras mukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has placed the Sublime Essence of the Lord into my mouth.

verses.original: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੂਨੀ ਨਿਤਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhaagaheen satigur nahee paiaa manmukh garabh joonee nit paudhaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The unfortunate ones do not find the True Guru; the self-willed manmukhs continually endure reincarnation through the womb. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aap dhiaal dhiaa prabh dhaaree ||
verses.translation: God, the Merciful, has Himself bestowed His Mercy.

verses.original: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mal haumai bikhiaa sabh nivaaree ||
verses.translation: He has totally removed the poisonous pollution of egotism.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak haT paTan vich kaa(n)iaa har lai(n)dhe gurmukh saudhaa jeeau ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the shops of the city of the human body, the Gurmukhs buy the merchandise of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: hau gun govi(n)dh har naam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)gat man naam vasaiee ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Name comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har prabh agam agochar suaamee mil satigur har ras keechai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord God is our Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Meeting the True Guru, I enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan har jan jin har prabh jaataa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are the humble servants of the Lord, who know the Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jai puchhaa jan har kee baataa ||
verses.translation: I go and ask those humble servants about the Mysteries of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paav malovaa mal mal dhovaa mil har jan har ras peechai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: I wash and massage their feet; joining with the humble servants of the Lord, I drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaatai naam dhiRaiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur dharasan paiaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ras sach a(n)mrit bolee gur poorai a(n)mrit leechai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The True Essence is Ambrosial Nectar; through the Ambrosial Words of the Perfect Guru, this Amrit is obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har satasa(n)gat sat purakh milaieeaai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, lead me to the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the true beings.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat har naam dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਰੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak har kathaa sunee mukh bolee gurmat har naam pareechai jeeau ||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I listen and chant the Lord's Sermon; through the Guru's Teachings, I am fulfilled by the Name of the Lord. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਤੁਸੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu bhaine tusee milahu piaareeaa ||
verses.translation: Come, dear sisters-let us join together.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo meraa preetam dhase tis kai hau vaareeaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the one who tells me of my Beloved.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat ladhaa har sajan hau satigur viTahu ghumaieeaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have found the Lord, my Best Friend. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh teh suaamee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: too ghaT ghaT raviaa a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: You are permeating each and every heart, O Lord, Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har naal dhikhaaliaa hau satigur viTahu sadh vaariaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has shown me that the Lord is always with me. I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: eko pavan maaTee sabh ekaa sabh ekaa jot sabaieeaa ||
verses.translation: There is only one breath; all are made of the same clay; the light within all is the same.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਇਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਨ ਰਲਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਰਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ikaa jot varatai bhin bhin na raliee kisai dhee ralaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The One Light pervades all the many and various beings. This Light intermingles with them, but it is not diluted or obscured.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਤਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ik nadharee aaiaa hau satigur viTahu vataiaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have come to see the One. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bolai a(n)mirat baanee ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak speaks the Ambrosial Bani of the Word.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa(n) kai man piaaree bhaanee ||
verses.translation: It is dear and pleasing to the minds of the GurSikhs.

verses.original: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: aupadhes kare gur satigur pooraa gur satigur paraupakaareeaa jeeau ||4||7||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, shares the Teachings. The Guru, the True Guru, is Generous to all. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਸਤ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: sat chaupadhe mahale chauthe ke ||
verses.translation: Seven Chau-Padhay Of The Fourth Mehla. ||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man lochai gur dharasan taiee ||
verses.translation: My mind longs for the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

verses.original: ਬਿਲਪ ਕਰੇ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: bilap kare chaatirak kee niaaiee ||
verses.translation: It cries out like the thirsty song-bird.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tirakhaa na utarai saa(n)t na aavai bin dharasan sa(n)t piaare jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: My thirst is not quenched, and I can find no peace, without the Blessed Vision of the Beloved Saint. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau gholee jeeau ghol ghumaiee gur dharasan sa(n)t piaare jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Blessed Vision of the Beloved Saint Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: teraa mukh suhaavaa jeeau sahaj dhun baanee ||
verses.translation: Your Face is so Beautiful, and the Sound of Your Words imparts intuitive wisdom.

verses.original: ਚਿਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: chir hoaa dhekhe saari(n)gapaanee ||
verses.translation: It is so long since this rainbird has had even a glimpse of water.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਜਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਜਣ ਮੀਤ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su dhes jahaa too(n) vasiaa mere sajan meet muraare jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Blessed is that land where You dwell, O my Friend and Intimate Divine Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਹਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਜਣ ਮੀਤ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau gholee hau ghol ghumaiee gur sajan meet muraare jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, I am forever a sacrifice, to my Friend and Intimate Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਤਾ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik ghaRee na milate taa kalijug hotaa ||
verses.translation: When I could not be with You for just one moment, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga dawned for me.

verses.original: ਹੁਣਿ ਕਦਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: hun kadh mileeaai pria tudh bhagava(n)taa ||
verses.translation: When will I meet You, O my Beloved Lord?

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: moh rain na vihaavai needh na aavai bin dhekhe gur dharabaare jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: I cannot endure the night, and sleep does not come, without the Sight of the Beloved Guru's Court. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau gholee jeeau ghol ghumaiee tis sache gur dharabaare jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that True Court of the Beloved Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaag hoaa gur sa(n)t milaiaa ||
verses.translation: By good fortune, I have met the Saint Guru.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh abinaasee ghar meh paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have found the Immortal Lord within the home of my own self.

verses.original: ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sev karee pal chasaa na vichhuRaa jan naanak dhaas tumaare jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: I will now serve You forever, and I shall never be separated from You, even for an instant. Servant Nanak is Your slave, O Beloved Master. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: hau gholee jeeau ghol ghumaiee jan naanak dhaas tumaare jeeau || rahaau ||1||8||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice; servant Nanak is Your slave, Lord. ||Pause||1||8||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raag maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: saa rut suhaavee jit tudh samaalee ||
verses.translation: Sweet is that season when I remember You.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕੰਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਘਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: so ka(n)m suhelaa jo teree ghaalee ||
verses.translation: Sublime is that work which is done for You.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so ridhaa suhelaa jit ridhai too(n) vuThaa sabhanaa ke dhaataaraa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed is that heart in which You dwell, O Giver of all. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਝਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) saajhaa saahib baap hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: You are the Universal Father of all, O my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: nau nidh terai akhuT bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your nine treasures are an inexhaustible storehouse.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) dheh su tirapat aghaavai soiee bhagat tumaaraa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Those unto whom You give are satisfied and fulfilled; they become Your devotees, Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਸੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko aasai teree baiThaa ||
verses.translation: All place their hopes in You.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar too(n)hai vuThaa ||
verses.translation: You dwell deep within each and every heart.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਸਾਝੀਵਾਲ ਸਦਾਇਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabhe saajheevaal sadhain too(n) kisai na dhiseh baaharaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: All share in Your Grace; none are beyond You. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape gurmukh mukat karaieh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself liberate the Gurmukhs;

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਭਵਾਇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape manmukh janam bhavaieh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself consign the self-willed manmukhs to wander in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas terai balihaarai sabh teraa khel dhasaaharaa jeeau ||4||2||9||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You; Your Entire Play is self-evident, Lord. ||4||2||9||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh vaajai sahaj suhelaa ||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Melody resounds and resonates in peaceful ease.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ana(n)dh kare sadh kelaa ||
verses.translation: I rejoice in the eternal bliss of the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਆਸਣੁ ਊਚ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahaj gufaa meh taaRee laiee aasan uooch savaariaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: In the cave of intuitive wisdom I sit, absorbed in the silent trance of the Primal Void. I have obtained my seat in the heavens. ||1||

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: fir ghir apune gireh meh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: After wandering through many other homes and houses, I have returned to my own home,

verses.original: ਜੋ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo loReedhaa soiee paiaa ||
verses.translation: and I have found what I was longing for.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਿਖਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tirapat aghai rahiaa hai sa(n)tahu gur anabhau purakh dhikhaariaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: I am satisfied and fulfilled; O Saints, the Guru has shown me the Fearless Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਲੋਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape raajan aape logaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the King, and He Himself is the people.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap nirabaanee aape bhogaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is in Nirvaanaa, and He Himself indulges in pleasures.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਈ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape takhat bahai sach niaaiee sabh chookee kook pukaariaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself sits on the throne of true justice, answering the cries and prayers of all. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਡਿਠਾ ਮੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa ddiThaa mai teho kahiaa ||
verses.translation: As I have seen Him, so have I described Him.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis ras aaiaa jin bhedh lahiaa ||
verses.translation: This Sublime Essence comes only to one who knows the Mystery of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jotee jot milee sukh paiaa jan naanak ik pasaariaa jeeau ||4||3||10||
verses.translation: His light merges into the Light, and he finds peace. O servant Nanak, this is all the Extension of the One. ||4||3||10||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਿਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jit ghar pir sohaag banaiaa ||
verses.translation: That house, in which the soul-bride has married her Husband Lord

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tit ghar sakhe'ee ma(n)gal gaiaa ||
verses.translation: in that house, O my companions, sing the songs of rejoicing.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਤਿਤੈ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਸਿਗਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadh binodh titai ghar soheh jo dhan ka(n)t sigaaree jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Joy and celebrations decorate that house, in which the Husband Lord has adorned His soul-bride. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: saa gunava(n)tee saa vaddabhaagan ||
verses.translation: She is virtuous, and she is very fortunate;

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰਵੰਤੀ ਸੀਲਵੰਤਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: putrava(n)tee seelava(n)t sohaagan ||
verses.translation: she is blessed with sons and tender-hearted. The happy soul-bride is loved by her Husband.

verses.original: ਰੂਪਵੰਤਿ ਸਾ ਸੁਘੜਿ ਬਿਚਖਣਿ ਜੋ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: roopava(n)t saa sughaR bichakhan jo dhan ka(n)t piaaree jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: She is beautiful, wise, and clever. That soul-bride is the beloved of her Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਚਾਰਵੰਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: achaarava(n)t saiee paradhaane ||
verses.translation: She is well-mannered, noble and distinguished.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਬਣੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh si(n)gaar bane tis giaane ||
verses.translation: She is decorated and adorned with wisdom.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ਜੋ ਪਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saa kulava(n)tee saa sabharaiee jo pir kai ra(n)g savaaree jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: She is from a most respected family; she is the queen, adorned with the Love of her Husband Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: mahimaa tis kee kahan na jaae ||
verses.translation: Her glory cannot be described;

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jo pir mel liee a(n)g laae ||
verses.translation: she melts in the Embrace of her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਵਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਾਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: thir suhaag var agam agochar jan naanak prem saadhaaree jeeau ||4||4||11||
verses.translation: Her marriage is eternal; her Husband is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. O Servant Nanak, His Love is her only Support. ||4||4||11||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਦਰਸਨ ਚਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat dharasan chaahe ||
verses.translation: I have searched and searched, seeking the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਨ ਬਨ ਅਵਗਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaat bhaat ban ban avagaahe ||
verses.translation: I travelled through all sorts of woods and forests.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: niragun saragun har har meraa koiee hai jeeau aan milaavai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: My Lord, Har, Har, is both absolute and related, unmanifest and manifest; is there anyone who can come and unite me with Him? ||1||

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: khaT saasat bicharat mukh giaanaa ||
verses.translation: People recite from memory the wisdom of the six schools of philosophy;

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa tilak teerath isanaanaa ||
verses.translation: they perform worship services, wear ceremonial religious marks on their foreheads, and take ritual cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਆਸਨ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nivalee karam aasan chauraaseeh in meh saa(n)t na aavai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: They perform the inner cleansing practice with water and adopt the eighty-four Yogic postures; but still, they find no peace in any of these. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰਖ ਕੀਏ ਜਪ ਤਾਪਾ ॥
verses.translit: anik barakh ke'ee jap taapaa ||
verses.translation: They chant and meditate, practicing austere self-discipline for years and years;

verses.original: ਗਵਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਰਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gavan keeaa dharatee bharamaataa ||
verses.translation: they wander on journeys all over the earth;

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eik khin hiradhai saa(n)t na aavai jogee bahuR bahuR uTh dhaavai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: and yet, their hearts are not at peace, even for an instant. The Yogi rises up and goes out, over and over again. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa moh saadh milaiaa ||
verses.translation: By His Mercy, I have met the Holy Saint.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal dheeraj paiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed; I have been blessed with patience and composure.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: prabh abinaasee basiaa ghaT bheetar har ma(n)gal naanak gaavai jeeau ||4||5||12||
verses.translation: The Immortal Lord God has come to dwell within my heart. Nanak sings the songs of joy to the Lord. ||4||5||12||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham apara(n)par dhevaa ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is Infinite and Divine;

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar alakh abhevaa ||
verses.translation: He is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Invisible and Inscrutable.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal gopaal gobi(n)dhaa har dhiaavahu gurmukh gaatee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Merciful to the meek, Sustainer of the World, Lord of the Universe-meditating on the Lord, the Gurmukhs find salvation. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh madhusoodhan nisataare ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are emancipated by the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sa(n)gee kirasan muraare ||
verses.translation: The Lord Krishna becomes the Gurmukh's Companion.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਭਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhiaal dhamodhar gurmukh paieeaai horat kitai na bhaatee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh finds the Merciful Lord. He is not found any other way. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਹਾਰੀ ਕੇਸਵ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: nirahaaree kesav niravairaa ||
verses.translation: He does not need to eat; His Hair is Wondrous and Beautiful; He is free of hate.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੈਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: koT janaa jaa ke poojeh pairaa ||
verses.translation: Millions of people worship His Feet.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਇਕਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hiradhai jaa kai har har soiee bhagat ikaatee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: He alone is a devotee, who becomes Gurmukh, whose heart is filled with the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: amogh dharasan bea(n)t apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Forever fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; He is Infinite and Incomparable.

verses.original: ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: vadd samarath sadhaa dhaataaraa ||
verses.translation: He is Awesome and All-powerful; He is forever the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam japeeaai tit tareeaai gat naanak viralee jaatee jeeau ||4||6||13||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall be carried across. O Nanak, rare are those who know this state! ||4||6||13||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਹਿਆ ਕਰਣਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahiaa karanaa dhitaa lainaa ||
verses.translation: As You command, I obey; as You give, I receive.

verses.original: ਗਰੀਬਾ ਅਨਾਥਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gareebaa anaathaa teraa maanaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Pride of the meek and the poor.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh too(n)hai too(n)hai mere piaare teree kudharat kau bal jaiee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: You are everything; You are my Beloved. I am a sacrifice to Your Creative Power. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਉਝੜ ਭਾਣੈ ਰਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai ujhaR bhaanai raahaa ||
verses.translation: By Your Will, we wander in the wilderness; by Your Will, we find the path.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai har gun gurmukh gaavaahaa ||
verses.translation: By Your Will, we become Gurmukh and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੂਨੀ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaanai bharam bhavai bahu joonee sabh kichh tisai rajaiee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: By Your Will, we wander in doubt through countless lifetimes. Everything happens by Your Will. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko moorakh naa ko siaanaa ||
verses.translation: No one is foolish, and no one is clever.

verses.original: ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: varatai sabh kichh teraa bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Your Will determines everything;

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: agam agochar bea(n)t athaahaa teree keemat kahan na jaiee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: You are Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Infinite and Unfathomable. Your Value cannot be expressed. ||3||

verses.original: ਖਾਕੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khaak sa(n)tan kee dheh piaare ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the dust of the Saints, O my Beloved.

verses.original: ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aai piaa har terai dhuaarai ||
verses.translation: I have come and fallen at Your Door, O Lord.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: dharasan pekhat man aaghaavai naanak milan subhaiee jeeau ||4||7||14||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. O Nanak, with natural ease, I merge into Him. ||4||7||14||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਜਾ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh tadhe jaa visar jaavai ||
verses.translation: They forget the Lord, and they suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਭੁਖ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhukh viaapai bahu bidh dhaavai ||
verses.translation: Afflicted with hunger, they run around in all directions.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: simarat naam sadhaa suhelaa jis dhevai dheen dhiaalaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, Merciful to the meek, bestows meditation on those blessed souls; this Naam forever provides peace.||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa vadd samarathaa ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is All-Powerful.

verses.original: ਜੀਇ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeei samaalee taa sabh dhukh lathaa ||
verses.translation: When I dwell upon Him in my soul, all my sorrows depart.

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਈ ਹਉ ਪੀੜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chi(n)taa rog giee hau peeRaa aap kare pratipaalaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Through this meditation the sickness of anxiety and the disease of ego are cured. God thus sustains us.||2||

verses.original: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਵਾਂਗੀ ਹਉ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: baarik vaa(n)gee hau sabh kichh ma(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Like a child, I ask for everything (from God).

verses.original: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhedhe toT naahee prabh ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: God is Bountifull; God never comes up empty, that is Gods way.

verses.original: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pairee pai pai bahut manaiee dheen dhiaal gopaalaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Again and again, I fall at Gods Feet. God is Merciful to the meek, the Sustainer of the World. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree satigur poore ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin ba(n)dhan kaaTe sagale mere ||
verses.translation: who has shattered all my bonds (to the world, breaking my attachment).

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: hiradhai naam dhe niramal ke'ee naanak ra(n)g rasaalaa jeeau ||4||8||15||
verses.translation: With the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in my heart, I have been purified. O Nanak, His Love has imbued me with nectar. ||4||8||15||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: laal gopaal dhiaal ra(n)geele ||
verses.translation: O my Love, Sustainer of the World, Merciful, Loving Lord,

verses.original: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: gahir ga(n)bheer bea(n)t govi(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Profoundly Deep, Infinite Lord of the Universe,

verses.original: ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: uooch athaeh bea(n)t suaamee simar simar hau jeevaa(n) jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Highest of the High, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord and Master: continually remembering You in deep meditation, I live. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਮੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh bha(n)jan nidhaan amole ||
verses.translation: O Destroyer of pain, Priceless Treasure,

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau niravair athaeh atole ||
verses.translation: Fearless, free of hate, Unfathomable, Immeasurable,

verses.original: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭੌ ਮਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਠੰਢਾ ਥੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: akaal moorat ajoonee sa(n)bhau man simarat Tha(n)ddaa theevaa(n) jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: of Undying Form, Unborn, Self-illumined: remembering You in meditation, my mind is filled with a deep and profound peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sa(n)gee har ra(n)g gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Joyous Lord, the Sustainer of the World, is my constant Companion.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: uooch neech kare pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: He cherishes the high and the low.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam rasain man tirapatain gurmukh a(n)mrit peevaa(n) jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The Nectar of the Name satisfies my mind. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh piaare tudh dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: In suffering and in comfort, I meditate on You, O Beloved.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eh sumat guroo te paiee ||
verses.translation: I have obtained this sublime understanding from the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak kee dhar too(n)hai Thaakur har ra(n)g paar pareevaa(n) jeeau ||4||9||16||
verses.translation: You are Nanak's Support, O my Lord and Master; through Your Love, I swim across to the other side. ||4||9||16||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su velaa jit mai satigur miliaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that time when I meet the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: safal dharasan netr pekhat tariaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Fruitful Vision of His Darshan, I have been saved.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਮੂਰਤ ਚਸੇ ਪਲ ਘੜੀਆ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n moorat chase pal ghaReeaa dha(n)n su oi sa(n)jogaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed are the hours, the minutes and the seconds-blessed is that Union with Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: audham karat man niramal hoaa ||
verses.translation: Making the effort, my mind has become pure.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har maarag chalat bhram sagalaa khoiaa ||
verses.translation: Walking on the Lord's Path, my doubts have all been cast out.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan satiguroo sunaiaa miT ge sagale rogaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The True Guru has inspired me to hear the Treasure of the Naam; all my illness has been dispelled. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar teree baanee ||
verses.translation: The Word of Your Bani is inside and outside as well.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਥੀ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aap kathee tai aap vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself chant it, and You Yourself speak it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kahiaa sabh eko eko avar na koiee hoigaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The Guru has said that He is One-All is the One. There shall never be any other. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ras har gur te peeaa ||
verses.translation: I drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence from the Guru;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har painan naam bhojan theeaa ||
verses.translation: the Lord's Name has become my clothing and food.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਿ ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਨੇ ਭੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naam ra(n)g naam choj tamaase naau naanak keene bhogaa jeeau ||4||10||17||
verses.translation: The Name is my delight, the Name is my play and entertainment. O Nanak, I have made the Name my enjoyment. ||4||10||17||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਇਕ ਮਾਂਗਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal sa(n)tan peh vasat ik maa(n)gau ||
verses.translation: I beg of all the Saints: please, give me the merchandise.

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥
verses.translit: karau bina(n)tee maan tiaagau ||
verses.translation: I offer my prayers-I have forsaken my pride.

verses.original: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਲਖ ਵਰੀਆ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaar vaar jaiee lakh vareeaa dheh sa(n)tan kee dhooraa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, hundreds of thousands of times a sacrifice, and I pray: please, give me the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum dhaate tum purakh bidhaate ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum samarath sadhaa sukhadhaate ||
verses.translation: You are All-powerful, the Giver of Eternal Peace.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh ko tum hee te varasaavai aausar karahu hamaaraa pooraa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: You bless everyone. Please bring my life to fulfillment. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਵਨ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan terai bhavan puneetaa ||
verses.translation: The body-temple is sanctified by the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan,

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਗੜੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਹੀ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aatam gaR bikham tinaa hee jeetaa ||
verses.translation: and thus, the impregnable fort of the soul is conquered.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tum dhaate tum purakh bidhaate tudh jevadd avar na sooraa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny. There is no other warrior as great as You. ||3||

verses.original: ਰੇਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: ren sa(n)tan kee merai mukh laagee ||
verses.translation: I applied the dust of the feet of the Saints to my face.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat binasee kubudh abhaagee ||
verses.translation: My evil-mindedness disappeared, along with my misfortune and false-mindedness.

verses.original: ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: sach ghar bais rahe gun gaae naanak binase kooraa jeeau ||4||11||18||
verses.translation: I sit in the true home of my self; I sing His Glorious Praises. O Nanak, my falsehood has vanished! ||4||11||18||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਵਡ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: visar naahee evadd dhaate ||
verses.translation: I shall never forget You-You are such a Great Giver!

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa bhagatan sa(n)g raate ||
verses.translation: Please grant Your Grace, and imbue me with the love of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਏਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhinas rain jiau tudh dhiaaiee eh dhaan moh karanaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, let me meditate on You day and night; please, grant me this gift! ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਅੰਧੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maaTee a(n)dhee surat samaiee ||
verses.translation: Into this blind clay, You have infused awareness.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ਭਲੀਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh dheeaa bhaleeaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: Everything, everywhere which You have given is good.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadh binodh choj tamaase tudh bhaavai so honaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Bliss, joyful celebrations, wondrous plays and entertainment-whatever pleases You, comes to pass. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhaa dhitaa sabh kichh lainaa ||
verses.translation: Everything we receive is a gift from Him

verses.original: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: chhateeh a(n)mirat bhojan khaanaa ||
verses.translation: -the thirty-six delicious foods to eat,

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਪਵਣਾ ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sej sukhaalee seetal pavanaa sahaj kel ra(n)g karanaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: cozy beds, cooling breezes, peaceful joy and the experience of pleasure. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: saa budh dheejai jit visareh naahee ||
verses.translation: Give me that state of mind, by which I may not forget You.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: saa mat dheejai jit tudh dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Give me that understanding, by which I may meditate on You.

verses.original: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: saas saas tere gun gaavaa oT naanak gur charanaa jeeau ||4||12||19||
verses.translation: I sing Your Glorious Praises with each and every breath. Nanak takes the Support of the Guru's Feet. ||4||12||19||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sifat saalaahan teraa hukam rajaiee ||
verses.translation: To praise You is to follow Your Command and Your Will.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: so giaan dhiaan jo tudh bhaiee ||
verses.translation: That which pleases You is spiritual wisdom and meditation.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਜਪੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਆਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: soiee jap jo prabh jeeau bhaavai bhaanai poor giaanaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: That which pleases God is chanting and meditation; to be in harmony with His Will is perfect spiritual wisdom. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ॥ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam teraa soiee gaavai || jo saahib terai man bhaavai ||
verses.translation: He alone sings Your Ambrosial Naam, who is pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too(n) sa(n)tan kaa sa(n)t tumaare sa(n)t saahib man maanaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You. The minds of the Saints are attuned to You, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sa(n)tan kee kareh pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: You cherish and nurture the Saints.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kheleh tum sa(n)g gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Saints play with You, O Sustainer of the World.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਖਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: apune sa(n)t tudh khare piaare too sa(n)tan ke praanaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Your Saints are very dear to You. You are the breath of life of the Saints. ||3||

verses.original: ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: aun sa(n)tan kai meraa man kurabaane ||
verses.translation: My mind is a sacrifice to those Saints who know You,

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin too(n) jaataa jo tudh man bhaane ||
verses.translation: and are pleasing to Your Mind.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: tin kai sa(n)g sadhaa sukh paiaa har ras naanak tirapat aghaanaa jeeau ||4||13||20||
verses.translation: In their company I have found a lasting peace. Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||13||20||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) jalanidh ham meen tumaare ||
verses.translation: : You are the Ocean of Water, and I am Your fish.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤਿਖਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: teraa naam boo(n)dh ham chaatirak tikhahaare ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the drop of water, and I am a thirsty rainbird.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumaree aas piaasaa tumaree tum hee sa(n)g man leenaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: You are my hope, and You are my thirst. My mind is absorbed in You. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਪੀ ਖੀਰੁ ਅਘਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau baarik pee kheer aghaavai ||
verses.translation: Just as the baby is satisfied by drinking milk,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau niradhan dhan dhekh sukh paavai ||
verses.translation: and the poor person is pleased by seeing wealth,

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਜਲੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਠੰਢਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tirakhaava(n)t jal peevat Tha(n)ddaa tiau har sa(n)g ih man bheenaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: and the thirsty person is refreshed by drinking cool water, so is this mind drenched with delight in the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau a(n)dhiaarai dheepak paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: Just as the darkness is lit up by the lamp,

verses.original: ਭਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: bharataa chitavat pooran aasaa ||
verses.translation: and the hopes of the wife are fulfilled by thinking about her husband,

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mil preetam jiau hot ana(n)dhaa tiau har ra(n)g man ra(n)geenaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: and people are filled with bliss upon meeting their beloved, so is my mind imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan mo kau har maarag paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Saints have set me upon the Lord's Path.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਿਝਾਇਆ ॥
