verses.translit: saadh kirapaal har sa(n)g gijhaiaa ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Holy Saint, I have been attuned to the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਮਰਾ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: har hamaraa ham har ke dhaase naanak sabadh guroo sach dheenaa jeeau ||4||14||21||
verses.translation: The Lord is mine, and I am the slave of the Lord. O Nanak, the Guru has blessed me with the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||14||21||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam sadhaa niramaleeaa ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is eternally pure.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਡਾਰਨ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaiee dhookh biddaaran hareeaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Giver of Peace and the Dispeller of sorrow.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avar saadh chakh sagale dhekhe man har ras sabh te meeThaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: I have seen and tasted all other flavors, but to my mind, the Subtle Essence of the Lord is the sweetest of all. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo peevai so tirapataavai ||
verses.translation: Whoever drinks this in, is satisfied.

verses.original: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: amar hovai jo naam ras paavai ||
verses.translation: Whoever obtains the Sublime Essence of the Naam becomes immortal.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan tiseh paraapat jis sabadh guroo man vooThaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Treasure of the Naam is obtained by one whose mind is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin har ras paiaa so tirapat aghaanaa ||
verses.translation: One who obtains the Sublime Essence of the Lord is satisfied and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਨਾਹਿ ਡੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin har saadh paiaa so naeh ddulaanaa ||
verses.translation: One who obtains this Flavor of the Lord does not waver.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tiseh paraapat har har naamaa jis masatak bhaageeThaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: One who has this destiny written on his forehead obtains the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ikas hath aaiaa varasaane bahutere ||
verses.translation: The Lord has come into the hands of the One, the Guru, who has blessed so many with good fortune.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tis lag mukat bhe ghanere ||
verses.translation: Attached to Him, a great many have been liberated.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaanaa gurmukh paieeaai kahu naanak viralee ddeeThaa jeeau ||4||15||22||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam; says Nanak, those who see the Lord are very rare. ||4||15||22||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: nidh sidh ridh har har har merai ||
verses.translation: My Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the nine treasures, the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, wealth and prosperity.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath gahir ga(n)bheerai ||
verses.translation: He is the Deep and Profound Treasure of Life.

verses.original: ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: laakh koT khuseeaa ra(n)g raavai jo gur laagaa paiee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Hundreds of thousands, even millions of pleasures and delights are enjoyed by one who falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan pekhat bhe puneetaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are sanctified,

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal udhaare bhaiee meetaa ||
verses.translation: and all family and friends are saved.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agam agochar suaamee apunaa gur kirapaa te sach dhiaaiee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Inaccessible and Unfathomable True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਉਪਾਏ ॥ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau khojeh sarab upaae || vaddabhaagee dharasan ko viralaa paae ||
verses.translation: The One, the Guru, who is sought by all-only a few, by great good fortune, receive His Darshan.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਥਾਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: uooch apaar agochar thaanaa oh mahal guroo dhekhaiee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: His Place is lofty, infinite and unfathomable; the Guru has shown me that palace. ||3||

verses.original: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gahir ga(n)bheer a(n)mirat naam teraa ||
verses.translation: Your Ambrosial Name is deep and profound.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mukat bhiaa jis ridhai vaseraa ||
verses.translation: That person is liberated, in whose heart You dwell.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: gur ba(n)dhan tin ke sagale kaaTe jan naanak sahaj samaiee jeeau ||4||16||23||
verses.translation: The Guru cuts away all his bonds; O Servant Nanak, he is absorbed in the poise of intuitive peace. ||4||16||23||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kirapaa te har har dhiaavau ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabhoo dhiaa te ma(n)gal gaavau ||
verses.translation: By God's Kindness, I sing the songs of joy.

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਗਲ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat sovat jaagat har dhiaaieeaai sagal avaradhaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: While standing and sitting, while sleeping and while awake, meditate on the Lord, all your life. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam aaukhadh mo kau saadhoo dheeaa ||
verses.translation: The Holy Saint has given me the Medicine of the Naam.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kilabikh kaaTe niramal theeaa ||
verses.translation: My sins have been cut out, and I have become pure.

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਸਭ ਪੀਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadh bhiaa nikasee sabh peeraa sagal binaase dharadhaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: I am filled with bliss, and all my pains have been taken away. All my suffering has been dispelled. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa a(n)g kare meraa piaaraa || so mukataa saagar sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: One who has my Beloved on his side, is liberated from the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sat kare jin guroo pachhaataa so kaahe kau ddaradhaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: One who recognizes the Guru practices Truth; why should he be afraid? ||3||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਉ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jab te saadhoo sa(n)gat paae || gur bheTat hau giee balaae ||
verses.translation: Since I found the Company of the Holy and met the Guru, the demon of pride has departed.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਢਾਕਿ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੜਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: saas saas har gaavai naanak satigur ddaak leeaa meraa paRadhaa jeeau ||4||17||24||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, Nanak sings the Lord's Praises. The True Guru has covered my sins. ||4||17||24||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ot pot sevak sa(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: Through and through, the Lord is intermingled with His servant.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh pratipaale sevak sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: God, the Giver of Peace, cherishes His servant.

verses.original: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paanee pakhaa peesau sevak kai Thaakur hee kaa aahar jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the grain for the servant of my Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaaT silak prabh sevaa laiaa ||
verses.translation: God has cut the noose from around my neck; He has placed me in His Service.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hukam saahib kaa sevak man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master's Command is pleasing to the mind of His servant.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: soiee kamaavai jo saahib bhaavai sevak a(n)tar baahar maahar jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: He does that which pleases his Lord and Master. Inwardly and outwardly, the servant knows his Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaanaa Thaakur sabh bidh jaaneh ||
verses.translation: You are the All-knowing Lord and Master; You know all ways and means.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur ke sevak har ra(n)g maaneh ||
verses.translation: The servant of the Lord and Master enjoys the Love and Affection of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo kichh Thaakur kaa so sevak kaa sevak Thaakur hee sa(n)g jaahar jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: That which belongs to the Lord and Master, belongs to His servant. The servant becomes distinguished in association with his Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜੋ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: apunai Thaakur jo pahiraiaa || bahur na lekhaa puchh bulaiaa ||
verses.translation: He, whom the Lord and Master dresses in the robes of honor, is not called to answer for his account any longer.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰਾ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: tis sevak kai naanak kurabaanee so gahir gabheeraa gauhar jeeau ||4||18||25||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to that servant. He is the pearl of the deep and unfathomable Ocean of God. ||4||18||25||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh ghar meh baahar naahee ||
verses.translation: Everything is within the home of the self; there is nothing beyond.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਟੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: baahar Tolai so bharam bhulaahee ||
verses.translation: One who searches outside is deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jinee a(n)tar paiaa so a(n)tar baahar suhelaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one who has found the Lord within is happy, inwardly and outwardly. ||1||

verses.original: ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jhim jhim varasai a(n)mirat dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Slowly, gently, drop by drop, the stream of nectar trickles down within.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man peevai sun sabadh beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The mind drinks it in, hearing and reflecting on the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadh binodh kare dhin raatee sadhaa sadhaa har kelaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: It enjoys bliss and ecstasy day and night, and plays with the Lord forever and ever. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kaa vichhuRiaa miliaa ||
verses.translation: I have now been united with the Lord after having been separated and cut off from Him for so many lifetimes;

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੂਕਾ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kirapaa te sookaa hariaa ||
verses.translation: by the Grace of the Holy Saint, the dried-up branches have blossomed forth again in their greenery.

verses.original: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sumat paae naam dhiaae gurmukh hoe melaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: I have obtained this sublime understanding, and I meditate on the Naam; as Gurmukh, I have met the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਜਿਉ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jal tara(n)g jiau jaleh samaiaa ||
verses.translation: As the waves of water merge again with the water,

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tiau jotee sa(n)g jot milaiaa ||
verses.translation: so does my light merge again into the Light.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਟੇ ਕਿਵਾੜਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਜਉਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bhram kaTe kivaaRaa bahuR na hoieeaai jaulaa jeeau ||4||19||26||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the veil of illusion has been cut away, and I shall not go out wandering any more. ||4||19||26||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis kurabaanee jin too(n) suniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who have heard of You.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis balihaaree jin rasanaa bhaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those whose tongues speak of You.

verses.original: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaar vaar jaiee tis viTahu jo man tan tudh aaraadhe jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Again and again, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on You with mind and body. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis charan pakhaalee jo terai maarag chaalai ||
verses.translation: I wash the feet of those who walk upon Your Path.

verses.original: ਨੈਨ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: nain nihaalee tis purakh dhiaalai ||
verses.translation: With my eyes, I long to behold those kind people.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man dhevaa tis apune saajan jin gur mil so prabh laadhe jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: I offer my mind to those friends, who have met the Guru and found God. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee jin tum jaane ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate are those who know You.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧੇ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kai madhe alipat nirabaane ||
verses.translation: In the midst of all, they remain detached and balanced in Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਨਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਤ ਉਨਿ ਸਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g un bhaujal tariaa sagal dhoot un saadhe jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and conquer all their evil passions. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee saran pariaa man meraa ||
verses.translation: My mind has entered their Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਜਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: maan taan taj moh a(n)dheraa ||
verses.translation: I have renounced my pride in my own strength, and the darkness of emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan dheejai naanak kau tis prabh agam agaadhe jeeau ||4||20||27||
verses.translation: Please bless Nanak with the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable God. ||4||20||27||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਪੇਡੁ ਸਾਖ ਤੇਰੀ ਫੂਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) pedd saakh teree foolee ||
verses.translation: You are the tree; Your branches have blossomed forth.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਸਥੂਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sookham hoaa asathoolee ||
verses.translation: From the very small and subtle, You have become huge and manifest.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) jalanidh too(n) fen budhabudhaa tudh bin avar na bhaaleeaai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Ocean of Water, and You are the foam and the bubbles on its surface. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸੂਤੁ ਮਣੀਏ ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) soot mane'ee bhee too(n)hai ||
verses.translation: You are the thread, and You are also the beads.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਗੰਠੀ ਮੇਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) ga(n)Thee mer sir too(n)hai ||
verses.translation: You are the knot, and You are the primary bead of the maalaa.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aadh madh a(n)t prabh soiee avar na koi dhikhaaleeaai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, there is God. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) niragun saragun sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: You transcend all qualities, and You possess the supreme qualities. You are the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਰਸੀਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) nirabaan raseeaa ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: You are detached in Nirvaanaa, and You are the Enjoyer, imbued with love.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: apane karatab aape jaaneh aape tudh samaaleeaai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: You Yourself know Your Own Ways; You dwell upon Yourself. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) Thaakur sevak fun aape ||
verses.translation: You are the Master, and then again, You are the servant.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) gupat paragaT prabh aape ||
verses.translation: O God, You Yourself are the Manifest and the Unmanifest.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sadhaa gun gaavai ik bhoree nadhar nihaaleeaai jeeau ||4||21||28||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises forever. Please, just for a moment, bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||21||28||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: safal su baanee jit naam vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: Blessed are those words, by which the Naam is chanted.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh kinai viralai jaanee ||
verses.translation: Rare are those who know this, by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su velaa jit har gaavat sunanaa aae te paravaanaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed is that time when one sings and hears the Lord's Name. Blessed and approved is the coming of such a one. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: se netr paravaan jinee dharasan pekhaa ||
verses.translation: Those eyes which behold the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan are approved and accepted.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਕਰ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: se kar bhale jinee har jas lekhaa ||
verses.translation: Those hands which write the Praises of the Lord are good.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: se charan suhaave jo har maarag chale hau bal tin sa(n)g pachhaanaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Those feet which walk in the Lord's Way are beautiful. I am a sacrifice to that Congregation in which the Lord is recognized. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sun saajan mere meet piaare ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g khin maeh udhaare ||
verses.translation: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved in an instant.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kilavikh kaaT hoaa man niramal miT ge aavan jaanaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Your sins will be cut out; your mind will be immaculate and pure. Your comings and goings shall cease. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhui kar joR ik binau kareejai ||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa ddubadhaa pathar leejai ||
verses.translation: please bless me with Your Mercy, and save this sinking stone.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: naanak kau prabh bhe kirapaalaa prabh naanak man bhaanaa jeeau ||4||22||29||
verses.translation: God has become merciful to Nanak; God is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||4||22||29||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee har har teree ||
verses.translation: The Word of Your Bani, Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun hovai param gat meree ||
verses.translation: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights.

verses.original: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jalan bujhee seetal hoi manooaa satigur kaa dharasan paae jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The burning within me has been extinguished, and my mind has been cooled and soothed, by the Blessed Vision of the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sookh bhiaa dhukh dhoor paraanaa ||
verses.translation: Happiness is obtained, and sorrow runs far away,

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t rasan har naam vakhaanaa ||
verses.translation: when the Saints chant the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jal thal neer bhare sar subhar birathaa koi na jaae jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The sea, the dry land, and the lakes are filled with the Water of the Lord's Name; no place is left empty. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhaaree tin sirajanahaare ||
verses.translation: The Creator has showered His Kindness;

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sagale pratipaare ||
verses.translation: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: miharavaan kirapaal dhiaalaa sagale tirapat aghaae jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: He is Merciful, Kind and Compassionate. All are satisfied and fulfilled through Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: van tiran tirabhavan keeton hariaa ||
verses.translation: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds are rendered green.

verses.original: ਕਰਣਹਾਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: karanahaar khin bheetar kariaa ||
verses.translation: The Doer of all did this in an instant.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naanak tisai araadhe man kee aas pujaae jeeau ||4||23||30||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, Nanak meditates on the One who fulfills the desires of the mind. ||4||23||30||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meraa pitaa too(n)hai meraa maataa ||
verses.translation: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meraa ba(n)dhap too(n) meraa bhraataa ||
verses.translation: You are my Relative, and You are my Brother.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) meraa raakhaa sabhanee thaiee taa bhau kehaa kaaRaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: You are my Protector everywhere; why should I feel any fear or anxiety? ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree kirapaa te tudh pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, I recognize You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) meree oT too(n)hai meraa maanaa ||
verses.translation: You are my Shelter, and You are my Honor.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tujh bin dhoojaa avar na koiee sabh teraa khel akhaaRaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other; the entire Universe is the Arena of Your Play. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh tudh upaae ||
verses.translation: You have created all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jit jit bhaanaa tit tit laae ||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You assign tasks to one and all.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh keetaa teraa hovai naahee kichh asaaRaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: All things are Your Doing; we can do nothing ourselves. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaai mahaa sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, I have found great peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gai meraa man seetalaiaa ||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my mind is cooled and soothed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ਬਿਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: gur poorai vajee vaadhaiee naanak jitaa bikhaaRaa jeeau ||4||24||31||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, congratulations are pouring in-Nanak is victorious on the arduous battlefield of life! ||4||24||31||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan prabh maneh adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: God is the Breath of Life of my soul, the Support of my mind.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat jeeveh gun gai apaaraa ||
verses.translation: His devotees live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan a(n)mrit har naamaa har dhiaai dhiaai sukh paiaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Meditating, meditating on the Lord's Name, I have found peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa dhaar jo ghar te aavai || saadhasa(n)g janam maran miTaavai ||
verses.translation: One whose heart's desires lead him from his own home to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be rid of the cycle of birth and death.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aas manorath pooran hovai bheTat gur dharasaiaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: His hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar kichh mit nahee jaanee ||
verses.translation: The limits of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord cannot be known.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadhik sidh dhiaaveh giaanee ||
verses.translation: The seekers, the Siddhas, those beings of miraculous spiritual powers, and the spiritual teachers, all meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khudhee miTee chookaa bholaavaa gur man hee meh pragaTaiaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Thus, their egos are erased, and their doubts are dispelled. The Guru has enlightened their minds. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadh ma(n)gal kaliaan nidhaanaa || sookh sahaj har naam vakhaanaa ||
verses.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Treasure of bliss, joy, salvation, intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: hoi kirapaal suaamee apanaa naau naanak ghar meh aaiaa jeeau ||4||25||32||
verses.translation: When my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His Name entered the home of my mind. ||4||25||32||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun jeevaa soi tumaaree ||
verses.translation: Hearing of You, I live.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) preetam Thaakur at bhaaree ||
verses.translation: You are my Beloved, my Lord and Master, Utterly Great.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumare karatab tum hee jaanahu tumaree oT guopaalaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: You alone know Your Ways; I grasp Your Support, Lord of the World. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat man hariaa hovai ||
verses.translation: Singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਤ ਮਲੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kathaa sunat mal sagalee khovai ||
verses.translation: Hearing Your Sermon, all filth is removed.

verses.original: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bheTat sa(n)g saadh sa(n)tan kai sadhaa japau dhiaalaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate forever on the Merciful Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apunaa saas saas samaarau ||
verses.translation: I dwell on my God with each and every breath.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: eeh mat gur prasaadh man dhaarau ||
verses.translation: This understanding has been implanted within my mind, by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tumaree kirapaa te hoi pragaasaa sarab miaa pratipaalaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, the Divine Light has dawned. The Merciful Lord cherishes everyone. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sat sat sat prabh soiee ||
verses.translation: True, True, True is that God.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa sadh aape hoiee ||
verses.translation: Forever, forever and ever, He Himself is.

verses.original: ਚਲਿਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: chalit tumaare pragaT piaare dhekh naanak bhe nihaalaa jeeau ||4||26||33||
verses.translation: Your Playful Ways are revealed, O my Beloved. Beholding them, Nanak is enraptured. ||4||26||33||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਵਰਸਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਮੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee varasan laage mehaa ||
verses.translation: By His Command, the rain begins to fall.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: saajan sa(n)t mil naam japehaa ||
verses.translation: The Saints and friends have met to chant the Naam.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: seetal saa(n)t sahaj sukh paiaa Thaadd paiee prabh aape jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Serene tranquility and peaceful ease have come; God Himself has brought a deep and profound peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਹੁਤੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh bahuto bahut upaiaa ||
verses.translation: God has produced everything in great abundance.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲ ਰਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh sagal rajaiaa ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, God has satisfied all.

verses.original: ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhaat karahu mere dhaataaraa jeea ja(n)t sabh dhraape jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Bless us with Your Gifts, O my Great Giver. All beings and creatures are satisfied. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib sachee naiee ||
verses.translation: True is the Master, and True is His Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh tis sadhaa dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I meditate forever on Him.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਹਾ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam maran bhai kaaTe mohaa binase sog sa(n)taape jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The fear of birth and death has been dispelled; emotional attachment, sorrow and suffering have been erased. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas naanak saalaahe ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, Nanak praises the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam kaaTe sabh faahe ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Name, all bonds are cut away.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਕਰੀ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: pooran aas karee khin bheetar har har har gun jaape jeeau ||4||27||34||
verses.translation: One's hopes are fulfilled in an instant, chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||27||34||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਉ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aau saajan sa(n)t meet piaare ||
verses.translation: Come, dear friends, Saints and companions:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mil gaaveh gun agam apaare ||
verses.translation: let us join together and sing the Glorious Praises of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gaavat sunat sabhe hee mukate so dhiaaieeaai jin ham ke'ee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Those who sing and hear these praises are liberated, so let us meditate on the One who created us. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilabikh jaaveh ||
verses.translation: The sins of countless incarnations depart,

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhe seiee fal paaveh ||
verses.translation: and we receive the fruits of the mind's desires.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਭਸੁ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: simar saahib so sach suaamee rijak sabhas kau dhe'ee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: So meditate on that Lord, our True Lord and Master, who gives sustenance to all. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: naam japat sarab sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, all pleasures are obtained.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabh bhau binasai har har dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: All fears are erased, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਿਰਾਮੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin seviaa so paaragiraamee kaaraj sagale the'ee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: One who serves the Lord swims across to the other side, and all his affairs are resolved. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai piaa teree saranaiee ||
verses.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary;

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau laih milaiee ||
verses.translation: if it pleases You, unite me with You.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh bhagatee laavahu sach naanak a(n)mrit pe'ee jeeau ||4||28||35||
verses.translation: Shower Your Mercy upon me, God; let me be committed to devotional worship. Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of Truth. ||4||28||35||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal govi(n)dh gusaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth, has become Merciful;

verses.original: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: megh varasai sabhanee thaiee ||
verses.translation: the rain is falling everywhere.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal sadhaa kirapaalaa Thaadd paiee karataare jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: He is Merciful to the meek, always Kind and Gentle; the Creator has brought cooling relief. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: apune jeea ja(n)t pratipaare ||
verses.translation: He cherishes all His beings and creatures,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਮਾਤਾ ਸੰਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau baarik maataa sa(n)maare ||
verses.translation: as the mother cares for her children.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਆਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhukh bha(n)jan sukh saagar suaamee dhet sagal aahaare jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Destroyer of pain, the Ocean of Peace, the Lord and Master gives sustenance to all. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal poor rahiaa miharavaanaa ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord is totally pervading and permeating the water and the land.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadh balihaar jaieeaai kurabaanaa ||
verses.translation: I am forever devoted, a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ਜਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: rain dhinas tis sadhaa dhiaaiee j khin meh sagal udhaare jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, I always meditate on Him; in an instant, He saves all. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: raakh le'ee sagale prabh aape ||
verses.translation: God Himself protects all;

verses.original: ਉਤਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: autar ge sabh sog sa(n)taape ||
verses.translation: He drives out all sorrow and suffering.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: naam japat man tan hareeaaval prabh naanak nadhar nihaare jeeau ||4||29||36||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are rejuvenated. O Nanak, God has bestowed His Glance of Grace. ||4||29||36||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jithai naam japeeaai prabh piaare ||
verses.translation: Where the Naam, the Name of God the Beloved is chanted

verses.original: ਸੇ ਅਸਥਲ ਸੋਇਨ ਚਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: se asathal soin chaubaare ||
verses.translation: those barren places become mansions of gold.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਇਦਾ ਸੇਈ ਨਗਰ ਉਜਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jithai naam na japeeaai mere goidhaa seiee nagar ujaaRee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Where the Naam, the Name of my Lord of the Universe is not chanted-those towns are like the barren wilderness. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੁਖੀ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: har rukhee roTee khai samaale ||
verses.translation: One who meditates as he eats dry bread,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)tar baahar nadhar nihaale ||
verses.translation: sees the Blessed Lord inwardly and outwardly.

verses.original: ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਸੂ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khai khai kare badhafailee jaan visoo kee vaaRee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Know this well, that one who eats and eats while practicing evil, is like a field of poisonous plants. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa setee ra(n)g na laae ||
verses.translation: One who does not feel love for the Saints,

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saakat sa(n)g vikaram kamaae ||
verses.translation: misbehaves in the company of the wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics;

verses.original: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਖੋਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੜ ਅਪੁਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhulabh dheh khoiee agiaanee jaR apunee aap upaaRee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: he wastes this human body, so difficult to obtain. In his ignorance, he tears up his own roots. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: teree saran mere dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek,

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar mere gur gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: Ocean of Peace, my Guru, Sustainer of the world.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮ ਅਸਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa naanak gun gaavai raakhahu saram asaaRee jeeau ||4||30||37||
verses.translation: Shower Your Mercy upon Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; please, preserve my honor. ||4||30||37||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: charan Thaakur ke ridhai samaane ||
verses.translation: I cherish in my heart the Feet of my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਸਭ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਇਆਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: kal kales sabh dhoor piaane ||
verses.translation: All my troubles and sufferings have run away.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sookh sahaj dhun upajee saadhoo sa(n)g nivaasaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The music of intuitive peace, poise and tranquility wells up within; I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਮੂਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: laagee preet na tooTai moole ||
verses.translation: The bonds of love with the Lord are never broken.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)tar baahar rahiaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: The Lord is totally permeating and pervading inside and out.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: simar simar simar gun gaavaa kaaTee jam kee faasaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, singing His Glorious Praises, the noose of death is cut away. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਖੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit varakhai anahadh baanee ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar, the Unstruck Melody of Gurbani rains down continually;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar saa(n)t samaanee ||
verses.translation: deep within my mind and body, peace and tranquility have come.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tirapat aghai rahe jan tere satigur keeaa dhilaasaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Your humble servants remain satisfied and fulfilled, and the True Guru blesses them with encouragement and comfort. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa saa tis te fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: We are His, and from Him, we receive our rewards.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh sa(n)g milaiaa ||
verses.translation: Showering His Mercy upon us, God has united us with Him.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rahe vaddabhaagee naanak pooran aasaa jeeau ||4||31||38||
verses.translation: Our comings and goings have ended, and through great good fortune, O Nanak, our hopes are fulfilled. ||4||31||38||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੀਹੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: meeh piaa paramesar paiaa ||
verses.translation: The rain has fallen; I have found the Transcendent Lord God.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh sukhee vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures dwell in peace.

verses.original: ਗਇਆ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: giaa kales bhiaa sukh saachaa har har naam samaalee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Suffering has been dispelled, and true happiness has dawned, as we meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis ke se tin hee pratipaare ||
verses.translation: The One, to whom we belong, cherishes and nurtures us.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh bhe rakhavaare ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become our Protector.

verses.original: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sunee bena(n)tee Thaakur merai pooran hoiee ghaalee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer; my efforts have been rewarded. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jeeaa kau dhevanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of all souls.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee nadhar nihaaraa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਸਭਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਣੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal sabh tirapataane saadhoo charan pakhaalee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The beings in the water, on the land and in the sky are all satisfied; I wash the Feet of the Holy. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man kee ichh pujaavanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: He is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa jaiee balihaaraa ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaan keeaa dhukh bha(n)jan rate ra(n)g rasaalee jeeau ||4||32||39||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Destroyer of pain has given this Gift; I am imbued with the Love of the Delightful Lord. ||4||32||39||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan teraa dhan bhee teraa ||
verses.translation: Mind and body are Yours; all wealth is Yours.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) Thaakur suaamee prabh meraa ||
verses.translation: You are my God, my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh raas tumaaree teraa jor gopaalaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Body and soul and all riches are Yours. Yours is the Power, O Lord of the World. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa too(n)hai sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, You are the Giver of Peace.

verses.original: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: niv niv laagaa teree paiee ||
verses.translation: I bow down and fall at Your Feet.

verses.original: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaar kamaavaa je tudh bhaavaa jaa too(n) dheh dhiaalaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: I act as it pleases You, as You cause me to act, Kind and Compassionate Dear Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh tum te lahanaa too(n) meraa gahanaa ||
verses.translation: O God, from You I receive; You are my decoration.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo too(n) dheh soiee sukh sahanaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever You give me, brings me happiness.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖਹਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jithai rakheh baiku(n)Th tithaiee too(n) sabhanaa ke pratipaalaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Wherever You keep me, is heaven. You are the Cherisher of all. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar naanak sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, Nanak has found peace.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar tere gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath pooran hoe kadhe na hoi dhukhaalaa jeeau ||4||33||40||
verses.translation: All my hopes and desires are fulfilled; I shall never again suffer sorrow. ||4||33||40||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਘੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh megh paThaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has unleashed the rain clouds.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal dheh dhis varasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Over the sea and over the land-over all the earth's surface, in all directions, He has brought the rain.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t bhiee bujhee sabh tirasanaa anadh bhiaa sabh Thaiee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Peace has come, and the thirst of all has been quenched; there is joy and ecstasy everywhere. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa dhukh bha(n)janahaaraa ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of pain.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape bakhas kare jeea saaraa ||
verses.translation: He gives and forgives all beings.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪਇ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਨਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: apane keete no aap pratipaale pi pairee tiseh manaiee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself nurtures and cherishes His Creation. I fall at His Feet and surrender to Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee saran piaa gat paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Seeking His Sanctuary, salvation is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas har naam dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis bin hor na dhoojaa Thaakur sabh tisai keeaa jaiee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Without Him, there is no other Lord and Master. All places belong to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: teraa maan taan prabh teraa ||
verses.translation: Yours is the Honor, God, and Yours is the Power.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sachaa saahib gunee gaheraa ||
verses.translation: You are the True Lord and Master, the Ocean of Excellence.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas kahai bena(n)tee aaTh pahar tudh dhiaaiee jeeau ||4||34||41||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak utters this prayer: may I meditate on You twenty-four hours a day. ||4||34||41||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe sukh bhe prabh tuThe ||
verses.translation: All happiness comes, when God is pleased.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore ke charan man vuThe ||
verses.translation: The Feet of the Perfect Guru dwell in my mind.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗੀ ਲਿਵ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaadh lagee liv a(n)tar so ras soiee jaanai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: I am intuitively absorbed in the state of Samaadhi deep within. God alone knows this sweet pleasure. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar saahib meraa ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar varatai neraa ||
verses.translation: Deep within each and every heart, He dwells near and close at hand.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa alipat jeeaa kaa dhaataa ko viralaa aap pachhaanai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: He is always detached; He is the Giver of souls. How rare is that person who understands his own self. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਏਹ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh milanai kee eh neesaanee ||
verses.translation: This is the sign of union with God:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਇਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: man iko sachaa hukam pachhaanee ||
verses.translation: in the mind, the Command of the True Lord is recognized.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਅਨਦੁ ਖਸਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sahaj sa(n)tokh sadhaa tirapataase anadh khasam kai bhaanai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Intuitive peace and poise, contentment, enduring satisfaction and bliss come through the Pleasure of the Master's Will. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਥੀ ਦਿਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: hathee dhitee prabh dhevanahaarai ||
verses.translation: God, the Great Giver, has given me His Hand.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran rog sabh nivaare ||
verses.translation: He has erased all the sickness of birth and death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas ke'ee prabh apune har keeratan ra(n)g maane jeeau ||4||35||42||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those whom God has made His slaves, rejoice in the pleasure of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||35||42||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: keenee dhiaa gopaal gusaiee ||
verses.translation: The Life of the World, the Sustainer of the Earth, has showered His Mercy;

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan vase man maahee ||
verses.translation: the Guru's Feet have come to dwell within my mind.

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeaa tin karatai dhukh kaa dderaa ddaahiaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: The Creator has made me His Own. He has destroyed the city of sorrow. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan vasiaa sachaa soiee ||
verses.translation: The True One abides within my mind and body;

verses.original: ਬਿਖੜਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bikhaRaa thaan na dhisai koiee ||
verses.translation: no place seems difficult to me now.

verses.original: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣ ਹੋਏ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhoot dhusaman sabh sajan hoe eko suaamee aahiaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: All the evil-doers and enemies have now become my friends. I long only for my Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare su aape aapai ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, He does all by Himself.

verses.original: ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: budh siaanap kichhoo na jaapai ||
verses.translation: No one can know His Ways.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aapaniaa sa(n)taa no aap sahaiee prabh bharam bhulaavaa laahiaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Helper and Support of His Saints. God has cast out my doubts and delusions. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal jan kaa aadhaaro ||
verses.translation: His Lotus Feet are the Support of His humble servants.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar raam naam vaapaaro ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, they deal in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: sahaj ana(n)dh gaaveh gun govi(n)dh prabh naanak sarab samaahiaa jeeau ||4||36||43||
verses.translation: In peace and pleasure, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. O Nanak, God is permeating everywhere. ||4||36||43||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: so sach ma(n)dhar jit sach dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: True is that temple, within which one meditates on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: so ridhaa suhelaa jit har gun gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that heart, within which the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saa dharat suhaavee jit vaseh har jan sache naam viTahu kurabaano jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Beautiful is that land, where the Lord's humble servants dwell. I am a sacrifice to the True Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sach vaddaiee keem na paiee ||
verses.translation: The extent of the True Lord's Greatness cannot be known.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat karam na kahanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: His Creative Power and His Bounties cannot be described.

verses.original: ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhiaai dhiaai jeeveh jan tere sach sabadh man maano jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating on You. Their minds treasure the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sach saalaahan vaddabhaagee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Praises of the True One are obtained by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har gun gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g rate terai tudh bhaaveh sach naam neesaano jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with Your Love are pleasing to You. The True Name is their Banner and Insignia. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sache a(n)t na jaanai koiee ||
verses.translation: No one knows the limits of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar sachaa soiee ||
verses.translation: In all places and interspaces, the True One is pervading.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sach dhiaaieeaai sadh hee a(n)tarajaamee jaano jeeau ||4||37||44||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate forever on the True One, the Searcher of hearts, the Knower of all. ||4||37||44||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: rain suhaavaRee dhinas suhelaa ||
verses.translation: Beautiful is the night, and beautiful is the day,

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap a(n)mirat naam sa(n)tasa(n)g melaa ||
verses.translation: when one joins the Society of the Saints and chants the Ambrosial Naam.

verses.original: ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਲ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghaRee moorat simarat pal va(n)n(j)h jeevan safal tithaiee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: If you remember the Lord in meditation for a moment, even for an instant, then your life will become fruitful and prosperous. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam dhokh sabh laathe ||
verses.translation: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all sinful mistakes are erased.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar har prabh saathe ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is always with us.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhai bhau bharam khoiaa gur poorai dhekhaa sabhanee jaiee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Fear, dread and doubt have been dispelled by the Perfect Guru; now, I see God everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਡ ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh samarath vadd uooch apaaraa ||
verses.translation: God is All-powerful, Vast, Lofty and Infinite.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: nau nidh naam bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Naam is overflowing with the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)t madh prabh soiee dhoojaa lavai na laiee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, there is God. Nothing else even comes close to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa mere dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Take pity on me, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaachik jaachai saadh ravaalaa ||
verses.translation: I am a beggar, begging for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: dheh dhaan naanak jan maagai sadhaa sadhaa har dhiaaiee jeeau ||4||38||45||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak begs for this gift: let me meditate on the Lord, forever and ever. ||4||38||45||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai too(n)hai aagai aape ||
verses.translation: You are here, and You are hereafter.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)tr sabh tere thaape ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures were created by You.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tudh bin avar na koiee karate mai dhar oT tumaaree jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other, O Creator. You are my Support and my Protection. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa jap jap jeevai suaamee ||
verses.translation: The tongue lives by chanting and meditating on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin seviaa tin hee sukh paiaa so janam na jooaai haaree jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Lord find peace; they do not lose their lives in the gamble. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam avakhadh jin jan terai paiaa ||
verses.translation: Your humble servant, who obtains the Medicine of the Naam,

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kaa rog gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: is rid of the illnesses of countless lifetimes and incarnations.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਫਲ ਏਹਾ ਹੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har keeratan gaavahu dhin raatee safal ehaa hai kaaree jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: So sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night. This is the most fruitful occupation. ||3||

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT dhaar apanaa dhaas savaariaa ||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He has adorned His slave.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar paarabraham namasakaariaa ||
verses.translation: Deep within each and every heart, the Supreme Lord is humbly worshipped.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: eikas vin hor dhoojaa naahee baabaa naanak ieh mat saaree jeeau ||4||39||46||
verses.translation: Without the One, there is no other at all. O Baba Nanak, this is the most excellent wisdom. ||4||39||46||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rataa raam piaare ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਪਨਾ ਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sarabas dheejai apanaa vaare ||
verses.translation: I sacrifice everything for Him.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar govi(n)dh gun gaieeaai bisar na koiee saasaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. Do not forget Him, for even one breath. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee saajan meet piaaraa ||
verses.translation: He is a companion, a friend, and a beloved of mine,

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam saadhasa(n)g beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: who reflects upon the Lord's Name, in the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੀਜੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g tareejai saagar kaTeeaai jam kee faasaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the world-ocean, and the noose of death shall be cut away. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath har kee sevaa ||
verses.translation: The four cardinal blessings are obtained by serving the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਜਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: paarajaat jap alakh abhevaa ||
verses.translation: The Elysian Tree, the source of all blessings, is meditation on the Unseen and Unknowable Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh kilabikh gur kaaTe pooran hoiee aasaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The Guru has cut out the sinful mistakes of sexual desire and anger, and my hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗ ਭਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: pooran bhaag bhe jis praanee || saadhasa(n)g mile saara(n)gapaanee ||
verses.translation: That mortal who is blessed by perfect destiny meets the Lord, the Sustainer of the Universe, in the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasiaa jis a(n)tar paravaan girasat udhaasaa jeeau ||4||40||47||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the mind, one is approved and accepted, whether he is a house-holder or a renunciate. ||4||40||47||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam ridhai sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, my heart is filled with peace.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਂੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa bhagata(n)ee pragaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, His devotees become famous and acclaimed.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਆਲਸ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g mil har har japiaa binase aalas rogaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the disease of laziness has disappeared. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai gireh nav nidh har bhaiee ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the nine treasures are found in the Home of the Lord;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis miliaa jis purab kamaiee ||
verses.translation: He comes to meet those who deserve it by their past actions.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan pooran paramesur prabh sabhanaa galaa jogaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Perfect Transcendent Lord is spiritual wisdom and meditation. God is All-powerful to do all things. ||2||

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਇਕੰਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap ika(n)tee aap pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the Many.

verses.original: ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਡਿਠੇ ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: lep nahee jagajeevan dhaate dharasan ddiThe lahan vijogaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Filth does not stick to the Giver, the Life of the World. Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the pain of separation departs. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਤਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)chal lai sabh sisaT taraiee ||
verses.translation: Holding on to the hem of His Robe, the entire Universe is saved.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa naau aap japaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself causes His Name to be chanted.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: gur bohith paiaa kirapaa te naanak dhur sa(n)jogaa jeeau ||4||41||48||
verses.translation: The Boat of the Guru is found by His Grace; O Nanak, such blessed destiny is pre-ordained. ||4||41||48||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: soiee karanaa j aap karaae ||
verses.translation: People do whatever the Lord inspires them to do.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖੈ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jithai rakhai saa bhalee jaae ||
verses.translation: Wherever He keeps us is a good place.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: soiee siaanaa so pativa(n)taa hukam lagai jis meeThaa jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: That person is clever and honorable, unto whom the Hukam of the Lord's Command seems sweet. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਪਰੋਈ ਇਕਤੁ ਧਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh paroiee ikat dhaagai ||
verses.translation: Everything is strung upon the One String of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis lai le so charanee laagai ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord attaches, are attached to His Feet.

verses.original: ਊਂਧ ਕਵਲੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: uoo(n)dh kaval jis hoi pragaasaa tin sarab nira(n)jan ddeeThaa jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Those, whose inverted lotus of the crown chakra is illuminated, see the Immaculate Lord everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: teree mahimaa too(n)hai jaaneh ||
verses.translation: Only You Yourself know Your Glory.

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa aap too(n) aap pachhaaneh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself recognize Your Own Self.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree sa(n)tan tere jin kaam karodh lobh peeThaa jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your Saints, who have crushed their sexual desire, anger and greed. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) niravair sa(n)t tere niramal ||
verses.translation: You have no hatred or vengeance; Your Saints are immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਭ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਕਲਮਲ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhekhe sabh utareh kalamal ||
verses.translation: Seeing them, all sins depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਧੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaai dhiaai jeevai binasiaa bhram bhau dheeThaa jeeau ||4||42||49||
verses.translation: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Naam. His stubborn doubt and fear have departed. ||4||42||49||

verses.original: ਮਾਂਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maa(n)jh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa ma(n)gan je koiee maagai ||
verses.translation: One who asks for a false gift,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਰਤੇ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau marate ghaRee na laagai ||
verses.translation: shall not take even an instant to die.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jo sadh hee sevai so gur mil nihachal kahanaa ||1||
verses.translation: But one who continually serves the Supreme Lord God and meets the Guru, is said to be immortal. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat jis kai man laagee ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is dedicated to loving devotional worship

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai anadhin nit jaagee ||
verses.translation: sings His Glorious Praises night and day, and remains forever awake and aware.

verses.original: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਲੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: baeh pakaR tis suaamee melai jis kai masatak lahanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Taking him by the hand, the Lord and Master merges into Himself that person, upon whose forehead such destiny is written. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal bhagataa(n) man vuThe ||
verses.translation: His Lotus Feet dwell in the minds of His devotees.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਮੁਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: vin paramesar sagale muThe ||
verses.translation: Without the Transcendent Lord, all are plundered.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa(n) kee dhooR nit baa(n)chheh naam sache kaa gahanaa ||3||
verses.translation: I long for the dust of the feet of His humble servants. The Name of the True Lord is my decoration. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat har har gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Standing up and sitting down, I sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਵਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat var nihachal paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on Him, I obtain my Eternal Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: naanak kau prabh hoi dhiaalaa teraa keetaa sahanaa ||4||43||50||
verses.translation: God has become merciful to Nanak. I cheerfully accept Your Will. ||4||43||50||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag maajh asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Maajh, Ashtpadheeyaa: First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ra(n)gaae hukam sabaae ||
verses.translation: By His Command, all are attuned to the Word of the Shabad,

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sachee dharageh mahal bulaae ||
verses.translation: and all are called to the Mansion of His Presence, the True Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sache dheen dhiaal mere saahibaa sache man pateeaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: O my True Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek, my mind is pleased and appeased by the Truth. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sabadh suhaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa gurmatee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of Peace. Through the Guru's Teachings, it dwells in the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko meraa hau kis keraa ||
verses.translation: No one is mine, and I am no one else's.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa Thaakur tirabhavan meraa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master of the three worlds is mine.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: haumai kar kar jai ghaneree kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Acting in egotism, so very many have died. After making mistakes, they later repent and regret. ||2||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam pachhaanai su har gun vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Those who recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh naam neesaanai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are glorified with the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਚੈ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa dhar lekhaa sachai chhooTas naam suhaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Everyone's account is kept in the True Court, and through the Beauty of the Naam, they are saved. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhoolaa Thaur na paae ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; they find no place of rest.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jam dhar badhaa choTaa khaae ||
verses.translation: Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are brutally beaten.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bin naavai ko sa(n)g na saathee mukate naam dhiaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: Without the Name, there are no companions or friends. Liberation comes only by meditating on the Naam. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saakat kooRe sach na bhaavai ||
verses.translation: The false shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਾਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa baadhaa aavai jaavai ||
verses.translation: Bound by duality, they come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: likhiaa lekh na meTai koiee gurmukh mukat karaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: No one can erase pre-recorded destiny; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai pir jaato naahee ||
