verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa visariaa agam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: They have forgotten the Giver of peace, the Unfathomable, the Infinite.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਤਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: dhukhe'ee nit fireh bilalaadhe bin gur saa(n)t na paavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: These miserable people wander endlessly, crying out in pain; without the Guru, they find no peace. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin keete soiee bidh jaanai ||
verses.translation: The One who created them, knows their condition.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap kare taa hukam pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: And if He inspires them, then they realize the Hukam of His Command.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jehaa a(n)dhar paae tehaa varatai aape baahar paavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: Whatever He places within them, that is what prevails, and so they outwardly appear. ||7||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis baajhahu sache mai hor na koiee ||
verses.translation: I know of no other except the True One.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis lai le so niramal hoiee ||
verses.translation: Those, whom the Lord attaches to Himself, become pure.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੪॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasai ghaT a(n)tar jis dhevai so paavaniaa ||8||14||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the heart of those, unto whom He has given it. ||8||14||15||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: Enshrining the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind,

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa sabh dhukh gavaae ||
verses.translation: all the pains of egotism, selfishness and conceit are eliminated.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee sadhaa salaahe a(n)mirat a(n)mrit paavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: By continually praising the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, I obtain the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree a(n)mirat baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Bani of the Word within their minds.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee ma(n)n vasaae a(n)mrit naam dhiaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Enshrining the Ambrosial Bani in their minds, they meditate on the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵੈਣੀ ॥ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਰਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit bolai sadhaa mukh vainee || a(n)mrit vekhai parakhai sadhaa nainee ||
verses.translation: Those who continually chant the Ambrosial Words of Nectar see and behold this Amrit everywhere with their eyes.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat kathaa kahai sadhaa dhin raatee avaraa aakh sunaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: They continually chant the Ambrosial Sermon day and night; chanting it, they cause others to hear it. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ra(n)g rataa liv laae ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Ambrosial Love of the Lord, they lovingly focus their attention on Him.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit gur parasaadhee paae ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they receive this Amrit.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit rasanaa bolai dhin raatee man tan a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: They chant the Ambrosial Name with their tongues day and night; their minds and bodies are satisfied by this Amrit. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: so kichh karai ju chit na hoiee ||
verses.translation: That which God does is beyond anyone's consciousness;

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis dhaa hukam meT na sakai koiee ||
verses.translation: no one can erase the Hukam of His Command.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: hukame varatai a(n)mirat baanee hukame a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: By His Command, the Ambrosial Bani of the Word prevails, and by His Command, we drink in the Amrit. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਜਬ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ajab ka(n)m karate har kere ||
verses.translation: The actions of the Creator Lord are marvellous and wonderful.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eih man bhoolaa jaa(n)dhaa fere ||
verses.translation: This mind is deluded, and goes around the wheel of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee siau chit laae a(n)mirat sabadh vajaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, hear the vibrations of the Ambrosial Word of the Shabad. ||5||

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: khoTe khare tudh aap upaae ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the counterfeit and the genuine.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape parakhe lok sabaae ||
verses.translation: You Yourself appraise all people.

verses.original: ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: khare parakh khajaanai paieh khoTe bharam bhulaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: You appraise the true, and place them in Your Treasury; You consign the false to wander in delusion. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਾ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar vekhaa kiau saalaahee ||
verses.translation: How can I behold You? How can I praise You?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sabadh salaahee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I praise You through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਣੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tere bhaane vich a(n)mrit vasai too(n) bhaanai a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: In Your Sweet Will, the Amrit is found; by Your Will, You inspire us to drink in this Amrit. ||7||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat sabadh a(n)mirat har baanee ||
verses.translation: The Shabad is Amrit; the Lord's Bani is Amrit.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai ridhai samaanee ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, it permeates the heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)mirat naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa pee a(n)mrit sabh bhukh leh jaavaniaa ||8||15||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Naam is forever the Giver of peace; drinking in this Amrit, all hunger is satisfied. ||8||15||16||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit varasai sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down, softly and gently.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh viralaa koiee jan paae ||
verses.translation: How rare are those Gurmukhs who find it.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit pee sadhaa tirapataase kar kirapaa tirasanaa bujhaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Those who drink it in are satisfied forever. Showering His Mercy upon them, the Lord quenches their thirst. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gurmukh a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those Gurmukhs who drink in this Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa ras chaakh sadhaa rahai ra(n)g raatee sahaje har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The tongue tastes the essence, and remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love, intuitively singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sahaj ko paae ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, intuitive understanding is obtained;

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa maare ikas siau liv laae ||
verses.translation: subduing the sense of duality, they are in love with the One.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa har gun gaavai nadharee sach samaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, then they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; by His Grace, they merge in Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa upar nadhar prabh teree ||
verses.translation: Above all is Your Glance of Grace, O God.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੈ ਥੋੜੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਹੈ ਘਣੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kisai thoRee kisai hai ghaneree ||
verses.translation: Upon some it is bestowed less, and upon others it is bestowed more.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tujh te baahar kichh na hovai gurmukh sojhee paavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Without You, nothing happens at all; the Gurmukhs understand this. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh tat hai beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs contemplate the essence of reality;

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat bhare tere bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your Treasures are overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve koiee na paavai gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, no one obtains it. It is obtained only by Guru's Grace. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevai so jan sohai ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are beautiful.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam a(n)tar man mohai ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices their inner minds.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat man tan baanee rataa a(n)mrit sahaj sunaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are attuned to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word; this Ambrosial Nectar is intuitively heard. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhoolaa dhoojai bhai khuaae ||
verses.translation: The deluded, self-willed manmukhs are ruined through the love of duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam na levai marai bikh khaae ||
verses.translation: They do not chant the Naam, and they die, eating poison.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: anadhin sadhaa visaTaa meh vaasaa bin sevaa janam gavaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: Night and day, they continually sit in manure. Without selfless service, their lives are wasted away. ||6||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit peevai jis no aap peeaae ||
verses.translation: They alone drink in this Amrit, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sahaj liv laae ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they intuitively enshrine love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahiaa sabh aape gurmat nadharee aavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord is Himself perfectly pervading everywhere; through the Guru's Teachings, He is perceived. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap nira(n)jan soiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin sirajee tin aape goiee ||
verses.translation: He who has created, shall Himself destroy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੬॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaal sadhaa too(n) sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||8||16||17||
verses.translation: O Nanak, remember the Naam forever, and you shall merge into the True One with intuitive ease. ||8||16||17||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: se sach laage jo tudh bhaae ||
verses.translation: Those who please You are linked to the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sach seveh sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh sachaa saalaahee sachai mel milaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they praise the True One, and they merge in the merging of Truth. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sach saalaahaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sach dhiaain se sach raate sache sach samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth; they are absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa sach sabhanee thaiee ||
verses.translation: The True One is everywhere, wherever I look.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ma(n)n vasaiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tan sachaa rasanaa sach raatee sach sun aakh vakhaananiaa ||2||
verses.translation: True are the bodies of those whose tongues are attuned to Truth. They hear the Truth, and speak it with their mouths. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa maar sach samaanee ||
verses.translation: Subduing their desires, they merge with the True One;

verses.original: ਇਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਡੀਠੀ ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ein man ddeeThee sabh aavan jaanee ||
verses.translation: they see in their minds that everyone comes and goes in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur seve sadhaa man nihachal nij ghar vaasaa paavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, they become stable forever, and they obtain their dwelling in the home of the self. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh ridhai dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sabadh jalaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, I have burned my emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sacho sachaa vekh saalaahee gur sabadhee sach paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: I gaze upon the Truest of the True, and I praise Him. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I obtain the True One. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo sach raate tin sachee liv laagee ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth are blessed with the Love of the True One.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: har naam samaaleh se vaddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: Those who praise the Lord's Name are very fortunate.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh aap milaae satasa(n)gat sach gun gaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: Through the Word of His Shabad, the True One blends with Himself, those who join the True Congregation and sing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||5||

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa paReeaai je lekhe vich hovai ||
verses.translation: We could read the account of the Lord, if He were in any account.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: oh agam agochar sabadh sudh hovai ||
verses.translation: He is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; through the Shabad, understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: anadhin sach sabadh saalaahee hor koi na keemat paavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: Night and day, praise the True Word of the Shabad. There is no other way to know His Worth. ||6||

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR thaake saa(n)t na aaiee ||
verses.translation: People read and recite until they grow weary, but they do not find peace.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਲੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa jaale sudh na kaiee ||
verses.translation: Consumed by desire, they have no understanding at all.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bikh bihaajheh bikh moh piaase kooR bol bikh khaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: They purchase poison, and they are thirsty with their fascination for poison. Telling lies, they eat poison. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee eko jaanaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I know the One.

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa maar man sach samaanaa ||
verses.translation: Subduing my sense of duality, my mind is absorbed into the True One.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak eko naam varatai man a(n)tar gur parasaadhee paavaniaa ||8||17||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One Name is pervading deep within my mind; by Guru's Grace, I receive it. ||8||17||18||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: varan roop varateh sabh tere ||
verses.translation: In all colors and forms, You are pervading.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫੇਰ ਪਵਹਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mar mar ja(n)meh fer paveh ghanere ||
verses.translation: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and make their rounds on the wheel of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) eko nihachal agam apaaraa gurmatee boojh bujhaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: You alone are Eternal and Unchanging, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding is imparted. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree raam naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis roop na rekhiaa varan na koiee gurmatee aap bujhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord has no form, features or color. Through the Guru's Teachings, He inspires us to understand Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ekaa jot jaanai je koiee ||
verses.translation: The One Light is all-pervading; only a few know this.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai paragaT hoiee ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, this is revealed.

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gupat paragaT varatai sabh thaiee jotee jot milaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: In the hidden and in the obvious, He is pervading all places. Our light merges into the Light. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tisanaa agan jalai sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: The world is burning in the fire of desire,

verses.original: ਲੋਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: lobh abhimaan bahut aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: in greed, arrogance and excessive ego.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਪਣੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mar mar janamai pat gavaae apanee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and lose their honor. They waste away their lives in vain. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh ko viralaa boojhai ||
verses.translation: Those who understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad are very rare.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap maare taa tirabhavan soojhai ||
verses.translation: Those who subdue their egotism, come to know the three worlds.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: fir oh marai na maranaa hovai sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: Then, they die, never to die again. They are intuitively absorbed in the True One. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa meh fir chit na laae ||
verses.translation: They do not focus their consciousness on Maya again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sadh rahai samaae ||
verses.translation: They remain absorbed forever in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sach salaahe sabh ghaT a(n)tar sacho sach suhaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: They praise the True One, who is contained deep within all hearts. They are blessed and exalted by the Truest of the True. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach saalaahee sadhaa hajoore ||
verses.translation: Praise the True One, who is Ever-present.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh rahiaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sach nadharee aavai sache hee sukh paavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, we come to behold the True One; from the True One, peace is obtained. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach man a(n)dhar rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: The True One permeates and pervades the mind within.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sach nihachal aavai na jai ||
verses.translation: The True One is Eternal and Unchanging; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sache laagai so man niramal gurmatee sach samaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to the True One are immaculate and pure. Through the Guru's Teachings, they merge in the True One. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sach saalaahee avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: Praise the True One, and no other.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jit seviaai sadhaa sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੮॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate veechaaree sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||8||18||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, reflect deeply on the Truth; they practice only Truth. ||8||18||19||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: niramal sabadh niramal hai baanee ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad is Immaculate and Pure; the Bani of the Word is Pure.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: niramal jot sabh maeh samaanee ||
verses.translation: The Light which is pervading among all is Immaculate.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: niramal baanee har saalaahee jap har niramal mail gavaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: So praise the Immaculate Word of the Lord's Bani; chanting the Immaculate Name of the Lord, all filth is washed away. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sukhadhaataa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Giver of peace within their minds.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਣਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har niramal gur sabadh salaahee sabadho sun tisaa miTaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Praise the Immaculate Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Listen to the Shabad, and quench your thirst. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: niramal naam vasiaa man aae ||
verses.translation: When the Immaculate Naam comes to dwell in the mind,

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal maiaa moh gavaae ||
verses.translation: the mind and body become Immaculate, and emotional attachment to Maya departs.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: niramal gun gaavai nit saache ke niramal naadh vajaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate True Lord forever, and the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad shall vibrate within. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: niramal a(n)mrit gur te paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Ambrosial Nectar is obtained from the Guru.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vichahu aap muaa tithai moh na maiaa ||
verses.translation: When selfishness and conceit are eradicated from within, then there is no attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: niramal giaan dhiaan at niramal niramal baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Immaculate is the spiritual wisdom, and utterly immaculate is the meditation, of those whose minds are filled with the Immaculate Bani of the Word. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo niramal seve su niramal hovai ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Immaculate Lord becomes immaculate.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mail gur sabadhe dhovai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the filth of egotism is washed away.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਵਾਜੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: niramal vaajai anahadh dhun baanee dhar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Bani and the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current vibrate, and in the True Court, honor is obtained. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: niramal te sabh niramal hovai ||
verses.translation: Through the Immaculate Lord, all become immaculate.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: niramal manooaa har sabadh parovai ||
verses.translation: Immaculate is the mind which weaves the Word of the Lord's Shabad into itself.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: niramal naam lage baddabhaagee niramal naam suhaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: Blessed and very fortunate are those who are committed to the Immaculate Name; through the Immaculate Name, they are blessed and beautified. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: so niramal jo sabadhe sohai ||
verses.translation: Immaculate is the one who is adorned with the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: niramal naam man tan mohai ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices the mind and body.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sach naam mal kadhe na laagai mukh uoojal sach karaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: No filth ever attaches itself to the True Name; one's face is made radiant by the True One. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mailaa hai dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: The mind is polluted by the love of duality.

verses.original: ਮੈਲਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਮੈਲੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mailaa chaukaa mailai thai ||
verses.translation: Filthy is that kitchen, and filthy is that dwelling;

verses.original: ਮੈਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: mailaa khai fir mail vadhaae manmukh mail dhukh paavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: eating filth, the self-willed manmukhs become even more filthy. Because of their filth, they suffer in pain. ||7||

verses.original: ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: maile niramal sabh hukam sabaae ||
verses.translation: The filthy, and the immaculate as well, are all subject to the Hukam of God's Command.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: se niramal jo har saache bhaae ||
verses.translation: They alone are immaculate, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੯॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar gurmukh mail chukaavaniaa ||8||19||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam abides deep within the minds of the Gurmukhs, who are cleansed of all their filth. ||8||19||20||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਊਜਲ ਹੰਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh uoojal uoojal ha(n)saa ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is radiant, and radiant are His soul-swans.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: man baanee niramal meree manasaa ||
verses.translation: Their minds and their speech are immaculate; they are my hope and ideal.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man uoojal sadhaa mukh soheh at uoojal naam dhiaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Their minds are radiant, and their faces are always beautiful; they meditate on the most radiant Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gobi(n)dh gun gaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh gobidh kahai dhin raatee gobidh gun sabadh sunaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So chant Gobind, Gobind, the Lord of the Universe, day and night; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind, through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh gaaveh sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: Sing of the Lord Gobind with intuitive ease,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਊਜਲ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhai uoojal haumai mal jaae ||
verses.translation: in the Fear of the Guru; you shall become radiant, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh raheh bhagat kareh dhin raatee sun gobidh gun gaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Remain in bliss forever, and perform devotional worship, day and night. Hear and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa naachai bhagat dhiraRaae ||
verses.translation: Channel your dancing mind in devotional worship,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh manai man milaae ||
verses.translation: and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, merge your mind with the Supreme Mind.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਤਾਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sachaa taal poore maiaa moh chukaae sabadhe nirat karaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Let your true and perfect tune be the subjugation of your love of Maya, and let yourself dance to the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਚਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਤਨਹਿ ਪਛਾੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: uoochaa kooke taneh pachhaaRe ||
verses.translation: People shout out loud and move their bodies,

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh johiaa jamakaale ||
verses.translation: but if they are emotionally attached to Maya, then the Messenger of Death shall hunt them down.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਨਚਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh is maneh nachaae a(n)tar kapaT dhukh paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: The love of Maya makes this mind dance, and the deceit within makes people suffer in pain. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat jaa aap karaae ||
verses.translation: When the Lord inspires one to become Gurmukh, and perform devotional worship,

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tan man raataa sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: then his body and mind are attuned to His Love with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: baanee vajai sabadh vajaae gurmukh bhagat thai paavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: The Word of His Bani vibrates, and the Word of His Shabad resounds, for the Gurmukh whose devotional worship is accepted. ||5||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bahu taal poore vaaje vajaae ||
verses.translation: One may beat upon and play all sorts of instruments,

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko sune na ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: but no one will listen, and no one will enshrine it in the mind.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਿੜ ਬੰਧਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: maiaa kaaran piR ba(n)dh naachai dhoojai bhai dhukh paavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: For the sake of Maya, they set the stage and dance, but they are in love with duality, and they obtain only sorrow. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)tar preet lagai so mukataa ||
verses.translation: Those whose inner beings are attached to the Lord's Love are liberated.

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhree vas sach sa(n)jam jugataa ||
verses.translation: They control their sexual desires, and their lifestyle is the self-discipline of Truth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sadhaa har dhiaae ehaa bhagat har bhaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they meditate forever on the Lord. This devotional worship is pleasing to the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat jug chaare hoiee ||
verses.translation: To live as Gurmukh is devotional worship, throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: horat bhagat na paae koiee ||
verses.translation: This devotional worship is not obtained by any other means.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੦॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam gur bhagatee paieeaai gur charanee chit laavaniaa ||8||20||21||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained only through devotion to the Guru. So focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||20||21||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sevee sach saalaahee ||
verses.translation: Serve the True One, and praise the True One.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sachai nai dhukh kab hee naahee ||
verses.translation: With the True Name, pain shall never afflict you.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa sevan sukh pain gurmat ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Giver of peace find peace. They enshrine the Guru's Teachings within their minds. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sukh sahaj samaadh lagaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who intuitively enter into the peace of Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo har seveh se sadhaa soheh sobhaa surat suhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Lord are always beautiful. The glory of their intuitive awareness is beautiful. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko teraa bhagat kahaae ||
verses.translation: All call themselves Your devotees,

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: seiee bhagat terai man bhaae ||
verses.translation: but they alone are Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your mind.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sach baanee tudhai saalaahan ra(n)g raate bhagat karaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of Your Bani, they praise You; attuned to Your Love, they worship You with devotion. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko sache har jeeau teraa ||
verses.translation: All are Yours, O Dear True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh milai taa chookai feraa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Gurmukh, this cycle of reincarnation comes to an end.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaavai taa nai rachaaveh too(n) aape naau japaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: When it pleases Your Will, then we merge in the Name. You Yourself inspire us to chant the Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee har ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine the Lord within my mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog sabh moh gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Pleasure and pain, and all emotional attachments are gone.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eikas siau liv laagee sadh hee har naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: I am lovingly centered on the One Lord forever. I enshrine the Lord's Name within my mind. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat ra(n)g raate sadhaa terai chaae ||
verses.translation: Your devotees are attuned to Your Love; they are always joyful.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: nau nidh naam vasiaa man aae ||
verses.translation: The nine treasures of the Naam come to dwell within their minds.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag satigur paiaa sabadhe mel milaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: By perfect destiny, they find the True Guru, and through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||5||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhiaal sadhaa sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: You are Merciful, and always the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape meleh gurmukh jaataa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself unite us; You are known only to the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape dheveh naam vaddaiee naam rate sukh paavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: You Yourself bestow the glorious greatness of the Naam; attuned to the Naam, we find peace. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa saache tudh saalaahee ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I praise You.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaataa dhoojaa ko naahee ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I know no other at all.

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਮਨਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ekas siau man rahiaa samaae man ma(n)niaai maneh milaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: My mind remains immersed in the One Lord; my mind surrenders to Him, and in my mind I meet Him. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so saalaahe ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: saache Thaakur veparavaahe ||
verses.translation: Our True Lord and Master is Carefree.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar gur sabadhee har melaavaniaa ||8||21||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with the Lord. ||8||21||22||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tere bhagat soheh saachai dharabaare ||
verses.translation: Your devotees look beautiful in the True Court.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh naam savaare ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are adorned with the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh raheh dhin raatee gun keh gunee samaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: They are forever in bliss, day and night; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, they merge with the Lord of Glory. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree naam sun ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who hear and enshrine the Naam within their minds.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau sachaa uoocho uoochaa haumai maar milaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord, the True One, the Highest of the High, subdues their ego and blends them with Himself. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau saachaa saachee naiee ||
verses.translation: True is the Dear Lord, and True is His Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee kisai milaiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, some merge with Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh mileh se vichhuReh naahee sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, those who merge with the Lord shall not be separated from Him again. They merge with intuitive ease into the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tujh te baahar kachhoo na hoi ||
verses.translation: There is nothing beyond You;

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) kar kar vekheh jaaneh soi ||
verses.translation: You are the One who does, sees, and knows.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae karataa gurmat aap milaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires others to act. Through the Guru's Teachings, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman gunava(n)tee har paae ||
verses.translation: The virtuous soul-bride finds the Lord;

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhai seegaar banaae ||
verses.translation: she decorates herself with the Love and the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਚ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sadhaa sohaagan sach upadhes samaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: She who serves the True Guru is forever a happy soul-bride. She is absorbed in the true teachings. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh visaaran tinaa Thaur na Thaau ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Word of the Shabad have no home and no place of rest.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhoole jiau su(n)n(j)ai ghar kaau ||
verses.translation: They are deluded by doubt, like a crow in a deserted house.

verses.original: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: halat palat tinee dhovai gavaae dhukhe dhukh vihaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: They forfeit both this world and the next, and they pass their lives suffering in pain and misery. ||5||

verses.original: ਲਿਖਦਿਆ ਲਿਖਦਿਆ ਕਾਗਦ ਮਸੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: likhadhiaa likhadhiaa kaagadh mas khoiee ||
verses.translation: Writing on and on endlessly, they run out of paper and ink.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai sukh paae na koiee ||
verses.translation: Through the love with duality, no one has found peace.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਤੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kooR likheh tai kooR kamaaveh jal jaaveh kooR chit laavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: They write falsehood, and they practice falsehood; they are burnt to ashes by focusing their consciousness on falsehood. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sacho sach likheh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs write and reflect on Truth, and only Truth.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: se jan sache paaveh mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: The true ones find the gate of salvation.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sach kaagadh kalam masavaanee sach likh sach samaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: True is their paper, pen and ink; writing Truth, they are absorbed in the True One. ||7||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh a(n)tar baiThaa vekhai ||
verses.translation: My God sits deep within the self; He watches over us.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee milai soiee jan lekhai ||
verses.translation: Those who meet the Lord, by Guru's Grace, are acceptable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||22||23||
verses.translation: O Nanak, glorious greatness is received through the Naam, which is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||23||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aatam raam paragaas gur te hovai ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light of the Supreme Soul shines forth from the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mail laagee gur sabadhee khovai ||
verses.translation: The filth stuck to the ego is removed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man niramal anadhin bhagatee raataa bhagat kare har paavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: One who is imbued with devotional worship to the Lord night and day becomes pure. Worshipping the Lord, He is obtained. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree aap bhagat karan avaraa bhagat karaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who themselves worship the Lord, and inspire others to worship Him as well.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tinaa bhagat janaa kau sadh namasakaar keejai jo anadhin har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I humbly bow to those devotees who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kaaran karaae ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord Himself is the Doer of deeds.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jit bhaavai tit kaarai laae ||
verses.translation: As He pleases, He applies us to our tasks.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag gur sevaa hovai gur sevaa te sukh paavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Through perfect destiny, we serve the Guru; serving the Guru, peace is found. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: mar mar jeevai taa kichh paae ||
verses.translation: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, obtain it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Lord within their minds.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa mukat har ma(n)n vasaae sahaje sahaj samaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Enshrining the Lord within their minds, they are liberated forever. With intuitive ease, they merge into the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bahu karam kamaavai mukat na paae ||
verses.translation: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they do not obtain liberation through them.

verses.original: ਦੇਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhesa(n)tar bhavai dhoojai bhai khuaae ||
verses.translation: They wander around the countryside, and in love with duality, they are ruined.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕਪਟੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: birathaa janam gavaiaa kapaTee bin sabadhai dhukh paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: The deceitful lose their lives in vain; without the Word of the Shabad, they obtain only misery. ||4||

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat raakhai Thaak rahaae ||
verses.translation: Those who restrain their wandering mind, keeping it steady and stable,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee param padh paae ||
verses.translation: obtain the supreme status, by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur aape mel milaae mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: The True Guru Himself unites us in Union with the Lord. Meeting the Beloved, peace is obtained. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਕੂੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eik kooR laage kooRe fal paae ||
verses.translation: Some are stuck in falsehood, and false are the rewards they receive.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai birathaa janam gavaae ||
verses.translation: In love with duality, they waste away their lives in vain.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aap ddube sagale kul ddobe kooR bol bikh khaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: They drown themselves, and drown their entire family; speaking lies, they eat poison. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: eis tan meh man ko gurmukh dhekhai ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, look within their bodies, into their minds.

verses.original: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhagat jaa haumai sokhai ||
verses.translation: Through loving devotion, their ego evaporates.

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik monidhaaree rahe liv lai tin bhee tan meh man na dhikhaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: The Siddhas, the seekers and the silent sages continually, lovingly focus their consciousness, but they have not seen the mind within the body. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap karaae karataa soiee ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself inspires us to work;

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: hor k kare keetai kiaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: what can anyone else do? What can be done by our doing?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੩॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak jis naam dhevai so levai naamo ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||23||24||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Name; we receive it, and enshrine it within the mind. ||8||23||24||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis gufaa meh akhuT bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within this cave, there is an inexhaustible treasure.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich vasai har alakh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within this cave, the Invisible and Infinite Lord abides.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape gupat paragaT hai aape gur sabadhee aap va(n)n(j)aavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, selfishness and conceit are eliminated. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree a(n)mirat naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within their minds.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam mahaa ras meeThaa gurmatee a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The taste of the Ambrosial Naam is very sweet! Through the Guru's Teachings, drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar bajar kapaaT khulaiaa ||
verses.translation: Subduing egotism, the rigid doors are opened.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam amolak gur parasaadhee paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Priceless Naam is obtained by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai naam na paae koiee gur kirapaa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, the Naam is not obtained. By Guru's Grace, it is implanted within the mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur giaan a(n)jan sach netree paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has applied the true ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Deep within, the Divine Light has dawned, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jotee jot milee man maaniaa har dhar sobhaa paavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: My light has merged into the Light; my mind has surrendered, and I am blessed with Glory in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sareerahu bhaalan ko baahar jaae || naam na lahai bahut vegaar dhukh paae ||
verses.translation: Those who look outside the body, searching for the Lord, shall not receive the Naam; they shall instead be forced to suffer the terrible pains of slavery.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਆਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dhe soojhai naahee fir ghir aai gurmukh vath paavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand; but when they return once again to their own home, then, as Gurmukh, they find the genuine article. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sachaa har paae ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the True Lord is found.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man tan vekhai haumai mail jaae ||
verses.translation: Within your mind and body, see the Lord, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

verses.original: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bais suthaan sadh har gun gaavai sachai sabadh samaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: Sitting in that place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever, and be absorbed in the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nau dhar Thaake dhaavat rahaae ||
verses.translation: Those who close off the nine gates, and restrain the wandering mind,

verses.original: ਦਸਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhasavai nij ghar vaasaa paae ||
verses.translation: come to dwell in the Home of the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: othai anahadh sabadh vajeh dhin raatee gurmatee sabadh sunaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: There, the Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates day and night. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Shabad is heard. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai a(n)tar aaneraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, there is only darkness within.

verses.original: ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: n vasat lahai na chookai feraa ||
verses.translation: The genuine article is not found, and the cycle of reincarnation does not end.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਦਰੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur hath ku(n)jee horat dhar khulai naahee gur poorai bhaag milaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: The key is in the hands of the True Guru; no one else can open this door. By perfect destiny, He is met. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gupat paragaT too(n) sabhanee thaiee ||
verses.translation: You are the hidden and the revealed in all places.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee mil sojhee paiee ||
verses.translation: Receiving Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੪॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaeh sadhaa too(n) gurmukh ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||24||25||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam forever; as Gurmukh, enshrine it within the mind. ||8||24||25||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh milai milaae aape ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs meet the Lord, and inspire others to meet Him as well.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaal na johai dhukh na sa(n)taape ||
verses.translation: Death does not see them, and pain does not afflict them.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਭ ਤੋੜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haumai maar ba(n)dhan sabh toRai gurmukh sabadh suhaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Subduing egotism, they break all their bonds; as Gurmukh, they are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har har naam suhaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who look beautiful in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh gaavai gurmukh naachai har setee chit laavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs sing, the Gurmukhs dance, and focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jeevai marai paravaan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are celebrated in life and death.

verses.original: ਆਰਜਾ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aarajaa na chheejai sabadh pachhaan ||
verses.translation: Their lives are not wasted; they realize the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh marai na kaal na khaae gurmukh sach samaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs do not die; they are not consumed by death. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har dhar sobhaa paae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vichahu aap gavaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap tarai kul sagale taare gurmukh janam savaaraniaa ||3||
verses.translation: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well. The Gurmukhs redeem their lives. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dhukh kadhe na lagai sareer ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs never suffer bodily pain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh haumai chookai peer ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs have the pain of egotism taken away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh man niramal fir mail na laagai gurmukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: The minds of the Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; no filth ever sticks to them again. The Gurmukhs merge in celestial peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam milai vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs obtain the Greatness of the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh gun gaavai sobhaa paiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtain honor.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee gurmukh sabadh karaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: They remain in bliss forever, day and night. The Gurmukhs practice the Word of the Shabad. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh anadhin sabadhe raataa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Shabad, night and day.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jug chaare hai jaataa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are known throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh gun gaavai sadhaa niramal sabadhe bhagat karaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs always sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. Through the Shabad, they practice devotional worship. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo hai a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਗਰਠੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jamakaal garaThe kareh pukaaraa ||
verses.translation: Seized by the Messenger of Death, people cry out and scream.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: anadhin rogee bisaTaa ke keeRe bisaTaa meh dhukh paavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: Night and day, they are diseased, like maggots in manure, and in manure they endure agony. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aape kare karaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs know that the Lord alone acts, and causes others to act.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hiradhai vuThaa aap aae ||
verses.translation: In the hearts of the Gurmukhs, the Lord Himself comes to dwell.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੫॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||25||26||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. It is received from the Perfect Guru. ||8||25||26||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa jot jot hai sareeraa ||
verses.translation: The One Light is the light of all bodies.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh dhikhaae satigur pooraa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru reveals it through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape farak keeton ghaT a(n)tar aape banat banaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself instills the sense of separation within our hearts; He Himself created the Creation. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo ko sahaj na paae gurmukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom; the Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape soheh aape jag moheh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are Beautiful, and You Yourself entice the world.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape nadharee jagat paroveh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself, by Your Kind Mercy, weave the thread of the world.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape dhukh sukh dheveh karate gurmukh har dhekhaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: You Yourself bestow pain and pleasure, O Creator. The Lord reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kare karaae ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape sabadh gur ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: Through Him, the Word of the Guru's Shabad is enshrined within the mind.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabadhe upajai a(n)mirat baanee gurmukh aakh sunaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani emanates from the Word of the Shabad. The Gurmukh speaks it and hears it. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa aape bhugataa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੇ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan toRe sadhaa hai mukataa ||
verses.translation: One who breaks out of bondage is liberated forever.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sadhaa mukat aape hai sachaa aape alakh lakhaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: The True Lord is liberated forever. The Unseen Lord causes Himself to be seen. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape maiaa aape chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is Maya, and He Himself is the Illusion.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape moh sabh jagat upaiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself has generated emotional attachment throughout the entire universe.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aape gunadhaataa gun gaavai aape aakh sunaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Giver of Virtue; He Himself sings the Lord's Glorious Praises. He chants them and causes them to be heard. ||5||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae aape ||
verses.translation: He Himself acts, and causes others to act.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape thaap uthaape aape ||
verses.translation: He Himself establishes and disestablishes.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tujh te baahar kachhoo na hovai too(n) aape kaarai laavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: Without You, nothing can be done. You Yourself have engaged all in their tasks. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape maare aap jeevaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself kills, and He Himself revives.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape mele mel milaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself unites us, and unites us in Union with Himself.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sevaa te sadhaa sukh paiaa gurmukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: Through selfless service, eternal peace is obtained. The Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਊਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape uoochaa uoocho hoiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Highest of the High.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis aap vikhaale su vekhai koiee ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who behold Him. He causes Himself to be seen.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੬॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasai ghaT a(n)tar aape vekh vikhaalaniaa ||8||26||27||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the hearts of those who see the Lord themselves, and inspire others to see Him as well. ||8||26||27||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh bharapoor rahiaa sabh thaiee ||
verses.translation: My God is pervading and permeating all places.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ghar hee meh paiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have found Him within the home of my own heart.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sarevee ik man dhiaaiee gurmukh sach samaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: I serve Him constantly, and I meditate on Him single-mindedly. As Gurmukh, I am absorbed in the True One. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree jagajeevan ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord, the Life of the World, within their minds.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jagajeevan nirabhau dhaataa gurmat sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I merge with intuitive ease into the Lord, the Life of the World, the Fearless One, the Great Giver. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghar meh dharatee dhaul paataalaa ||
verses.translation: Within the home of the self is the earth, its support and the nether regions of the underworld.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghar hee meh preetam sadhaa hai baalaa ||
verses.translation: Within the home of the self is the Eternally Young Beloved.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai sukhadhaataa gurmat sahaj samaavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace is eternally blissful. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar haumai meraa ||
verses.translation: When the body is filled with ego and selfishness,

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran na chookai feraa ||
verses.translation: the cycle of birth and death does not end.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su haumai maare sacho sach dhiaavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh subdues egotism, and meditates on the Truest of the True. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar paap pu(n)n dhui bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Within this body are the two brothers, sin and virtue.

verses.original: ਦੁਹੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhuhee mil kai sirasaT upaiee ||
verses.translation: When the two joined together, the Universe was produced.

verses.original: ਦੋਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhovai maar jai ikat ghar aavai gurmat sahaj samaavaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: Subduing both, and entering into the Home of the One, through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghar hee maeh dhoojai bhai aneraa ||
verses.translation: Within the home of the self is the darkness of the love of duality.

verses.original: ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਛੋਡੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: chaanan hovai chhoddai haumai meraa ||
verses.translation: When the Divine Light dawns, ego and selfishness are dispelled.

verses.original: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: paragaT sabadh hai sukhadhaataa anadhin naam dhiaavaniaa ||5||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace is revealed through the Shabad, meditating upon the Naam, night and day. ||5||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jot paragaT paasaaraa ||
verses.translation: Deep within the self is the Light of God; It radiates throughout the expanse of His creation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur saakhee miTiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.

verses.original: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kamal bigaas sadhaa sukh paiaa jotee jot milaavaniaa ||6||
verses.translation: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and eternal peace is obtained, as one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar mahal ratanee bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within the mansion is the treasure house, overflowing with jewels.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paae naam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Infinite Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vanaje sadhaa vaapaaree laahaa naam sadh paavaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh, the trader, always purchases the merchandise of the Naam, and always reaps profits. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵਥੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape vath raakhai aape dhei ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself keeps this merchandise in stock, and He Himself distributes it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vanajeh keiee kei ||
verses.translation: Rare is that Gurmukh who trades in this.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੭॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak jis nadhar kare so paae kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||27||28||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain it. Through His Mercy, it is enshrined in the mind. ||8||27||28||

verses.original: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maajh, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har aape mele sev karaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself leads us to merge with Him and serve Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh bhaau dhoojaa jaae ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the love of duality is eradicated.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har niramal sadhaa gunadhaataa har gun meh aap samaavaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord is the Bestower of eternal virtue. The Lord Himself leads us to merge in His Virtuous Goodness. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sach sachaa hiradhai vasaavaniaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Truest of the True within their hearts.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa naam sadhaa hai niramal gur sabadhee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Name is eternally pure and immaculate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is enshrined within the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape gur dhaataa karam bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Guru Himself is the Giver, the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevak seveh gurmukh har jaataa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh, the humble servant who serves the Lord, comes to know Him.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam sadhaa jan soheh gurmat har ras paavaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those humble beings look beautiful forever in the Ambrosial Naam. Through the Guru's Teachings, they receive the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eis gufaa meh ik thaan suhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Within the cave of this body, there is one beautiful place.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorai gur haumai bharam chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, ego and doubt are dispelled.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam salaahan ra(n)g raate gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, you shall find Him. ||3||
